Title: Head of operations
Description:
****Job Description:****
**Job summary:**
The Head of Operations (HO Operations) is responsible for the end-to-end operational performance of the subsidiary, covering spares distribution, technical support, training, Part 145 maintenance/repair activities, equipment repair, and contract management. The role ensures operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and a strong safety culture while supporting the development of multi-service support offers to customers across the region.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**
Operations Leadership
  
  

* Lead and coordinate all operational functions: spares distribution, technical support, Part 145 workshop, equipment repair, and training delivery
* Ensure operational plans are aligned with the subsidiary's business objectives and customer commitments
* Drive performance through clear KPIs, structured governance, and regular operational reviews

Part 145 & Technical Support
  
  

* Ensure the Part 145 maintenance organization operates in full compliance with applicable civil/military airworthiness regulations
* Oversee technical support activities, ensuring timely and quality resolution of customer technical requests
* Maintain strong relationships with airworthiness authorities and Airbus Helicopters engineering support

Spares & Equipment Repair
  
  

* Ensure efficient spares distribution processes, inventory accuracy, and on-time delivery performance
* Oversee equipment repair operations, ensuring turnaround times and quality standards are met

Training
  
  

* Ensure training programs (technical, operational) are delivered to required standards and support customer capability development
* Coordinate with training partners/academies as relevant

Contract Management & Support Offers
  
  

* Oversee contract execution, ensuring deliverables, SLAs, and commercial terms are met
* Support the development and structuring of multi-service support offers (bundled MRO, training, spares, technical support packages) in collaboration with Sales/Business Development

Safety Culture & Structure
  
  

* Champion a strong, visible safety culture across all operational activities - technical, workshop, and training environments
* Ensure robust risk management, incident reporting, and continuous improvement processes are in place
* Build and maintain structured, documented processes and procedures across all operational domains, ensuring consistency, auditability, and scalability as the organization grows
* Lead by example on compliance, discipline, and rigor in day-to-day operations

People Management
  
  

* Manage, coach, and develop operational team leads and their teams
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

**Requirements:**

* Strong experience in Support & Services ideally in Aeronautics.
* Significant experience in MRO/aviation operations management, ideally in a helicopter or complex technical environment
* Strong knowledge of Part 145 requirements and airworthiness regulatory frameworks
* Proven track record leading multi-disciplinary operational teams (technical, logistics, training)
* Experience in contract management and support of commercial/service offer development
* Demonstrated commitment to safety culture and structured operational management
* Strong leadership, organizational, and stakeholder management skills
* Good Communication skills
* Strong network internal and external

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Title: Incident Management (IM) Operations Lead
Description:
Job Description: Incident Management (IM) Operations Lead

24/7 Operations – Connected Car & Telematics

Location: Irvine, CA (5 Days Onsite)

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an Incident Management (IM) Operations Lead for a 24/7 operations program supporting a key player in the automotive industry's connected car space. This role will lead an onsite–offshore IM function, act as the single point of accountability for all incidents and active outages which occur during onsite business hours and ensure adherence to contractual SLAs. The IM Operations Lead will orchestrate end-to-end incident handling—from anomaly detection to bridge initiation, stakeholder communications, resolution, and post-incident governance—with a strong background in Telematics and Connected Vehicle systems (including Remote Services).

**Key Responsibilities**

Lead and mentor the Incident Management team in an onsite–offshore operating model; establish clear handoffs and coverage to support 24/7 operations.

Own and drive the lifecycle of every major incident/outage (not a shift-based support engineer role), ensuring rapid triage, containment, and resolution.

Serve as the primary point of contact (POC) for all IM matters—including executive escalations—maintaining authoritative situational awareness across platforms.

Accountable for all IM SLAs (MTTD, MTTA, MTTR, communication SLAs); ensure measurement, reporting, and continuous improvement.

Should be proficient in handling the incidents ranging from high priority ones (P1, P2) to the low priority incidents (P3, P4).

Initiate and run incident bridges/war rooms; coordinate cross-functional responders (application, infrastructure, network, OEM partners, and third parties).

Oversee proactive detection through data monitoring tools (Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, MaxGauge) and ensure alert quality, runbooks, and signal-to-noise optimization.

Establish and enforce SOPs for incident declaration, severity classification, response roles and decision logs.

Drive disciplined stakeholder communications: timely updates to product, operations, OEM/customer contacts, leadership, and impacted regions; maintain comms cadence and channels.

Ensure post-incident governance: facilitate RCA, document contributing causes, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and circulate the RCA across teams for sign-off.

Partner with Problem Management to track and eradicate recurring issues; maintain problem backlog, KEDB (Known Error Database), and follow-through on remediation.

Define and maintain IM dashboards, KPIs, and executive reports; present weekly/monthly service reviews with trend analysis and action plans.

Collaborate with Product/Engineering to influence reliability roadmaps (resiliency patterns, observability, capacity, release safeguards).

Ensure compliance with information security, data privacy, and OEM contractual obligations during incident handling and communications.

Continuously refine IM playbooks, runbooks, and training; conduct simulations/game days and readiness audits across onsite–offshore teams.

Domain Expertise: Telematics & Connected Car

Hands-on knowledge of Telematics Control Unit (TCU), eSIM/OTA provisioning, backend telematics platforms, and data flows between vehicle, cloud, and mobile apps.

Familiarity with Remote Services (e.g., remote lock/unlock, start/stop, charge control, climate pre-conditioning), geo-services, and safety/assist features.

Understanding of service dependencies: identity/auth, messaging, device management, CAN bus signals, firmware/OTA update orchestration, and regional compliance.

Experience coordinating incidents across OEM partners, Tier-1 suppliers, cloud providers, and customer support operations.

**Required Qualifications**

8–12+ years in Operations/Service Management with 4+ years leading Incident Management in large-scale, 24/7 environments.

Demonstrated experience running bridges for P1/P0 incidents; proven incident commander skills and decision-making under pressure.

Strong background in Telematics/Connected Car domain and vehicle remote services concepts.

Proficiency with observability and monitoring tools: Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, MaxGauge (dashboards, alerting, traces, logs).

Expertise in IM processes: detection → triage → severity assignment → bridge initiation → stakeholder updates → resolution → post-incident RCA.

Working knowledge of ITIL practices (Incident, Problem, Change, Service Level Management).

Should have good hands-on experience in using tools like JIRA, Confluence, Jenkins, XMatters.

Excellent communication (written/verbal), executive presence, and stakeholder management across onsite–offshore teams.

Ability to analyze telemetry and time-series data to drive root cause hypotheses and corrective actions.

Experience defining SLAs/SLOs and building KPI dashboards (MTTD/MTTA/MTTR, incident volume, recurrence, comms SLA, customer impact).

Tools & Technologies

Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, MaxGauge (APM, logs, metrics, dashboards).

Incident & Comms: ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), chat/bridge tools (Teams/Zoom), status pages.

Data: time-series analysis, log aggregation, tracing, alerting policies and noise reduction.

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Location & Travel

Location: Costa Mesa, Orange County, California.

Work Model: Onsite presence from office is required 5 days a week.

Title: Assistant Manager - Pouching
Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Assistant Manager – Pouching Department

**Department:**Production – Pouching  
**Reports To:**Production Manager / Plant Head

1. Job PurposeTo manage and control all pouching operations to achieve production targets, optimum machine utilization, required quality standards, on-time delivery, minimum wastage, and efficient manpower utilization while ensuring compliance with safety and company procedures.2. Key Responsibilities**A. Production Planning and Execution**

* Execute daily and monthly production plans as per customer requirements and delivery schedules.
* Ensure optimum utilization of pouching machines, manpower, and available resources.
* Monitor production output, machine speeds, efficiency, downtime, and order completion.
* Ensure timely changeovers, job preparation, and smooth production flow.
* Coordinate with Planning, Printing, Lamination, Slitting, QA, Maintenance, departments.
* Take corrective action to recover production losses and meet daily targets.

**B. Productivity and Cost Control**

* Achieve defined targets for output, productivity, machine utilization, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), where applicable.
* Minimize material wastage, start-up rejection, sealing defects, and pouching losses.
* Monitor production performance against established standards and identify improvement opportunities.
* Improve machine running speeds and reduce setup, changeover, and idle time.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to increase capacity and reduce conversion costs.

**C. Quality Management**

* Ensure production conforms to approved specifications, customer requirements, and quality standards.
* Monitor critical parameters such as sealing temperature, pressure, dwell time, registration, dimensions, zipper alignment, gusset formation, and cutting accuracy, as applicable to the pouch type.
* Ensure first-piece approval and regular in-process quality checks.
* Prevent defects such as seal leakage, wrinkles, misregistration, poor cutting, contamination, and dimensional variation.
* Ensure traceability, correct material identification, and proper recording of production and quality data.
* Coordinate with QA to investigate non-conformities, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure rejected and non-conforming material is properly identified, segregated, and controlled.

**D. Manpower Management**

* Allocate operators and helpers according to machine loading and production priorities.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, productivity, and operator performance.
* Develop operator skills through training, coaching, and competency assessments.
* Ensure proper shift handover and effective communication between shifts.
* Build a multi-skilled workforce to improve operational flexibility.

**E. Machine Maintenance and Performance**

* Coordinate with Maintenance to ensure preventive maintenance and timely breakdown resolution.
* Monitor recurring breakdowns and implement measures to reduce downtime.
* Ensure machines, tools, sealing jaws, cutting systems, and other accessories are maintained in good working condition.
* Ensure proper machine settings, changeover practices, and equipment handling.
* Report technical issues and recommend improvements to enhance machine reliability.

**F. Safety, Housekeeping and Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with company safety rules, machine guarding, and lockout/tagout procedures where applicable.
* Maintain 5S, housekeeping, and cleanliness throughout the department.
* Ensure safe handling of materials, tools, and equipment.
* Promote a safety-first culture and report incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality, food-contact packaging, hygiene, and customer requirements.

**G. Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare daily production and shift performance reports.
* Monitor output, efficiency, downtime, wastage, rejection, and manpower utilization.
* Ensure accurate recording of production data in ERP systems.
* Analyze performance gaps and submit action plans to the Production Manager.
* Maintain records of machine settings, quality checks, changeovers, downtime, and material reconciliation.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance will be evaluated against approved departmental targets for:

* Production output versus plan.
* Machine efficiency and utilization.
* Downtime and breakdown losses.
* Material wastage and rejection percentage.
* Quality defects and customer complaints.
* On-time order completion.
* Setup and changeover time.
* Manpower productivity and overtime control.
* Preventive maintenance compliance.

Title: Major Incident Manager
Description:
**Job Summary & Objectives**

The Major Incident Manager leads the coordinated response to Severity 1 (Critical) and Severity 2 (Major) technology incidents affecting the firm’s lawyers, business professionals, clients, offices, or critical services. The role assumes operational command during a declared major incident and remains accountable for the incident lifecycle from declaration and role activation through service restoration, closure, post-incident review, and transition to Problem Management.

The Major Incident Manager directs the response process but does not replace the Technical Lead, Service Owner, Communications Lead, Information Security, Legal, or engineering teams. The role establishes clear command and control, maintains urgency and disciplined decision-making, removes response barriers, ensures stakeholders receive accurate and timely information, and keeps participating teams focused on restoring business service.

The position also advances the firm’s Major Incident Management program by maintaining standards, improving ServiceNow workflows, developing incident managers and responders, facilitating exercises, measuring performance, and converting lessons from incidents into permanent operational improvements.

**Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities**

**Major Incident Command**

* Serve as operational commander for declared Severity 1 and Severity 2 incidents, including technology outages with security, privacy, client-data, regulatory, contractual, or business-continuity implications.
* Validate business impact and urgency, declare the major incident, confirm or adjust severity, and document the basis for the decision.
* Assume ownership of all required incident roles until qualified individuals are assigned.
* Activate and chair the incident bridge or war room, establish operating discipline, and ensure the correct service owners, technical teams, vendors, and leadership representatives are engaged.
* Set response objectives, stakeholder-update cadence, decision points, escalation thresholds, action owners, and target times.
* Maintain separation between incident command and technical troubleshooting so technical responders can focus on diagnosis and restoration.
* Challenge unvalidated assumptions, redirect stalled activity, and escalate nonresponsive teams, vendor delays, missing authority, competing priorities, or resource constraints.
* Coordinate response across regions, time zones, technology pillars, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Manage incident-manager handoffs and relief during prolonged events while preserving continuity of command and an accurate chronology.
* Authorize severity changes and recommend stand-down or closure after technical restoration and business validation.
* Ensure emergency changes, workarounds, rollback decisions, and risk acceptances are properly authorized and recorded.

**Communication & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Direct the Communications Lead in preparing clear, concise, fact-based incident notifications for IT responders, business stakeholders, firm leadership, and other approved audiences.
* Confirm affected services, user and client impact, available workaround, response ownership, current actions, risks, and the expected next update before communications are released.
* Maintain the required communication cadence, including status, material changes, service restoration, and closure notices.
* Provide concise executive briefings that distinguish confirmed facts, working hypotheses, unknowns, decisions required, and business risk.
* Coordinate with Information Security, Risk, Privacy, Legal, and firm leadership when an incident may involve confidential information, client data, regulatory notification, contractual commitments, or reputational exposure.
* Ensure external, client, insurer, regulator, or law-enforcement communications follow required approval paths.
* Protect confidentiality and legal privilege by limiting sensitive incident information to approved channels and audiences.

**Documentation, Closure & Post-Incident Review**

* Ensure the major incident record is complete and maintained as the authoritative record in ServiceNow.
* Ensure the Scribe captures actions, decisions, timestamps, communications, owners, escalation attempts, changes, workarounds, and restoration evidence in real time.
* Confirm technical restoration with the Technical Lead and validate business service restoration with the Service Owner before closing the incident.
* Ensure final communications accurately describe service status, remaining risk, monitoring requirements, and any continuing workaround.
* Remain accountable for completion of the Post-Incident Review and ensure the chronology, decisions, evidence, communication history, and performance data are available for review.
* Partner with the Problem Manager to identify root cause, contributing factors, control failures, known errors, and corrective actions.
* Ensure remediation items have named owners, priorities, target dates, and traceable ServiceNow records.
* Escalate overdue or ineffective remediation and report repeat incidents, systemic risks, and unresolved corrective actions to leadership.
* Update procedures, training, response templates, contact rosters, and knowledge content based on approved lessons learned.

**Process Ownership & Operational Readiness**

* Maintain the Major Incident Management lifecycle, operating procedures, decision authority, RACI, response checklists, escalation matrices, communication templates, contact rosters, and bridge information.
* Partner with Global Support Operations and the ServiceNow platform team to improve workflows, automation, notifications, dashboards, paging, and reporting.
* Maintain a qualified Incident Manager and Deputy Incident Manager roster with appropriate global and after-hours coverage.
* Develop and deliver role-based training for Incident Managers, Service Desk leaders, regional support leaders, Communications Leads, Scribes, and technical responders.
* Plan and facilitate tabletop exercises, simulations, and incident-response drills; assess performance and track readiness improvements to completion.
* Coordinate with Security Incident Response, Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, Emergency Change, Problem Management, and Vendor Management processes.
* Support governance reviews and recommend changes to incident criteria, authority, coverage, service levels, and escalation expectations.
* Prepare leadership reporting on major incident performance, recurring failure patterns, response risks, and remediation status.

**Measures of Success**

* Incident Manager engaged within 5 minutes of a validated request.
* Qualifying major incident declared within 10 minutes.
* Required roles assigned and bridge activated within 5 minutes of declaration.
* Initial stakeholder communication delivered within 15 minutes for Severity 1 and 30 minutes for Severity 2 incidents.
* Compliance with the approved stakeholder-update cadence.
* Mean time to acknowledge, declare, mobilize, mitigate, restore, and close.
* Percentage of incidents with a complete timeline and decision log.
* Percentage of Post-Incident Reviews and corrective actions completed within approved targets.
* Reduction in repeat incidents and recurrence associated with previously identified control gaps.
* Incident Manager roster readiness, training completion, and exercise performance.
* Stakeholder assessment of communication clarity, accuracy, timeliness, and usefulness.

**Education**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, Emergency Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**Preferred**

* ITIL 4 Foundation.
* ITIL 4 Specialist: Create, Deliver and Support.
* ITIL 4 Strategist: Direct, Plan and Improve.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or equivalent ServiceNow ITSM experience.
* Formal training in crisis management, incident command, Kepner-Tregoe, 5 Whys, or another structured investigation and decision-making method.

**Skills & Experience**

**Required**

* Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT service management, technology operations, infrastructure, application support, service desk, or enterprise support.
* At least three years directly leading major incidents, crisis bridges, critical service-restoration efforts, or comparable high-pressure operational responses.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Knowledge Management, and service-level management.
* Hands-on experience using ServiceNow or an equivalent enterprise ITSM platform for incident command, task ownership, chronology, reporting, and audit evidence.
* Experience coordinating multiple technical disciplines during complex outages without assuming ownership of each technical workstream.
* Ability to translate technical conditions into clear business impact, risk, decisions, and actions for nontechnical leaders.
* Strong executive presence, judgment, composure, discretion, and communication skills.
* Ability to establish authority through role clarity, process discipline, and sound decision-making rather than organizational hierarchy.
* Strong written documentation skills, including incident summaries, executive updates, timelines, PIR inputs, procedures, and governance reporting.
* Willingness and ability to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation and respond outside normal business hours.

**Preferred**

* Experience in an AmLaw firm, financial institution, global professional-services organization, or similarly regulated and client-sensitive environment.
* Experience coordinating security, privacy, client-data, or regulatory incidents with Information Security, Legal, Privacy, Risk, and external service providers.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, identity and access management, network services, end-user computing, cloud platforms, virtual desktop, remote access, telephony, and legal-industry applications.
* Experience with globally distributed teams and follow-the-sun support.
* Experience designing or improving major-incident workflows, automation, dashboards, paging, and executive reporting.
* Experience planning and facilitating tabletop exercises and simulations.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Incident command and bridge facilitation.
* Business-impact and severity assessment.
* Structured escalation and decision management.
* Executive, attorney, client, and technical communications.
* ServiceNow ITSM and major-incident records.
* Evidence, chronology, and audit-quality documentation.
* Root-cause and contributing-factor analysis.
* Problem Management and corrective-action governance.
* Emergency Change and rollback coordination.
* Information-security, privacy, confidentiality, and business-continuity awareness.
* Vendor escalation and support-entitlement management.
* Global coverage, handoffs, and on-call operations.
* Calm leadership during incomplete, rapidly changing, and high-risk situations.

**Role Authority & Scope Boundary**

*The Major Incident Manager owns the incident-management process and operational command of the response. Technical Leads and Service Owners remain responsible for technical diagnosis, corrective actions, and service validation. The Communications Lead owns message preparation and distribution through approved channels. The Problem Manager facilitates root-cause review and tracks long-term remediation. The Major Incident Manager remains accountable for coordinated execution, escalation, closure, and completion of the post-incident process.*

**Working Conditions**

* Primarily office-based or hybrid work in accordance with firm policy.
* Regular after-hours, weekend, and holiday availability as part of an on-call rotation.
* Periods of sustained concentration and extended working hours during Severity 1 or prolonged Severity 2 incidents.
* Occasional travel to firm offices, response exercises, or operational-readiness sessions.
* Sedentary work consistent with a professional office role.

**Drafting Basis**

This draft was developed from the STB Major Incident Management SOP Runbook v1.1 and the current Global Support Services leadership and technology-support job-description formats. Final reporting line, grade, compensation range, location eligibility, and FLSA classification remain subject to Human Resources and leadership approval.

Title: Senior Director, Information Technology
Description:

: Full Time, 14 Month Contract

  
Position Description:
  

The Toronto Region Board of Trade is seeking a Senior Director, Information Technology for a 14-month contract to lead the Board's IT team. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, you will ensure the Board's systems remain secure, reliable and well-supported, and serve as a trusted technology partner across all levels of the organization. This role oversees IT operations, business applications, vendor partnerships, cybersecurity and in-flight technology initiatives within a Microsoft-centred environment that includes Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform. * Serves as the senior technology advisor to the Chief Financial Officer and leadership team, providing clear, concise updates and recommendations.

* Maintains a strong understanding of the organization’s technology environment and remains actively involved in the execution and resolution of day-to-day technology matters.
  
* Identifies opportunities to improve technology effectiveness, reliability and user experience, with a focus on practical solutions appropriate for a 50-100-person organization.
  

  

**AI Implementation & Adoption**

  

  
* Supports the implementation of agentic AI solutions across the organization, working with business teams and external partners to identify practical use cases, configure and test solutions, and integrate them into everyday workflows.

* Provides practical guidance, training and troubleshooting to help employees adopt AI tools and apply them effectively in their work.

* Leads, supports and develops the IT team, setting priorities and managing performance and KPIs.
  
* Provides service to all areas of the Board by applying business partner skills and a client service outlook.
  
* Allocates work effectively across the team and ensures appropriate coverage for operational priorities, projects and employee support.
  
* Documents key decisions and changes to support a smooth transition at the end of the contract
  

  

**Vendor Management, Security & Compliance**

  

  
* Manages the relationships with key technology partners, including the managed services providers; monitors performance and oversees renewals and negotiations.
  
* Leads vendor escalations and ensures unresolved service issues are addressed quickly and effectively.
  
* Maintains the Board's cybersecurity posture across Azure and Microsoft 365, including identity, access and data protection.
  
* Upholds IT policies, including the Board's AI use policy, and supports compliance with accessibility (AODA) and privacy requirements.
  

  

**IT Operations & Service Delivery**

  

  
* Oversees the reliable day-to-day operation of IT infrastructure and technology services at both the Board’s event space at 100 Queens Quay and corporate office at 21 Melinda, including network connectivity, Wi-Fi, end-user services, collaboration tools and telephony.
  
* Takes a hands-on role in addressing operational issues, troubleshooting escalated concerns and coordinating resolution with internal team members and external vendors.
  
* Manages the IT operating calendar, including renewals, reviews and as needed event support.
  
* Maintains service levels and resolves escalated issues promptly.
  
* Oversees technology onboarding and offboarding, hardware and software provisioning, access management and equipment lifecycle requirements.
  

  

**Business Applications & Data**

  

  
* Oversees the Board's infrastructure including: CRM, marketing automation, finance, event management system, payments, website and related platforms.
  
* Works directly with business teams and vendors to troubleshoot issues, manage enhancements and ensure systems are configured to support operational requirements.
  
* Coordinates system upgrades, integrations, implementations and changes, ensuring appropriate testing, communication, documentation and employee support.
  
* Supports reporting and analytics through Power BI and champions low-code solutions on the Power Platform where they add value.
  
* Identifies opportunities to automate manual processes, simplify workflows and improve productivity using existing technology.
  

  

**Your experience includes:**

  

  
* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including experience leading IT teams.
  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  
* Strong working knowledge of a Microsoft-centred environment, including Azure, Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365.
  
* Practical experience implementing or supporting AI tools and workflow automation, including technical deployment and employee adoption; experience with agentic AI solutions considered an asset.
  
* Experience managing IT infrastructure, connectivity, audiovisual systems and technology support across multiple locations, including corporate office and event environments.
  
* Proven experience managing managed service providers and external agencies, including contracts and performance.
  
* Solid grounding in cybersecurity practices for a cloud-first organization.
  
* Experience managing an IT budget and reporting to senior executives.
  
* Strong oral and written communication skills; experience explaining technical matters to partners at all levels.
  
* Ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with business units.
  
* Experience with Business Central, Power BI, ClickDimensions, CMS considered an asset.
  

  

**You’re often described as:**

  

  
* A steady, pragmatic leader who builds trust quickly with a new team
  
* A business partner first, able to translate organizational needs into practical technology solutions
  
* Highly organized and able to navigate competing priorities and deadlines
  
* A self-starter who can work independently from a structured handover
  
* A strong communicator, collaborative with colleagues from all levels and departments
  
* Security-minded, detail-oriented and accountable
  

  

**Working Conditions:**

  

  
* Full-time position, hybrid with 3-4 days in office.
  
* May require occasional evening and weekend work for system maintenance or emergencies.
  
* On-call availability for critical system issues.

TRBOT is committed to fair, equitable pay that matches the responsibility and expertise behind every role.

  

This role has an annual salary range of $120,000-$170,000.

  

At TRBOT, performance plays an important role in pay progression. As you build your skills, take on new challenges, and make an impact, your compensation will evolve to reflect that progress. Regular development check-ins with your manager keep your path clear and your momentum strong.

  

We encourage open dialogue about compensation at every stage of the interview proto ensure transparency and trust. Ask us anything—we want you to feel informed and confident from day one.

Title: Incident Manager
Description:
Koniag IT Systems, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an Incident Manager to support KITS and our government customer Washington, DC. The position is hybrid, requires 3 days onsite. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.
  
  
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.
  
  
Koniag IT Systems, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced Incident Manager to support a comprehensive enterprise IT operations and support engagement for a federal customer. This role serves as the primary owner of the enterprise incident management lifecycle, ensuring rapid detection, triage, escalation, resolution, and post-incident review of IT incidents across a geographically distributed, 24x7 hybrid on-premises and cloud environment spanning AWS commercial and GovCloud, Microsoft 365, Azure Government, and enterprise network and application platforms.
  
  
The Incident Manager operates within a mature ITIL 4-aligned IT Service Management (ITSM) practice and works in close coordination with the enterprise NOC, multi-tier Service Desk, network engineering, infrastructure, and platform operations teams to ensure that all incidents are managed to resolution within established service level objectives. This individual plays a central role in driving service restoration, minimizing business impact, and contributing to the program's continual service improvement objectives through trend analysis, problem identification, and post-incident learning activities.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented and operationally experienced ITSM professional with a strong background in enterprise incident management, ITIL-based service management practices, and federal IT operations environments. This individual must thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability 24x7 operational setting and possess the ability to coordinate effectively across diverse technical teams and Government stakeholders under time-critical conditions.
  
  
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain an SBA background investigation, HSPD-12 PIV credentials, and applicable IT access authorizations prior to performing work. This position may be primarily performed at SBA Headquarters and/or approved remote/telework locations.
  
  
The Incident Manager is responsible for owning and managing the end-to-end enterprise incident management lifecycle in accordance with ITIL 4 best practices and SBA OCIO service management requirements. This individual ensures that all incidents—from Tier 1 Service Desk tickets through Priority 1 critical enterprise outages—are accurately classified, prioritized, assigned, escalated, and resolved within established service level agreements (SLAs). The Incident Manager serves as the central coordination hub during major incidents, driving technical bridge calls, managing stakeholder communications, and ensuring timely service restoration. This role also contributes to problem management, change management support, knowledge management, and continual service improvement activities.
  
  
**Incident Lifecycle Management**
**Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:**

* Own and manage the full enterprise incident management lifecycle from initial detection and logging through triage, categorization, prioritization, assignment, escalation, resolution, and formal closure in the Government's ITSM platform.
* Ensure all incidents are accurately classified by priority (P1–P4) in accordance with established impact and urgency criteria, and that appropriate response and resolution timelines are applied and monitored in real time.
* Monitor the active incident queue continuously, identifying aging incidents, escalation triggers, SLA breach risks, and stalled assignments, and taking proactive action to ensure forward progress on all open incidents.
* Coordinate and drive the timely assignment of incidents to the appropriate Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, or Tier 4 technical resources based on incident category, complexity, and required expertise.
* Ensure incidents are escalated promptly and appropriately—both functionally across technical teams and hierarchically to program leadership and Government stakeholders—when SLA thresholds, scope, or business impact warrant escalation.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and timely incident records in the ITSM platform throughout the incident lifecycle, ensuring all actions, decisions, workarounds, and resolutions are thoroughly documented.

**Major Incident Management**

* Serve as the primary coordinator and decision-maker for all Priority 1 (P1) and Priority 2 (P2) major incidents, activating and leading technical bridge calls, war rooms, and cross-functional response teams to drive rapid service restoration.
* Ensure P1 critical incidents are acknowledged within 15 minutes and that service restoration is achieved within 4 hours in accordance with program service level objectives, meeting the Government's target of at least 90% of P1 incidents restored within the 4-hour SLA.
* Maintain clear, accurate, and timely stakeholder communications throughout major incident events, including initial notifications, status updates at defined intervals, and formal incident closure notifications to the COR and Government stakeholders.
* Coordinate with the NOC, Service Desk Manager, technical leads, and program leadership to ensure all required resources are engaged, barriers to resolution are removed, and escalation paths are followed during major incidents.
* Lead or facilitate formal post-incident reviews (PIRs) for all P1 and significant P2 incidents, ensuring root cause analysis findings, contributing factors, corrective actions, and lessons learned are thoroughly documented and tracked to completion.

**Problem Management Coordination**

* Collaborate with the Problem Manager or Service Management Lead to ensure incidents exhibiting patterns of recurrence or systemic root causes are formally transitioned into the problem management process.
* Contribute incident trend data, recurring issue patterns, and workaround documentation to support problem record creation, root cause investigation, and known error documentation.
* Track and monitor the implementation of permanent fixes and corrective actions arising from problem management activities, ensuring incident recurrence rates are measurably reduced over time.

**Change Management Support**

* Coordinate with the change management process to identify incidents resulting from unauthorized changes or failed changes, ensuring accurate linkage between incident records and associated change records in the ITSM platform.
* Participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities as needed, providing incident trend data and operational risk inputs to support change impact assessment and scheduling decisions.

**ITSM Platform Administration & Reporting**

* Administer and maintain incident management workflows, categorization schemas, assignment group structures, escalation rules, and SLA configurations within the Government's ITSM platform (ServiceNow or equivalent) to ensure accurate and efficient incident processing.
* Develop, maintain, and deliver recurring incident management performance reports and dashboards, including metrics on incident volumes, SLA compliance rates, mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to resolve (MTTR), first-contact resolution rates, escalation rates, and incident trends by category and priority.
* Contribute incident management metrics and performance data to Sprint Review Reports, Monthly Status and Performance Reports, and the service-level/ITSM metrics dashboard submitted to the Government by the 5th business day of each month.
* Analyze incident data to identify trends, high-volume categories, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities, providing actionable recommendations to program leadership and the Service Management Lead.

**Knowledge Management**

* Oversee the development, review, and maintenance of incident-related knowledge base articles, resolution guides, troubleshooting procedures, and known error workarounds in the Government's ITSM knowledge management system.
* Ensure Tier 1 and Tier 2 Service Desk personnel have access to current, accurate, and actionable knowledge base content to support first-contact resolution objectives, targeting at least 70% of eligible tickets resolved at Tier 1.
* Promote a knowledge-sharing culture across the NOC and Service Desk, ensuring resolution documentation is captured at ticket closure and that institutional knowledge is preserved throughout personnel transitions.

**Agile Delivery Integration**

* Participate in Sprint ceremonies as required, including Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, and Sprint Retrospectives, contributing incident management workstream priorities, improvement backlog items, and operational performance data to the Sprint cadence.
* Maintain and manage incident management-related backlog items in the Government's Agile/ITSM tooling, ensuring items are accurately prioritized, estimated, and tracked to completion each Sprint.
* Identify and propose process improvement opportunities for inclusion in the program backlog, driving measurable enhancements to incident management efficiency, SLA performance, and customer satisfaction.

**Security & Compliance**

* Ensure all incident management activities comply with applicable Federal security, privacy, and compliance requirements, including FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, SBA IT and cybersecurity policies, and CUI safeguarding requirements.
* Ensure suspected or confirmed security incidents are promptly identified, escalated, and reported in accordance with SBA incident response procedures and applicable Federal reporting requirements.
* Support the application of least-privilege, separation-of-duties, and Zero Trust principles within incident management workflows and access control practices.

**Required**
**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field from an accredited college or university. Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT service management, with at least 3 years of dedicated experience in an Incident Manager, Major Incident Manager, or equivalent ITSM leadership role in an enterprise federal IT environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing the full incident lifecycle—including P1 major incident coordination—in a 24x7 enterprise IT operations environment of comparable scale and complexity.
* Demonstrated experience with ITIL-based ITSM practices, including incident management, problem management, change management, and knowledge management.
* Hands-on experience administering and managing incidents within an enterprise ITSM platform, preferably ServiceNow.
* Ability to obtain and maintain an SBA background investigation, HSPD-12 PIV credentials, and all required IT access authorizations prior to performing work requiring such access.

**Preferred**

* Prior experience supporting federal civilian agency IT operations programs.
* Experience supporting incident management within hybrid on-premises and cloud environments, including AWS and Microsoft Azure/365.
* Experience working within an Agile IT operations delivery model, integrating ITSM processes with Sprint-based planning and prioritization.

**Required Skills And Competencies**

* Exceptional communication skills in English—both written and oral—with the demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and concisely under time-critical conditions to diverse audiences including technical teams, program leadership, and senior Government stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead and coordinate cross-functional technical teams during high-pressure major incident events, driving rapid diagnosis and service restoration without direct authority over all participants.
* Deep knowledge of ITIL 4 incident management principles and practices, including incident classification, prioritization, escalation, SLA management, major incident management, and post-incident review processes.
* Hands-on proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms, particularly ServiceNow, including incident workflow configuration, queue management, SLA monitoring, escalation rule management, and reporting.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify incident trends, recurring patterns, and systemic issues from ITSM data and translate findings into actionable improvement recommendations.
* Experience developing and maintaining incident management performance dashboards and metrics reports, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance rates, first-contact resolution rates, and incident volume trends.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain a high-quality knowledge base, ensuring Tier 1 and Tier 2 Service Desk personnel have access to current, accurate resolution guidance.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure components relevant to incident management, including network, server, cloud (AWS/Azure), Microsoft 365, and enterprise application platforms.
* Familiarity with federal IT security and compliance requirements, including FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, Zero Trust Architecture principles, and CUI safeguarding requirements.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to simultaneously manage multiple open incidents at varying priority levels, maintaining accurate records and ensuring no incident falls through the cracks.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, and enterprise collaboration tools.

**Desired Skills And Competencies**

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification or higher (e.g., ITIL 4 Specialist: High Velocity IT, ITIL 4 Managing Professional).
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) – IT Service Management.
* Experience managing incidents within AWS commercial and/or GovCloud environments, including familiarity with AWS monitoring, alerting, and event management tooling.
* Experience managing Microsoft 365 and Azure Government-related incidents, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Entra identity incidents.
* Familiarity with enterprise network incident management, including LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, routing, switching, wireless, and network security fabric incidents.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring and event management platforms (e.g., SolarWinds, Splunk, Dynatrace, or equivalent) as they relate to automated incident detection and correlation.
* Knowledge of problem management and root cause analysis methodologies, including Fishbone/Ishikawa analysis, 5 Whys, and Kepner-Tregoe problem analysis.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and experience participating in Sprint ceremonies within an IT operations context.
* Experience supporting post-incident review (PIR) facilitation and corrective action tracking programs in a federal IT environment.
* CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or equivalent cybersecurity certification demonstrating knowledge appropriate to managing incidents involving Federal IT systems and sensitive data.
* Experience with HSPD-12/PIV credentialing processes and federal identity and access management platforms, including Okta and Microsoft Entra.
* Familiarity with Section 508 compliance requirements as they apply to ITSM reporting tools and knowledge management platforms.
* Experience contributing to continual service improvement programs within an ITIL-aligned, Agile IT operations environment.

Guided by our philosophy, the Blueprint of Simplicity, we design technology around real human behavior, connecting people, enabling financial access, and making everyday experiences effortless.
  
  
Our flagship platform, botim, is the region’s most trusted fintech communication platform, combining secure VoIP with action-based AI and everyday money tools.

* Report monthly to the VP Consumer Payments & Wealth on actuals vs budget, variance drivers, and corrective actions.
* Lead the Sales Manager – WPS and the sales and onboarding team (targets, performance, hiring, development), and represent WPS in Consumer Payments forums and SLT reviews.

**Requirements**

* 8+ years in payments, payroll, banking, or exchange house businesses in the UAE, with a track record of growing a B2B2C or payroll-linked product.
* Experience scaling a WPS, payroll card, or prepaid program at a bank, exchange house, or fintech.
* Strong network across UAE banks, financial institutions, exchange houses, and large and mid-size corporates.
* Strong commercial and financial skills: pricing, budgeting, unit economics, and cost-to-serve.
* Working knowledge of CBUAE and MOHRE WPS requirements and card scheme rules. Experience leading sales and onboarding teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Title: Restoration Manager
Description:
**RESTORATION MANAGER**

  
  

**About telMAX Inc.:**

  

Based in York Region, telMAX is a private equity-backed all fibre digital infrastructure platform that provides a 21st century alternative to traditional telecom networks. Recognized for four consecutive years as Canada’s Fastest ISP with an industry-leading net promoter score of over fifty, telMAX is continuing its rapid growth plan to bring its all-fibre network to residential and business customers across Southern Ontario.

  
  

**Your Position & How You Will Contribute:**

  

The Restoration Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all restoration activities associated with TelMAX’s Fibre-to-the-Home (FTTH) construction program. This role will have primary accountability for ensuring that all construction vendors complete required restoration work in a timely, safe, compliant, and high-quality manner across all build areas. The Restoration Manager will act as the primary point of contact for restoration activities, coordinating multiple vendors, tracking outstanding deficiencies, managing priorities, and working closely with Construction, Engineering, Municipal Relations, Quality, and other internal teams to ensure restoration requirements are completed and accepted. The successful candidate will be highly organized, field-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple vendors and competing priorities across a large geographic footprint.

  
  

**Responsibilities & Key Duties:**

  

Restoration Management

  

  
* Own the end-to-end restoration process for all FTTH construction areas.
  
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive inventory of outstanding restoration requirements by area, vendor, project, and municipality.
  
* Establish restoration priorities and drive vendors to complete work within required timelines.
  
* Ensure all restoration activities are completed in accordance with municipal standards, approved construction requirements, permits, and TelMAX standards.
  
* Monitor restoration progress from initial construction through final completion and municipal acceptance.
  
* Identify and escalate restoration risks, delays, deficiencies, and potential compliance issues.
  

  
  

Vendor Management

  

  
* Act as the primary point of contact for vendors responsible for restoration activities.
  
* Establish clear expectations, schedules, deliverables, and completion dates with each vendor.
  
* Hold vendors accountable for outstanding restoration work and deficiencies.
  
* Conduct regular vendor reviews and follow up on overdue or incomplete work.
  
* Coordinate additional resources or corrective action where vendors are unable to meet required timelines.
  
* Track vendor performance and identify recurring quality or performance issues.
  
* Support vendor performance management, including escalation of persistent non-performance to Construction leadership.
  

  
  

Field Coordination & Quality

  

  
* Conduct regular field inspections to verify that restoration work has been completed properly.
  
* Validate that restoration meets municipal, property, and TelMAX requirements.
  
* Coordinate the correction of deficient restoration work with vendors.
  
* Work with municipalities and inspectors to address restoration-related concerns and deficiencies.
  
* Ensure temporary restoration is transitioned to permanent restoration where required.
  
* Confirm that completed restoration is properly documented and ready for municipal inspection or acceptance.
  

  
  

Project Tracking & Reporting

  

  
* Maintain an accurate restoration dashboard showing:
    
    
  + Outstanding restoration items
    
  + Vendor assignments
    
  + Target completion dates
    
  + Aging of outstanding items
    
  + Deficiencies and rework
    
  + Municipal inspection status
    
  + Completed/closed restoration
  
* Provide regular reporting to Construction leadership on restoration progress, risks, and vendor performance.
  
* Establish KPIs and reporting mechanisms to measure restoration performance across the FTTH program.
  
* Identify trends and recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
  

  
  

Municipal & Stakeholder Coordination

  

  
* Work closely with Municipal Relations and Construction teams to understand municipal restoration requirements and deadlines.
  
* Support responses to municipal restoration complaints, deficiencies, and escalations.
  
* Coordinate vendor responses to municipal requirements and inspection findings.
  
* Help ensure restoration commitments made to municipalities are tracked and delivered.
  
* Support the resolution of property-owner restoration concerns where required.
  

  
  

Financial Management

  

  
* Monitor restoration costs and vendor spend against approved budgets.

Title: Assistant Claims Manager
Description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

As Assistant Claims Manager, you will lead the delivery of high-quality claims advisory and advocacy services across sensitive and complex medical and life claims. You will support clients and members through critical moments, guide a team of Claims Advisors, and work closely with insurers, third-party administrators and internal stakeholders to achieve fair, timely and effective outcomes.

The role combines hands-on case leadership, complaint resolution, client and insurer engagement, regulatory awareness and people management. You will also contribute to service improvement, technology enablement and the continued development of our claims value proposition.

  
  

**What you will do**

**Lead complex claims and case management**

* Review and provide direction on sensitive, denied, disputed and complex claims, including pre-authorisation escalations, VIP claims and matters escalated by clients or internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate medical evacuation and repatriation cases from initial escalation through resolution, maintaining clear communication with all parties.
* Lead case management for members with sensitive or high-cost conditions, including cancer, rare disorders and terminal illness; review utilisation, cost-containment needs and second medical opinion requirements.
* Provide practical resolution support to team members on denial disputes and complex coverage questions, advocating for outcomes that reflect client expectations and policy terms.
* Escalate emerging risks, disputes and complex cases promptly to the Head of Claims and senior management in line with agreed protocols.
  

  

**Resolve complaints and strengthen client confidence**

* Ensure complaints are fully investigated and responses clearly explain the cause, outcome and actions taken to prevent recurrence.
* Manage complaints that are not upheld by explaining findings, setting clear expectations and guiding members through the appropriate complaint route, including regulatory escalation where required.
* Maintain accurate complaint records in line with internal processes and applicable DHA requirements.
* Participate in client and insurer visits, including sensitive group renewal discussions where your claims expertise is required.
* Prepare quarterly service reports for key clients and provide clear updates on open cases, risks and actions.
  

  

**Build effective insurer and stakeholder relationships**

* Maintain trusted working relationships with insurers and third-party administrators, clearly communicating expectations and advocating for mutual clients.
* Engage with clients, colleagues, providers and insurers to progress complex cases and reach timely, well-supported decisions.
* Participate in periodic case review meetings and ensure actions are documented and closed within agreed timelines.
  

  

**Lead and develop the team**

* Implement team standards, claims procedures and best-practice controls across advisory and transactional claims activity.
* Allocate new accounts and workload, monitor capacity and oversee the smooth delivery of team operations across medical and life claims.
* Review claims files and deliverables to maintain quality, accuracy and service standards; monitor denied cases and cases approaching or exceeding turnaround time.
* Hold regular team and cross-functional meetings, summarise actions and follow through to closure.
* Mentor, coach and train direct reports on procedures, policies, claims practice and effective client interactions.
  

  

**Strengthen compliance, records and service improvement**

* Apply sound knowledge of DHA and DOH mandates, treatment guidelines, exclusions and regulatory updates, and translate relevant developments into practical team guidance.
* Protect confidential information by following data protection, encryption and clear-desk requirements; report and help prevent data incidents.
* Ensure claims, submissions, follow-ups, successes and appreciations are recorded accurately and in real time to support dashboards and management reporting.
* Support technology initiatives, proof-of-concept testing, change adoption, process improvement and appropriate use of AI to create capacity and enhance client service.
  

  

**Support embedded member services**

* Act as a trusted point of contact for members and client representatives under designated client programmes, including on-site support where agreed.
* Explain claims procedures, benefits, co-payments, provider access and approved support channels in clear, accessible language.
* Coordinate pre-authorisation, treatment requests, guarantee-of-payment requests, reimbursement queries, declined or suspended claims and reconsiderations through authorised channels.
* Track requests, missing information, ownership, ageing, escalation history and closure status, ensuring clear handovers and service updates.
  

  

**What you will bring**

* At least seven years of relevant experience in claims, healthcare benefits, insurance or a closely related environment.
* A bachelor’s degree in medicine or a related medical field.
* Experience leading and motivating diverse teams, including colleagues working remotely or across geographies.
* Strong knowledge of insurer claims processes, claims adjudication criteria, market developments and regulatory requirements.
* Proven claims advocacy, complaint resolution, crisis management, negotiation and client-management capability.
* Strong analytical, time-management, computer and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to interpret data and dashboards and turn insight into action.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the judgement and empathy to support members and clients through sensitive situations.
* A practical, improvement-oriented approach to technology, process change and service quality.
  

  

**Working arrangements**

This is a hybrid role with a typical expectation of three days per week in the office. Client-site attendance, working hours and backup arrangements will be agreed separately where the role requires embedded member support. The role carries a low or normal level of physical and mental risk.

Title: VP, Construction & ETO
Description:
**About Us**
Appficiency is a global technology and professional services firm that solves complex business challenges through the intelligent application of enterprise software, automation, and AI. We're a proud Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner; Salesforce Crest Partner; Microsoft Gold Certified Partner, and much more: our evolution has taken us well beyond a single platform, making us a multi-technology advisory and implementation partner across ERP, CRM, cloud platforms, and AI-driven solutions. What sets us apart is a "technical-first" approach, teams who understand both business logic and deep system architecture paired with a genuine belief that our people are our greatest strength, and that's who we invest in first.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As Vice President, AI & Multitech, you'll position yourself and your team as the technology leaders clients turn to across Appficiency's full platform portfolio - spanning ERP, CRM, AI, and beyond. This is a role built for someone who thinks in ecosystems, not single platforms: you'll build and coach a team fluent across multiple technologies, shape long-term account strategy in step with our sales targets, and push AI-driven delivery efficiency to new heights. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales to shape regional strategy, ensuring the team you build reflects where the business is headed next.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Own client health across the construction and ETO portfolio, building the kind of trust that keeps retention high in one of the firm's most demanding verticals
* Champion delivery excellence for construction and ETO engagements, ensuring every project lands within scope, on time, on budget, and to Appficiency's quality standard
* Cultivate deep, senior-level relationships with key stakeholders across your most strategic construction and ETO accounts
* Take direct ownership of reducing escalations - since this industry generates a disproportionate share of the firm's escalations today, this is one of the clearest measures of your impact
* Partner with the product team to shape a stronger, more tailored customer experience for construction and ETO clients
* Build a delivery organization with genuine credibility in front of construction and ETO clients, coaching your internal team and hiring externally to bring in the industry expertise clients expect
* Act as a true partner to the SOS team, giving them the delivery support and credibility they need to win and grow construction and ETO business
* Turn strong delivery into growth, supporting the conversion of implementation engagements into follow-on opportunities and referenceable relationships
* Manage your portfolio's profitability with the same discipline you bring to client satisfaction and escalation management

What You’ll Bring
  
  

* A blend of backgrounds: hands-on experience in construction, civil engineering, or ETO manufacturing, paired with time spent inside an IT or software company - you've operated credibly in both worlds, and that combination is non-negotiable for this role
* A degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical field is strongly preferred; an MBA or equivalent business degree is a plus
* Working fluency in construction-specific business processes - job costing, percentage-of-completion accounting, change order management, RFIs, submittals, and subcontractor/vendor management — and how they translate into ERP and project system requirements
* Exposure to construction-focused ERP/field platforms (e.g., Procore, Viewpoint/Vista, Sage 300 CRE, CMiC, Foundation) is a strong plus, alongside broader ERP/CRM experience such as NetSuite or Salesforce
* 10+ years in Professional Services or construction/ETO industry leadership, with 7-8 of those years in systems implementation, integration, or process re-engineering for construction or engineering-driven organizations
* A track record of managing distributed delivery teams across multiple regions on concurrent, complex projects
* Strong command of business analytics, BI, and financial performance management, including genuine fluency in reading and acting on job-cost reporting and P&L
* Willingness to travel up to 25% of your time, with flexibility for site visits and client needs

What Will Set You Apart
  
  

* A rare blend of construction industry experience and enterprise technology delivery background - you've credibly operated in both worlds, not just one
* A track record of reducing escalations and stabilizing delivery in complex, industry-specific engagements
* Strong executive presence with construction and ETO clients who expect a partner who understands their business, not just their software
* Experience partnering with product and sales teams to shape offerings and win business in a specialized vertical
* A reputation in the industry that opens doors - clients and prospects recognize your name before you walk into the room

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Escalations originating from construction and ETO accounts trend consistently downward under your leadership
* Your portfolio's false-start and early-termination rate holds well below the firm's threshold
* Clients recognize your delivery team as genuine construction and ETO experts, not generalists applying a standard playbook
* Sales consistently reports strong, proactive support from Delivery on construction and ETO opportunities, and the partnership shows up in win rates
* Your product feedback loop measurably improves the customer experience for construction and ETO clients over time

**Gestion des risques et analyse des causes fondamentales**

* Maintenir le registre RAID du programme et soutenir les processus de gouvernance des risques.

Title: Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director
Description:
**Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director - Digital Project Delivery**

**(This role can be based in any global Worley office)**

**About Worley**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets.

With more than 40,000 employees in over 40 countries, we specialise in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**The role**

Shape how the world's energy, chemicals and resources projects are built and brought to life. As our Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director, you'll lead the team that digitally enables successful Construction and Commissioning (C&C) delivery across Worley's global project portfolio.

**Why this role matters**

At Worley, digital enablement spans the full stack of people, process and technology a global EPC company needs. Reporting to the Global Head of Digital Project Delivery (DPD) and joining the DPD leadership team, you'll set the direction for C&C digitalisation and have the authority and autonomy to make it happen. You will own the strategy, technology and corresponding processes that help our project teams deliver better outcomes for our customers.

DPD is part of Digital Operations at Worley and exists to support Operations, so your work in this global role will have impact across the organisation.

This is where deep digital expertise meets senior leadership. Rather than writing code yourself, you'll set the technical direction and lead a talented team across multiple locations, bringing them together to turn that vision into results on our projects. You'll engage with functional representatives in Operations to ensure C&C project needs are understood and delivered.

Worley has placed Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) at the centre of project execution. A key part of this role is supporting the seamless digital enablement of AWP on projects. AI is also central to our digital strategy, and this role will help shape how we adopt AI across C&C delivery.

**What you will do**

* Set the strategy: Define the strategy for digital enablement of C&C as part of the wider DPD strategy, build the plans to deliver it, and develop strategic relationships with external technology partners that support our DPD ambition.
* Own the solution: Take ownership of the C&C technology stack, including tools, integrations, automation, AI, data management and reporting, across its full build-operate-support-retire lifecycle, partnering closely with other parts of the Worley digital team.
* Own the approach: Define the end-to-end C&C workflow for digitally enabled projects in collaboration with the project delivery function.
* Lead implementation: Drive adoption of the C&C digital way of working, collaborating with the DPD People and Processes team to ensure a consistent approach across project delivery.
* Enable our people: Contribute to organisational change management, define the digital competency requirements for project personnel, and support the governance framework that embeds the Worley digital approach.
* Deliver standout support: Build a support culture focused on keeping our people productive, using service metrics to drive continuous improvement.
* Lead and grow the team: Manage geographically dispersed direct and indirect reports, including subcontractors, and develop and manage the team budget in line with company delegation of authority requirements.

**What you will bring**

* Demonstrated experience in construction and commissioning.
* Strong digital execution expertise and AI capability.
* A proven record of directly leading and managing teams.
* A relevant university degree.
* Experience collaborating across teams to deliver practical solutions.
* Experience developing strategies, operating models and frameworks, with a track record of successfully implementing new ways of working.
* Experience with digital solutions on projects and awareness of software commonly used for C&C delivery. Knowledge of O3 is preferred.
* Thought leadership, with the ability to move between strategic and tactical thinking and work comfortably with new concepts and complexity.
* Strong relationship and influencing skills across all levels, cultures and external parties, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and facilitate discussions with large groups.

**What's in it for you**

* A senior leadership role on the DPD leadership team, with genuine authority and autonomy over C&C digitalisation.
* The opportunity to shape how digital technology is used to build and commission projects globally.
* The opportunity to build capability in deploying digital solutions across a large multinational organisation.
* Latitude to explore emerging C&C digital technologies with technology providers that could shape the future of project delivery at Worley.

***\*Applicants must possess valid working rights for the country in which the role will be based.***

You will be accountable for delivering a consistent, high-quality customer experience across direct and distributor markets, while improving operational performance, service revenue, organizational capability and customer loyalty.

You will have direct managerial accountability for the METER Field Service Engineer (FSE), Field Application Specialist (FAS) and Field IT organizations across both direct and indirect service models, together with Customer Service operations, training and relevant Data/IT service capabilities. You will lead the upcoming Service transformation in METER as part of the broader EMEA GO28 transformation, including the transition of the local Training Center into a Global Training Hub and its integration into the future Regional Support Center Hub model. You will drive the organizational readiness and change management required to ensure a successful implementation in METER.

**Your scope and accountability**

* Own the end-to-end Customer Service strategy, organization and performance for the METER cluster, covering Türkiye, Middle East and applicable export/distributor markets.
* Lead both direct and indirect service models, ensuring appropriate governance, capability and customer experience across subsidiaries and distributors.
* Ensure alignment with Global Customer Service strategy, standards, processes, quality requirements and digital transformation priorities.
* Directly manage the leaders and teams responsible for METER Field Service Engineering and Field Application across direct and indirect markets, with clear accountability for objectives, capacity, competence, execution quality and business impact.
* Contribute as a member of the METER leadership team and advise senior management on service risks, customer-impacting issues, investment priorities and growth opportunities.

* Conversational AI & Chatbots

+ Lead the design and delivery of Snoonu's multi-agent AI chatbot service for driver support across real-time chat channels.
+ Own the four-agent architecture — Coordinator, Data Collector, Rules Agent, and Action Executor — running on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar architecture.
+ Ensure chatbot flows handle driver intents reliably: order removal, vehicle mismatch, ETA extensions, merchant disputes, and escalations.
+ Drive LLM evaluation cycles, prompt strategy, and Bedrock Guardrail design to ensure responses are consistent, safe, and operationally correct.

* Integrate chatbot services with order management, CRM (Salesforce), Slack operations channels, and driver-facing apps via secure, event-driven patterns.
* Agentic AI & SOP Automation

+ Lead the buildout and operation of the SOPs-as-Code framework — encoding operational SOPs as machine-readable policies executed by the multi-agent system.
+ Own the Config File architecture and Config Reader Agent pipeline that converts PDFbased SOPs into deployable agent configurations on AWS Bedrock.
+ Govern the structured rules engine (condition/operator/value schema) to ensure deterministic, auditable decisions with no LLM interpretation ambiguity.
+ Design and enforce human-in-the-loop checkpoints, escalation triggers, confidence thresholds, and operator override capabilities.
+ Establish versioning, rollback, and safe deployment practices for SOP configuration changes in production.

* AWS Infrastructure & MLOps

+ Own the cloud backbone for AI services: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, MongoDB, S3, CloudWatch, and AWS Bedrock.
+ Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for prompt versioning, agent configuration rollout, and automated eval gates before production deployment.
+ Define observability standards — per-agent-turn latency SLAs, Bedrock cost tracking, drift detection, and failure alerting.
+ Lead capacity and cost planning as interaction volumes scale across driver and operations channels.

* R&D & Innovation

+ Evaluate frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet/Opus, open-weight models) and orchestration frameworks (Bedrock Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI) against Snoonu's operational constraints.
+ Identify and prototype the next AI capability Snoonu should dominate — from experiment to validated proof-of-concept with clear go/no-go criteria.
+ Produce architecture decision records, prompt engineering playbooks, and technical documentation for team-wide use

**🧙‍♂️ The Magic You Bring**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 6–10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a tech lead or engineering management role.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production conversational AI, IVR, or agentic systems end-to-end — not just models, but the full stack from architecture to monitoring. Portfolio, GitHub, or detailed case studies required.
* Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration on AWS Bedrock or equivalent agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen).
* Prior experience leading a team of 3–8 engineers, with a coaching-first approach to technical growth.
* Strong Python and backend development skills; able to write, review, and hold the bar on production-grade code.
* Engineering multiplier: makes every engineer on the team faster and better through design guidance, code reviews, and clear technical direction.
* Ownership without ego: defines problems, architects solutions, ships results — accountable for outcomes across the full platform, not just assigned tickets.
* Operational intelligence: understands the business context of driver support, logistics operations, and the real cost of failure in real-time systems.
* Senior communicator: articulates trade-offs (agent reliability vs. automation rate, cost vs. latency) clearly to non-engineers and influences roadmap decisions through clarity of thought.
* Structured under ambiguity: brings process and rigor to fast-moving R&D environments where requirements evolve alongside the build.
* Bias for action: prototypes fast, validates early, and ships iteratively — while maintaining the quality bars that prevent production incidents.
* Collaborative and direct: raises architectural risks early, pushes back on under-specified requirements, and surfaces trade-offs before they become delivery blockers.

**Conversational AI & LLMs (Core)**

* Deep experience with AWS Bedrock — Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, and model invocation; strong preference for Claude Sonnet/Opus via Bedrock.
* Multi-agent system design: orchestration patterns, agents-as-tools, inter-agent handoffs, context propagation, and failure isolation.
* Prompt engineering: system prompt design, structured output, tool-use, multi-turn reasoning, eval-driven iteration, and red-teaming for safety.
* Structured rules engines: condition/operator/value schemas for deterministic, noninterpretive decision logic — mandatory in production agentic systems.
