**AWS Services (Core)**

* Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch — event-driven and serverless architectures.
* AWS Bedrock Agents: agent creation, alias management, tool action group configuration, and Guardrail policy management.
* IAM, VPC, Secrets Manager — security and environment best practices for AI service deployments.
* CI/CD for AI services: prompt versioning, agent config deployment pipelines, automated evals, and rollback gates.

* MongoDB and DynamoDB — schema design, indexing, querying, and operational monitoring.
* Docker, ECS/Fargate; Git, automated testing, and CI/CD workflows.
* Salesforce integration (APIs, events, data sync) is a strong plus.

Title: Food Operations Manager
Description:
**About Foodsmart:**  
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  

**About the Role:**

As the Food Operations Manager, you'll be the face of Foodsmart's food operations to our health plan and payer clients, and the person who makes sure members get the right food, on time. You'll report to the Senior Director of Client Operations and help lead the team that runs our food benefit programs end to end.

Foodsmart’s food benefit programs connect clinical nutrition care to real food getting to members’ homes. That means working closely with health plan clients, food vendors, and our clinical teams, with data moving between all of them. You’ll own how that work runs day to day, make sure it works for members and clients, and dig into why when it doesn’t. This role suits someone who is confident with clients, rigorous about root causes, great at organizing complex processes, and comfortable with ambiguity in a growing, evolving program.

### **You will:**

* Design and own the workflows that run food operations, both internally and together with clients: define how food is assessed, approved, and shipped, explain why each step exists and what data we need from the client and what we provide, and secure client buy-in
* Bring internal teams together to follow those workflows consistently, and organize and standardize processes and SOPs across the food operations team
* Oversee the flow from clinician assessment through payer approval to vendor fulfillment, and make sure every handoff works
* Coordinate with our multiple food vendors and operationalize processes across all of them, holding them to service and quality standards
* Lead vendor change management: when something changes, such as a file design, get buy-in from every vendor, explain what is happening, and coordinate timing with them before implementing
* Partner with Product and Engineering to troubleshoot and implement our new food benefit management (FBM) system, including testing, rollout, and team training
* Manage data exchanges with clients and vendors, including SFTP file transfers and file design, and resolve data quality issues
* Serve as a client-facing lead for food operations, speaking with payer and health plan clients about incidents, program performance, and escalations with confidence and clarity
* Manage and resolve escalations from clients, vendors, and internal teams, and keep everyone updated until each one is closed
* Run root cause analysis when food doesn't ship correctly, and drive the fixes that keep it from happening again
* Dig into operational data in Excel to find out what's going on, and build reports for the team, clients, and business reviews
* Lead and develop the food operations team, balance workload among team members, and manage internal escalations
* Flag risks, trends, and client feedback to leadership so we can improve our programs

### **You are:**

* Able to design a workflow and explain it clearly to a client: what the workflow is, why it works the way it does, what data we need from them, and what data we will provide in return
* Someone who can get internal teams to adopt and follow new processes, working well with Product, Engineering, clinical, and vendor teams and winning buy-in from people who don't report to you
* Highly organized and a true project manager, capable of bringing structure to messy processes and making them repeatable
* Confident and polished with clients, and comfortable owning a conversation about an incident or escalation
* Curious and rigorous, and keep digging into the data until you find the root cause
* Committed to following through and responding on time
* A manager who can lead with fairness and empathy while keeping workloads balanced across a team
* Interested in our mission to expand access to nutritious food for underserved communities
* Motivated to set clear success metrics and the plan to achieve them
* Collaborative, positive, and easy to partner with

### **You have:**

* Bachelor's degree, or higher
* 6-8+ years of experience in operations, client or account management, or program management, ideally in healthcare, health tech, or fulfillment and logistics
* 2+ years of experience managing a leading a team
* Experience handling client escalations and incidents, including root cause analysis
* Experience designing workflows and standardizing processes
* Basic understanding Knowledge of data exchanges, including SFTP and file design, and experience working with product and engineering teams
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, such as pivot tables and lookups, and experience building reports from raw data
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience implementing or testing a new software system is a plus
* Experience with food benefits, SNAP/EBT, or grocery and meal fulfillment is a plus
* Familiarity with healthcare payers, such as Medicaid or Medicare Advantage plans, is a plus

Title: U Health Food & Beverage Manager

You will lead and mentor the F B crew to ensure that every member experience, from order to delivery, exceeds expectations. This includes upholding our service standards, ensuring team members are well-trained, managing scheduling and operations, and taking action to resolve service gaps.

**3. Manage all F B operational aspects, from inventory control to financial performance.**  
You will manage the ordering, stock levels, portion control, and pricing of food and beverages to ensure cost-effective operations. Additionally, you’ll manage the P L for the F B department, drive revenue growth through menu innovations and promotions, and ensure financial targets are consistently met.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Develop and manage the F B menu and product offering.**  
Curate a wellness-focused menu that reflects Virgin Active’s commitment to holistic health, offering nutritious, delicious, and member-friendly food and beverage options. Regularly review and update the menu to keep it relevant and exciting, considering seasonal trends, dietary needs, and member preferences.

**2. Oversee F B operations to ensure consistent quality, hygiene, and service standards.**  
Ensure all food and beverage offerings meet Virgin Active’s high standards for quality, presentation, and safety. This includes managing compliance with food safety regulations, overseeing cleanliness, and ensuring portioning and stock rotation practices are consistently followed.

**3. Lead, train, and develop the F B team.**  
Hire, onboard, and train staff, ensuring they understand and deliver on the brand’s customer service expectations. Provide coaching and mentoring to develop their skills, encourage team collaboration, and maintain high morale in the F B space.

**4. Ensure accurate inventory management, stock control, and cost management.**  
Regularly monitor stock levels, manage orders and deliveries, ensure products are stored properly, and perform stock audits. Manage food cost variances and operational costs to maximize profitability, while maintaining high-quality service standards.

**5. Create and execute sales and marketing initiatives to drive F B engagement.**  
Collaborate with the marketing and events teams to plan and execute promotional activities and events that align with Virgin Active’s wellness philosophy. These could include wellness-focused dining events, special offers, member events, and seasonal promotions that drive foot traffic and sales.

**6. Monitor and evaluate F B financial performance.**  
Track key financial metrics for the F B department, including sales performance, margins, and operational expenses. Work to continually optimize profitability, manage food cost fluctuations, and identify opportunities for growth and revenue generation.

**Key performance indicators**

**1. Food and beverage revenue:** Achieve or exceed sales targets for the F B department, with a focus on profitability and growth.

**2. Member satisfaction and service standards:** High satisfaction ratings for food quality, service, and overall dining experience.

**3. Operational efficiency and cost control:** Achieve target food cost percentage, maintain inventory levels, and minimize wastage while ensuring high operational standards.

**Expectations and Standards**

As a Virgin Active team member, you are expected to:

**1. Embody Virgin Values:** Demonstrate our core values in all interactions with members, colleagues, and stakeholders. Lead by example and be a role model for the Virgin Active ethos.

**2. Demonstrate the Skills Competencies**: Consistently apply the key skills competencies outlined. These competencies are fundamental to your success and to delivering exceptional member experiences.

**3. Safety First**: Ensure that the safety and well-being of our members, guests, and team are always a top priority. Follow all health, safety, and wellness protocols, including emergency procedures, to create a safe and welcoming environment. Regularly assess and mitigate risks to maintain a secure environment for all.

**4. Deliver Our Brand Standards:** Uphold and deliver Virgin Active’s high brand standards in every aspect of your work. From member interactions to facility maintenance and service delivery, ensure that every experience reflects our commitment to luxury, excellence, and holistic wellness. Your role is key in maintaining our reputation as a premium wellness brand.

**5. Collaborate Effectively**: Work closely with your colleagues and other departments to ensure seamless operations and a positive experience for both members and staff. Foster a team-oriented environment where open communication, mutual support, and collaboration are at the forefront of achieving collective goals.

Description:

The Sr. Strategy and Programs Manager, FWA HSI Local Marketing Activation is the connection between FWA High Speed Internet local marketing strategy and what happens in market. This role owns how local marketing gets activated for FWA HSI: partnering with the HSI acquisition team to identify opportunities and priorities, deciding where, why, and how to activate, designing the programs that do it, and enabling the field to run those programs with confidence.
  
  
The role works where network capacity and demand are out of balance. That includes High Supply and Low Demand markets, where available capacity isn’t converting into activations, and markets where churn and disconnects are eroding growth. This person turns market-level data into targeted local programs, runs them, measures them, and scales what works.
  
  
This is not a project coordinator role. This person builds the activation programs, owns their delivery, and is accountable for whether they drive new accounts and retention in market.
  
  
This is a remote role. Travel expectation is up to 30% nationally, covering market visits, National Marketing engagements, planning sessions, and team collaboration. The best activation programs are designed by people who spend time in the markets they are building.
  
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Activation Strategy & Program Design**

* Own the activation approach. Develop the framework for how FWA HSI local marketing gets activated: which markets, which audiences, which tactics, in what sequence, and what principles guide local decisions.
* Lead High Supply and Low Demand programs. Combine network capacity data with local marketing levers to build programs that convert available capacity into activation and define when a geography qualifies.
* Build complete program designs. Every program should have a clear objective, target audience, channel mix, offer and messaging direction, timeline, budget, and success metric, with rationale for each choice.
* Develop retention-oriented programs. Partner with the disconnect and churn effort to design local programs that reduce HSI churn, not just drive new orders.
* Close the gaps. Identify moments where the organization lacks a proven tactic or a defined approach for FWA HSI, and build the solution instead of flagging it for someone else.

**Program Execution & Field Enablement**

* Run the programs. Own program management from design through launch and close-out: timelines, dependencies, vendors, budgets, and cross-functional deliverables.
* Enable the field. Give the field everything it needs to execute: program briefs, targeting lists, messaging guidance, creative assets, and clear success criteria.
* Sequence the rollout. Pilot first, then scale in phases, tied to the commercial calendar and to the team’s 2027 expansion into HSI.
* Make it stick. Partner with the Hyperlocal Playbook Manager so proven programs are captured in the playbook as operating standards.

**Measurement & Test-and-Learn**

* Design the tests. Build test-and-control structures for local programs so the team can separate real lift from noise.
* Target with data. Use propensity and segmentation analysis to choose and size markets and opportunity.
* Report what works. Produce clear readouts on incremental new accounts, churn impact, cost per acquisition, and program ROI, and recommend scale, adjust, or stop.
* Close the loop. Run a retrospective at the end of each program and each quarter: what the program produced, where execution diverged from the plan, and what changes next.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with National Marketing. Pull national campaigns, brand guardrails, and creative into field-ready formats, and push field learnings back up so what gets built centrally serves local needs.
* Partner with HSI Acquisition team to identify commercial opportunities and priorities for hyperlocal marketing campaigns
* Partner with Network and Capacity Planning. Get timely, usable capacity data so programs target the right markets at the right time.
* Partner with Analytics and Sales Operations. Align on data, measurement, and incentives so programs are measurable and the frontline is incented to action off of them.
* Coordinate with the Fiber team. Manage the places where FWA and fiber overlap, including footprint eligibility changes and creating an ecosystem accounting for customer moves from HSI to fiber.
* Steward the brand. Ensure local activity stays within T-Mobile brand guardrails while remaining locally effective.

**Quarterly Planning & Field Intelligence**

* Contribute to the planning cycle. Translate commercial targets, capacity conditions, and national priorities into a 90-day activation program plan with market-by-market priorities.
* Synthesize the signal. Aggregate market observations, competitive activity, and program performance into insights that inform local decisions and national direction.
* Find the pattern. Identify which market conditions, audiences, and tactic combinations are producing results and what the team should do more of.
* Brief leadership. Produce a regular update for the Sr. Manager and Director on what’s working, what isn’t, and what the field needs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree and 7 years of related work experience, or a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
* 7-10 years in marketing strategy, field marketing, growth marketing, or program management, with demonstrated ownership of programs from design through measurement.
* Strong analytical skills, including campaign measurement, segmentation, and test-and-control design.
* Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and no direct authority.
* Experience translating strategy into field-executable programs that people actually use.
* Strong written and verbal communicator who can brief the field, partner teams, and senior leaders.
* Comfortable operating without complete information and adjusting quickly when results come in.

  + Demonstrated and proven proficiency and impact in marketing communications and content planning, execution, analytics and measurement; social media leadership; events and brand experience planning and execution; integrated campaigns; email; web; etc.
  + Demonstrated leadership, reliability and flexibility
  + Excellent organizational, communications (verbal/written), interpersonal and creative problem-solving skills
  + Ability to work in a high pressure, deadline driven environment where juggling multiple projects, deadlines, and last-minute changes are commonplace
  + Exceptionally high level of judgement and skill for providing strategic input/guidance and ensuring items are error-free
  + Demonstrated ability to handle multiple priorities and be self-motivated in a high pressure, fast paced and demanding work environment
  + Collaborative team player with ability to tackle challenges in a creative, positive, and engaging manner

  + Previous experience working or volunteering for a not-for-profit organization preferred
  + Previous experience working in a fundraising environment desirable
  + Experience working in health care communications an asset

Title: Group Procurement Director
Description:
Millennium & Copthorne Hotels Middle East & Africa is seeking an accomplished **Group Procurement Director** to lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive, group-wide strategic procurement function across our portfolio of operating hotels.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for a commercially driven professional capable of transforming a decentralized purchasing environment into a coordinated, efficient, and value-generating procurement organization.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of establishing procurement strategies, policies, governance frameworks, and sourcing capabilities across complex organizations comprising multiple operating entities.

**Key Job Responsibilities:**

**1. Procurement Strategy & Organization**

* Design and implement a group-wide procurement strategy, operating model, and governance framework.
* Establish procurement policies, procedures, approval authorities, and compliance standards across the hotel portfolio.
* Define the optimal balance between centralized strategic sourcing and decentralized operational purchasing.

**2. Group Synergies & Value Creation**

* Identify and capture procurement synergies, economies of scale, and consolidation opportunities across multiple properties and geographies.
* Develop category management strategies, group purchasing agreements, and preferred supplier frameworks.
* Deliver measurable cost efficiencies while maintaining operational quality, service standards, and business continuity.

**3. Supplier & Contract Management**

* Lead strategic supplier selection, negotiations, contracting, and performance management.
* Establish long-term partnerships with key suppliers and develop regional and international sourcing opportunities.
* Implement robust supplier evaluation, risk management, and contractual governance processes.

**4. Performance, Technology & Transformation**

* Introduce procurement performance indicators, spend analytics, reporting dashboards, and savings measurement methodologies.
* Drive procurement digitalization, including appropriate e-procurement platforms and purchasing systems.
* Build a culture of procurement excellence, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**5. Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership**

* Partner closely with hotel General Managers, Finance Directors, operational teams, and corporate leadership.
* Engage constructively with hotel owners and stakeholders to align procurement initiatives with property-level requirements and ownership structures.
* Build and lead a high-performing procurement organization capable of supporting a geographically diversified portfolio.

**The ideal candidate:**

* 15+ years of professional experience, including significant leadership responsibilities in strategic procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management.
* Demonstrated success in designing, establishing, and scaling centralized or coordinated procurement functions across large, decentralized, multi-entity organizations.
* Strong experience in category management, strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, procurement governance, and cost optimization.
* Proven ability to generate measurable financial benefits through procurement consolidation and organizational transformation.
* Experience in hospitality, retail, food & beverage, travel retail, or other multi-site service industries. Hospitality experience is advantageous but not essential.
* Strong commercial acumen, financial understanding, analytical capabilities, and technology orientation.
* Excellent leadership, influencing, and change-management skills, with the ability to drive alignment across independently managed operating entities.
* Preferably currently based in the UAE or wider GCC, with relevant regional market knowledge and supplier networks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related discipline; relevant postgraduate qualifications or professional certifications are advantageous.

**Why join us?**

This position offers the opportunity to **build and shape a strategic procurement function at group level**, with direct influence on operational performance, profitability, and long-term value creation.

Reporting to the Chief Performance Officer, the Group Procurement Director will play a central role in strengthening the operational excellence and competitiveness of Millennium & Copthorne Hotels across the Middle East and Africa.

We welcome applications from accomplished procurement leaders across industries who have demonstrated the ability to create scalable, high-performing procurement organizations.

**If you have built procurement capabilities across complex, multi-site businesses and are ready to make a tangible impact at regional level, we would welcome your interest.**

Title: Property Manager (Mississauga)
Description:
**About Icon Property Management**

Join a company that’s redefining condominium management in Ontario. ICON Property Management is an ACMO 2000 Certified firm with more than 30 years of experience serving high-rise, mid-rise, low-rise, and townhouse communities across the GTA and Southwestern Ontario.

At ICON, our people are our greatest strength. We provide the tools, training, and technology you need to succeed, along with a supportive team culture that values collaboration, professionalism, and growth. If you’re looking to build a rewarding career with a respected and forward-thinking management firm, ICON is the place to be.

**About the role**

As a Property Manager at ICON Property Management, you will be the primary on-site representative for a residential condominium community, ensuring the smooth delivery of day-to-day operations. Reporting to the Regional Director, you will work closely with the board of directors, residents, contractors, and internal departments to maintain an organized, compliant, and well-run community.

You’ll be responsible for implementing board-approved decisions, overseeing maintenance and service contracts, managing budgets, supervising on-site staff, and ensuring compliance with all legislative and corporate standards. This role requires strong leadership, organization, and communication skills, as well as a proactive approach to problem-solving.

At ICON, we value professionalism, collaboration, and excellence in service. If you take pride in building positive relationships, providing sound guidance to boards, and creating communities residents are proud to call home, we’d love to hear from you.

**What you'll do**

Responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to the following:

*Client Relations*

* Serve as the primary point of contact to resolve resident inquiries and concerns in a timely and professional manner.
* Provide prompt, courteous, and solution-focused responses to all communications.
* Schedule, attend, and actively participate in board meetings, providing insights and updates on property management matters.
* Attend and contribute to committee meetings, as requested.
* Foster a strong, productive relationship between the board of directors, residents, contractors, and site staff.
* Ensure compliance with the Declaration, Bylaws, and Rules of the corporation.
* + Assist with the planning and organization of community events to enhance resident engagement.

*Financial Management*

* Prepare, implement, and manage operating and reserve fund budgets in alignment with the corporation’s annual budget and legislative obligations.
* Monitor and evaluate expenditures to ensure cost effectiveness and compliance with board-approved budgets.
* Collaborate with the property accountant and Senior Director of Accounting to manage cash flow and investments for long-term financial sustainability.
* Code and approve accounts payable invoices, ensuring appropriate backup documentation is provided for audit and recordkeeping purposes.
* Monitor common element fee payments and lead arrears collection efforts in accordance with the Condominium Act and the corporation’s collection policy.
* Ensure timely submission and accuracy of financial documentation in accordance with internal controls and regulatory standards.
* Prepare supporting documentation for the corporation’s annual audit, working collaboratively with auditors and the accounting team to address requests and ensure transparency.
* Update banking authorities and oversee financial processes to ensure accuracy, transparency, and efficiency.

*Building Operations*

* Enforce cleanliness, security and safety standards throughout the condominium corporation.
* Conduct regular inspections of the common elements, ensuring timely follow-up on any outstanding issues.
* Review and optimize building systems for energy efficiency and cost-effectiveness.
* Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with contract terms and quality standards.
* Maintain, communicate, and enforce the corporation’s emergency procedures.
* Develop and execute a comprehensive annual maintenance plan to manage short- and long-term building upkeep.

*Team Management*

* Collaborate with the Regional Director to establish site goals and communicate them effectively to the site team.
* Lead, mentor, and support on-site staff to promote a positive and service-oriented workplace culture.
* Address employee concerns and resolve conflicts with professionalism and fairness.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, performance feedback sessions and assign stretch assignments to encourage employee development.
* Oversee staffing needs, including recruitment, training, and succession planning.
* Facilitate regular team meetings to encourage proactive communication, team buy-in and alignment.

*Contract Management*

* Define the scope of work for regular contractors, ensuring clarity and alignment with the corporation’s needs.
* Review contractor specifications and tenders, presenting summaries and recommendations to the board of directors.
* Lead contract negotiations, securing favorable terms while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee contract execution and address service deficiencies or warranty issues as needed.
* Ensure that contractor performance aligns with applicable codes, health and safety standards, and corporate expectations.

*Administrative Services*

* Ensure that all administrative requirements of the property are completed in an organized, timely, and professional manner.
* Lead the tendering and negotiation of condominium insurance coverage, managing the administration of any claims that arise.
* Maintain the corporation’s records in accordance with the Condominium Act, 1998, including owner registers, meeting minutes, governing documents, and correspondence.
* Prepare and distribute Annual General Meeting (AGM) packages, owner meeting notices, budget packages, and Information Certificate packages (PICs and NOICs) in compliance with legislative timelines.
* Coordinate all logistical arrangements for AGMs and owner meetings, including scheduling, venue setup (virtual or in-person), notices, proxies, and minute-taking support.
* Enforce and support adherence to internal policies and procedures to promote consistency and compliance.
* Provide vacation relief and administrative coverage at other ICON-managed condominium sites, based on operational requirements and under the direction of senior management.

*Compliance & Regulatory Oversight*

* Ensure the corporation’s full compliance with all applicable federal, provincial, and municipal legislation, regulations, and codes governing condominium operations, health and safety, accessibility, and residential property management.
* Maintain compliance with the Ontario Fire Code by ensuring life safety systems are tested and inspected as required, and that an up-to-date, approved Fire Safety Plan is implemented and communicated to staff and residents.
* Monitor and enforce compliance with all applicable municipal bylaws, including those related to property standards, noise, short-term rentals, parking, and waste management.
* Ensure all required records, including governing documents, financial statements, minutes, and owner notices, are properly maintained in accordance with Condominium Act and CMRAO regulations.
* Ensure full compliance with CMRAO licensing requirements and Code of Ethics when providing condominium management services on behalf of the licensed provider.
* Oversee the preparation and submission of annual filings, assessments, and notices to the Condominium Authority of Ontario (CAO).
* Implement and monitor compliance with AODA standards and workplace safety protocols under the Occupational Health and Safety Act.
* Stay informed of legislative and regulatory changes and ensure that site staff and board members are advised of necessary updates to procedures and policies.

**Qualifications**

* General License in good standing with the Condominium Management Regulatory Authority of Ontario (CMRAO).
* Post-secondary education in business administration, real estate, or a related discipline is preferred.
* 3-5 years of experience managing residential condominium communities as a property manager.
* Strong understanding of the Condominium Act, Condominium Management Services Act, CMRAO regulations, and the Condominium Authority Tribunal (CAT) process.
* Demonstrated diplomacy, professionalism, and customer service excellence when supporting residents, board members, and contractors.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Strong command of physical building operations, maintenance planning, and core building systems.
* Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to liaise effectively with multiple stakeholders including board members, residents, and contractors.
* Principled approach with the ability to take direction from the board of directors and appointed officers while maintaining sound judgment and integrity.
* Strong financial planning and project management skills with proven experience in budgeting and forecasting.
* Demonstrated diplomacy, patience, and professionalism when managing sensitive or complex situations.
* Excellent time management and organizational abilities with attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) and familiarity with condominium management platforms.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment with a high level of accountability.

**Working Condition**s

* The role is based on-site within a condominium community, with standard office hours (Monday-Friday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM). Remote work options are not available.
* Must be available to respond to after-hours emergencies and attend evening Board or Owner meetings.
* Regular interaction with residents, trades, consultants, and board members is expected.
* Work environment includes a combination of office duties and occasional exposure to construction or building maintenance conditions.

We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our clients and the communities in which we serve. If you require an accommodation for the recruitment/ interview process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs*.

Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy), age, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, parental status, ancestry, disability, gender identity, veteran status, genetic information, other distinguishing characteristics of diversity and inclusion, or any other protected status.*

85,000 - 95,000 CAD per year(Mississauga)

Title: Restaurant Technology Manager
Description:
**Location - Al Rayyan Tower, Al Nahda, Sharjah**

**Job Purpose:**

The Restaurant Technology Manager – UAE is the single point of accountability for all restaurant technology across the UAE market, reporting directly to the Global Head of Technology Operations. The role leads the delivery, support and continuous improvement of all in-store and guest-facing technology across brands, including POS/MIS, BSP, Digital, ALMP, Kiosk, Digital Menu Boards, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, as well as store networks, Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals. The role also manages the restaurant technology vendor portfolio end to end, including contracts, SLAs, service reviews, billing and invoice validation, and payment tracking with Finance and Procurement. By maximizing restaurant uptime, enabling fast incident resolution and ensuring accurate, cost-effective technology spend, the role protects restaurant sales and guest experience while supporting growth and digital ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Restaurant Technology Ownership:**
  Own the end-to-end management of all restaurant technology components in the UAE – POS / MIS, BSP, Digital ordering, ALMP, Kiosk, DMB, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, store network / Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals – ensuring stable, secure and standardised operation across all brands.
* **Service Operations & Incident Management:**
  Lead the UAE restaurant technology support team; define, implement and continually improve incident, problem, request and change management processes in line with ITIL and ATO standards.
* **Escalation & Major Incident Management:**
  Act as the escalation point for UAE restaurant operations both in and out of hours; lead major incidents, stakeholder communication and root cause analysis (RCA).
* **Vendor Management:**
  Manage all UAE restaurant technology vendors and service providers (POS / hardware, kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, network / telecom, payment, aggregator integration, field service): onboarding, SOWs, SLA governance, monthly service reviews, vendor scorecards, penalties / service credits and renewals, in coordination with Procurement and Legal.
* **Vendor Billing & Invoice Validation:**
  Validate every vendor invoice before approval against contract rates, POs, SOWs, asset / license / site counts, delivered services, GRNs and SLA performance; identify and recover over-billing, duplicate charges and unapplied credits.
* **Vendor Payment Validation & Tracking:**
  Validate and track vendor payments with Finance / Accounts Payable; maintain the vendor payment and accruals tracker, ensure payments are released on time and only for accepted deliverables, and resolve vendor payment disputes.
* **Budget & Cost Management:**
  Prepare and manage the UAE restaurant technology opex and capex budget; track actuals vs budget and forecast; drive cost optimisation across licenses, maintenance contracts, telecom and hardware.
* **New Store Openings, Remodels & Rollouts:**
  Deliver restaurant technology for new store openings, remodels, relocations and closures, and lead UAE rollouts of new technology (kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital) on time, on budget and to standard.
* **Asset & License Management:**
  Maintain an accurate register of restaurant hardware, software licenses and spares; plan lifecycle refresh and manage the spares pool.
* **Information Security & Compliance:**
  Ensure restaurant technology complies with Americana IT security policies, PCI-DSS for card payments and UAE regulatory requirements, including patching, endpoint protection and access control.
* **Stakeholder Management & Reporting:**
  Partner with UAE Operations, Brands, Marketing, Digital, Finance and Procurement; provide monthly service, vendor and spend performance reporting to the Global Head of Technology Operations; keep SOPs, KEDB, network diagrams and the vendor contract register up to date.
* **People Leadership:**
  Lead, coach and develop the team; set objectives, run mid-year and annual reviews, build individual development and succession plans, and manage shift and on-call rosters.
* **Other Duties:**
  Undertake other duties as assigned by the Global Head of Technology Operations.

**Qualification: -**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Master’s degree / MBA is preferred.
* ITIL v4 Foundation (or higher) certification required; PMP / PRINCE2 preferred.

**Experience: -**

* 10+ years of IT experience, including at least 5 years in a managerial role in restaurant, QSR, hospitality or retail technology.
* Excellent knowledge of restaurant technology systems and infrastructure – POS (NCR / Oracle an advantage), kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital ordering, loyalty and aggregator integrations.
* Must have delivered and supported solutions for an estate of 150+ stores; UAE / GCC experience strongly preferred.
* Proven vendor management experience, including contract and SLA management, vendor billing / invoice validation and payment reconciliation.
* Experience owning an IT opex / capex budget and reporting actuals vs budget.
* Has been through or led significant change within a restaurant or retail technology environment.

**Job Specific Skills:**

* ITIL service management – incident, problem, change and request management.
* Strong vendor and contract management, negotiation and commercial acumen.
* Invoice, billing and payment validation; financial controls, accruals and reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of retail networks, payment security (PCI-DSS) and endpoint management.
* ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow) and reporting / analytics (Excel, Power BI)
* Project and rollout management for multi-site deployments.

**Major Challenges:**

* 24/7 restaurant operations with late-night and delivery trading; on-call and out-of-hours escalations are part of the role.
* Large multi-brand estate across all Emirates with differing technology stacks, channels (dine-in, drive-thru, kiosk, delivery, aggregators) and brand requirements.
* Managing many vendors with different SLAs, contract and billing models; ensuring every invoice reflects contracted rates and delivered service, and resolving billing and payment disputes without disrupting restaurant service.
* Balancing cost control and budget discipline with restaurant uptime and guest experience; dependencies on third-party platforms (aggregators, payment providers, telecom) outside direct control.
* Fast new-store and rollout pipeline with tight, fixed opening dates.
* Frequent travel to restaurants across the UAE.

**Leadership Traits:**

* Business Succession Planning
* Business Acumen
* Entrepreneurship
* Budgets and Financial Reports
* Crisis Management

With a rapidly growing presence across international airports and partnerships with leading duty-free operators, the successful candidate will play a central role in managing day-to-day commercial activities, coordinating with retail partners, and ensuring the effective execution of GTI's commercial and marketing initiatives across the channel.

The position requires strong account management, analytical, and coordination capabilities, with the ability to independently manage multiple accounts and projects across different markets.

The Travel Retail Executive will serve as the primary operational point of contact between GTI, its duty-free partners, and internal departments, ensuring commercial plans are translated into measurable results.

**Travel Retail Account Management:**

* Manage day-to-day commercial relationships and operational communication with existing duty-free operators.

* Maintain regular communication with duty-free operators to review sales performance, stock availability, product assortment, and ongoing commercial activities.
* Monitor the implementation of agreed commercial terms, including pricing, margins, listing fees, promotional commitments, and payment conditions.
* Maintain an updated database of accounts, airports, retail locations, contacts, commercial agreements, and key account requirements.
* Support management in preparing business reviews and identifying opportunities to improve account performance.

**Sales Performance, Reporting & Analysis:**

* Collect, consolidate, and analyse periodic sales reports from duty-free operators, with visibility by airport, terminal, shop, brand, and SKU wherever available.

Title: Senior Manager, Retail Segmentation Program - 18 Month Term
Flight Safety Manager
Description:
**Job Description:**

**This Is How We Fly**
----------------------

At JSX, we’re not just a lifestyle carrier – we’re a lifestyle employer. Here, entrepreneurship meets determination, and excellence is our standard. We believe that the journey is just as important as the destination, and every day, we strive to create a Joyful, Simple eXperience for our Customers. Join us, and find your runway to growth, innovation, and success.

  

**About the Role**
------------------

The Flight Safety Manager is responsible for developing, administering, and continuously improving JSX's flight safety initiatives, with a focus on identifying, evaluating, and mitigating risks associated with flight operations.

  

In this role, you'll oversee the Flight Operational Quality Assurance (FOQA) program, using flight data to identify operational trends, emerging hazards, and opportunities to strengthen safety performance. You'll translate complex information into actionable recommendations that support risk-informed decisions and proactive operational improvements.

  

You'll also manage flight irregularity reporting, maintain safety databases, participate in incident investigations, and prepare reports and presentations that provide visibility into flight safety performance. Working closely with Flight Operations, Training, Maintenance, and other departments, you'll help ensure safety concerns are appropriately evaluated and addressed.

  

As a key connection between flight operations and JSX's Safety Management System (SMS), you'll support the consistent application of established safety processes, promote meaningful operational engagement, and help foster a culture of proactive risk identification and continuous improvement.

  

This is an opportunity for an aviation safety professional who combines analytical thinking, operational knowledge, and sound judgment with a commitment to protecting people and strengthening aviation safety.

  

**A Day in the Life**
---------------------

In this role, you'll:

  

**Flight Safety Program Management**

* Develop, administer, and continuously improve flight safety initiatives that support safe and reliable operations.
* Manage the Flight Irregularities Program, including coordinating follow-up communications with Flight Crewmembers after reported events or incidents.
* Review Pilot Debriefs and other operational reports to identify safety concerns, emerging trends, and opportunities for improvement.
* Prepare and distribute preliminary event reports to appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate and organized Flight Safety and Flight Mechanical databases.
* Evaluate existing safety programs, policies, and procedures to identify opportunities for improved effectiveness.
Support the implementation of safety recommendations and monitor progress toward established objectives.  

  

**Flight Operational Quality Assurance (FOQA)**

* Oversee the administration, monitoring, and ongoing improvement of JSX's FOQA program.
* Analyze flight operational data to identify trends, potential hazards, and areas of increased operational risk.
* Review FOQA findings and translate data-driven insights into practical safety recommendations.
* Coordinate FOQA-related communications and collaborate with operational stakeholders to support program objectives.
* Partner with Flight Operations, Training, and Maintenance to evaluate findings and identify opportunities for risk reduction.
* Support the integration of FOQA insights into broader safety initiatives and established SMS processes.
Monitor recurring operational trends and recommend proactive measures to improve flight safety performance.  

  

**Safety Investigations & Risk Management**

* Participate in investigations of aviation safety events and incidents reported by Crewmembers.
* Conduct root cause analyses to identify contributing factors and recommend appropriate corrective or preventive actions.
* Evaluate safety-related information to identify operational hazards and potential areas of risk.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to assess findings and develop practical risk mitigation strategies.
* Support the documentation, communication, and evaluation of flight operational risks through JSX's Safety Management System.
* Assist with Emergency Response activities and other assigned safety programs.
Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying lessons learned from safety events, investigations, and operational data.  

  

**Safety Reporting & Data Analysis**

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and annual flight safety reports, analyses, and program summaries.
* Develop presentations and supporting materials for safety working groups, operational stakeholders, and leadership.
* Analyze safety program data, operational trends, and relevant policies to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain accurate and timely safety records, databases, and supporting documentation.
* Translate technical and operational findings into clear, actionable information for stakeholders.
* Monitor safety performance indicators and communicate emerging concerns through appropriate channels.
Support data-driven decision-making by providing meaningful insights into flight safety performance.  

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Safety Culture**

* Partner with Flight Operations, Training, Maintenance, and other departments to strengthen the effectiveness of flight safety initiatives.
* Conduct Safety Department briefings for Flight Crewmembers to communicate relevant safety information, program updates, and operational concerns.
* Engage with operational teams to promote awareness of safety risks, reporting expectations, and established procedures.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to support consistent execution of safety recommendations and corrective actions.
* Encourage proactive hazard identification, open communication, and continuous improvement.
* Support departmental initiatives and special projects as directed by the Director of Safety.
Travel to JSX locations or other operational sites as needed to support safety programs, investigations, and related activities.  

  

**Why You'll Love This Role**
-----------------------------

* **Make a Meaningful Safety Impact:** Help identify and mitigate operational risks that directly influence the safety of JSX Customers, Crewmembers, and aircraft.
* **Lead Data-Driven Safety Initiatives:** Oversee the FOQA program and use flight data to uncover trends, identify hazards, and support proactive improvements.
* **Collaborate Across Aviation:** Work closely with Flight Operations, Training, Maintenance, and other stakeholders to strengthen operational safety.
* **Turn Insights Into Action:** Use safety investigations, root cause analysis, and performance reporting to recommend meaningful improvements.
* **Influence Safety Culture:** Help promote proactive reporting, operational engagement, and a shared commitment to continuous improvement.
* **Expand Your Aviation Safety Expertise:** Gain exposure to flight safety programs, SMS processes, operational investigations, and safety data analysis.

  

**What Makes a Successful Flight Safety Manager?**
--------------------------------------------------

We're looking for someone who is:

  

* **Safety-Focused:** You maintain an unwavering commitment to aviation safety, regulatory compliance, and proactive risk management.
* **Analytical:** You can interpret complex operational data, identify trends, and develop meaningful recommendations based on your findings.
* **Detail-Oriented:** You understand the importance of accurate safety records, thorough investigations, and reliable reporting.
* **Proactive:** You anticipate potential risks, recognize emerging hazards, and take initiative to address concerns before they become larger issues.
* **Collaborative:** You build strong relationships across departments and work effectively with operational teams to support shared safety objectives.
* **Communicative:** You translate technical information into clear, practical insights and communicate effectively with Flight Crewmembers and leadership.
* **Objective:** You approach safety investigations and operational evaluations with sound judgment, professionalism, and a commitment to understanding contributing factors.
* **Organized:** You manage multiple safety initiatives, maintain accurate documentation, and consistently follow through on assigned responsibilities.
* **Adaptable:** You remain composed and effective when responding to operational events, changing priorities, and unexpected challenges.
* **Entrepreneurial:** You challenge existing processes constructively, embrace innovative approaches, and seek opportunities to strengthen safety performance and operational excellence.

  

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* Minimum of two years of aviation experience.
* Bachelor of Science degree in Safety, Aviation, Engineering Sciences, Physical Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* FAA Airman Certificate.
* Good understanding of Federal Aviation Regulations and applicable FAA and National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) requirements.
* Knowledge of aviation accident and incident investigation processes.
* Understanding of pilot, maintenance, and cabin safety, including human factors and system safety principles.
* Ability to evaluate operational risks, analyze safety-related information, and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify trends and evaluate contributing factors.
* Ability to conduct root cause analyses and support safety investigations.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare reports, deliver briefings, and communicate technical information effectively.
* Fluency in reading, writing, and speaking English.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when maintaining safety records, databases, and reports.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Flight Operations, Training, Maintenance, and other operational stakeholders.
* Sound judgment and ability to handle sensitive safety information professionally.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and respond effectively to operational needs.
Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25% of the time.  

  

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Previous experience in commercial aviation operations.
* Experience administering, supporting, or analyzing a Flight Operational Quality Assurance (FOQA) program.
* Familiarity with aviation Safety Management Systems (SMS) and operational risk management practices.
* Experience analyzing flight operational data, identifying safety trends, or developing safety performance reports.
* Previous involvement in aviation safety investigations, incident reviews, or root cause analysis.
* Experience working with flight safety databases or aviation safety reporting systems.
* Experience conducting safety briefings or presenting operational findings to aviation stakeholders.
Familiarity with cross-functional safety initiatives involving Flight Operations, Training, or Maintenance.  

  

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* **Health Benefits:** New Crewmembers become eligible for coverage on the 1st of the month following the start date, with medical plans beginning at just $110/month. 100% employer-paid dental & vision, plus up to $2,100 annually for HSA contribution. Short-term and long-term disability coverage at no cost.
* **Travel Benefits:** Enjoy free non-revenue standby travel on JSX, plus deeply discounted standby travel on other major domestic and international airlines for you and your qualifying immediate family.
* **401(k) Match:** 50% of your first 8%.
* **Generous PTO:** Take time to recharge with our flexible PTO plan.

  

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

May perform other responsibilities as assigned. Responsibilities and duties may change when circumstances dictate, including emergencies, changes in workload, rush jobs, technical developments, or evolving business needs.

Ready to soar with us? Join JSX, where every day is a chance to be part of something eXtraordinary!

Title: Head of Pre-Sales
Description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 182470

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  
  
**Overview Of The Role:**  
  
  

* The Head of Pre-Sales at Al-Futtaim Technologies is responsible for leading the regional Pre-Sales function across the UAE, KSA, and Qatar. This position ensures the governance, quality, and final sign-off of technical solutions, estimates, cost sheets, and bid submissions. The role is pivotal in qualifying opportunities, ensuring technical compliance, deliverability, cost competitiveness, and successful handover to delivery teams. The Head of Pre-Sales also manages the pre-sales operating model, engagement frameworks, and feedback loops to improve bid speed, solution differentiation, and customer conversion rates while safeguarding gross margin.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **Leadership, Strategy and Capacity**

  
  

* Lead the regional Pre-Sales function and establish a high-performance, customer-centric and control-focused culture with clear LOB ownership, workload allocation, succession and capability plans.
* Develop and execute the Product and Services Strategy across supported domains, aligned with market priorities, partnership strengths, recurring-revenue opportunities and AFT delivery capability.
* Maintain a capacity plan by geography and LOB; prioritize strategic bids; identify skill gaps; and recommend hiring, cross-utilization, automation or approved external support.
* Ensure senior pre-sales governance remains independent enough to challenge scope, pricing, and risk while collaborating closely with Sales.
  

  

#### **Opportunity Qualification and Bid Governance**

  
  

* Implement a documented bid/no-bid and Go/No-Go process covering strategic fit, probability, client budget, technical feasibility, compliance, delivery capacity, cash/credit exposure, contract risk, vendor readiness, and expected margin.
* Assign a bid owner, independent reviewer, RACI, timeline, and dependency plan at kickoff; front-load site surveys, portal access, RFIs, vendor engagement, and approvals.
* Chair deal-desk reviews for major or high-risk opportunities and obtain all required DOA approvals before submission.
* Maintain clear decision records for proceed, re-scope, partner, no-bid, and management-approved strategic-margin exceptions.
  

  

#### **Solution Architecture, Design Assurance, and Consultant Management**

  
  

* Govern the design basis and solution architecture, including integrations, capacity, redundancy, lifecycle, supportability, cybersecurity, authority requirements and delivery feasibility.
* Ensure a requirements traceability and compliance matrix is completed for every material bid, with each requirement classified as compliant, qualified, deviated, excluded, or subject to clarification.
* Lead consultant/client technical strategy: workshops, RFIs, technical clarifications, alternative approvals, material-submittal dependencies, brand/specification changes, and documented acceptance of deviations.
  

  

#### **Cost Estimation and Estimate Completeness**

  
  

* Establish and enforce an Estimate Completeness Standard for project, service and AMC proposals. No estimate is complete until the scope, quantities, interfaces, duration, resources, risks and commercial inputs have been independently checked.
* Ensure cost sheets capture, where applicable: Principal and local materials; freight, customs, duty, FX and escalation; accessories, consumables, back boxes and mock-ups; BIM/CAD/design.
* Validate manpower using the programme, work breakdown, geography, site conditions and Finance/HR-approved fully loaded rates. Obtain Delivery/PMO or Service Delivery validation before finalization.
* Approve the estimate only when unresolved items are quantified, allocated to a named owner and covered through contingency, qualification, variation entitlement or management-approved risk acceptance.
  

  

#### **Commercial Competitiveness and Vendor/OEM Management**

  
  

* Create a competitive solution and pricing strategy from the first submission, normally including a fully compliant base option and an AFT-designed value-engineered alternative where the tender permits.
* Build and manage principal, OEM, distributor and specialist-partner relationships; secure registrations, certifications, rebates, project discounts, price validity, lead-time commitments, and technical support early in the cycle.
  

  

#### **Proposal Quality and Submission Control**

  
  

* Ensure proposals are complete, accurate, persuasive and aligned with RFP format, technical and commercial separation, required certificates, datasheets, drawings, compliance matrices and submission instructions.
* Enforce a two-level review for major bids: preparer/LOB review followed by independent cross-check and Head of Pre-Sales sign-off.
* Ensure timely submission of all tenders across UAE, KSA and Qatar, with documented exceptions and recovery actions.
  

  

#### **Service, AMC and Casual-Job Costing**

  
  

* Ensure Pre-Sales is the single point of accountability for service-proposal solution design, BOQ, vendor quotations and costing completeness before customer submission.
* Use Finance-approved loaded man-hour rates and validate service frequency, response/resolution commitments, standby/on-call requirements, vehicles, tools, spares, subcontract support, escalation, warranty overlap and contract duration.
  

  
  
**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  
  
  

* Technical proficiency in solution architecture across ICT, ELV, and integrated digital systems.
* Advanced estimate review and cost modeling capabilities including Excel, CRM, and analytics platforms.
* Strategic leadership and decision-making skills with a focus on competitiveness and risk management.
* Strong negotiation, executive presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  
**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in IT, Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Controls/Automation or a relevant discipline.
* MBA, Master's degree, chartered/professional engineering credential or recognized commercial/estimating qualification is preferred.
* 12-15 years of progressive experience in ICT, ELV/SSLV, BMS, AV, digital or systems-integration pre-sales, including significant regional leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated ownership of multi-country tendering and major, multi-system bids in UAE and/or KSA; experience in Qatar is advantageous.
  

  

About Al-Futtaim Real Estate

With a legacy of more than six decades in real estate and asset management, Al-Futtaim Real Estate – part of Al-Futtaim – creates real impact on the communities it serves through long-term investment and growth. As one of the region’s leading private developers, the company plans, creates and manages developments across the MENA region.

Al-Futtaim Real Estate has a diversified, multi-billion-dollar portfolio across the real estate value chain and asset types such as residential, commercial, malls and industries including hospitality, healthcare, infrastructure and education. Flagship mixed-use urban communities include Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.

Al-Futtaim Real Estate is also responsible for Al-Futtaim Contracting, a fully integrated, end-to-end specialist division operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Egypt. The business has delivered industry-leading construction, engineering, technology and FM solutions for more than 50 years.

Title: B2B Sales Manager, KSA
Description:
**About the Company**

At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.

Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.

### **About the Role**

As B2B Sales Manager, KSA, you will own Flow's corporate housing and relocation business across the Kingdom. You will be the senior commercial relationship for HR leaders, global mobility teams, and procurement at the largest employers in Saudi Arabia — from giga-projects and government-linked entities to multinationals, consulting firms, and fast-scaling local champions bringing talent into the country. This is a senior individual contributor role for a hunter-closer who can open doors at the executive level, structure multi-unit, multi-year agreements, and translate Flow's living experience into a compelling solution for companies relocating and housing their people. You will carry a personal quota, work an enterprise-style pipeline, and act as the voice of the corporate customer inside Flow.

### **Responsibilities**

**Pipeline & New Business Development:**

* Identify, prioritize, and pursue target accounts across KSA — including giga-projects, government and semi-government entities, multinationals, consulting and professional services firms, and fast-growing local employers with significant mobility needs.
* Build and own a robust pipeline through outbound prospecting, industry events, networking, partnerships with relocation management companies (RMCs), and referrals.
* Lead full cycle sales: discovery, solution design, site visits, proposals, commercial negotiation, and contract close.

**Account Management & Renewals:**

* Serve as the senior point of contact for corporate accounts post-signature, ensuring smooth onboarding and a seamless resident experience for relocated employees.
* Drive renewals, expansions, and cross-sell across Flow's MENA footprint as new communities come online.
* Build deep, trust-based relationships with HR, global mobility, procurement, and executive sponsors at key accounts.

**Commercial Strategy & Deal Structuring:**

* Structure multi-unit, multi-year corporate housing agreements that balance occupancy, ADR, and long-term account value.
* Partner with finance and revenue management to price competitively while protecting margin.
* Work with legal on master service agreements, preferred supplier arrangements, and bespoke contract terms required by enterprise customers.

**Cross-Functional Partnership:**

* Partner with property leadership and operations to ensure corporate residents receive the experience promised in the sales process.
* Work closely with Marketing on B2B campaigns, account-based marketing, sector positioning, and industry events.
* Provide structured feedback to product, operations, and leadership on what enterprise customers need from Flow's offering in KSA.

**Market Intelligence:**

* Maintain a clear view of the KSA corporate housing landscape — competitor offerings, pricing, inventory, and how mobility budgets are evolving as Vision 2030 reshapes the market.
* Track demand drivers across sectors and translate them into a focused account plan.

  

### **Ideal Background**

* 8+ years of B2B sales experience, with a meaningful portion selling into HR, global mobility, procurement, or C-suite buyers at large enterprises.
* Direct experience in corporate housing, serviced apartments, extended-stay hospitality, relocation services, or commercial/residential real estate selling to corporate accounts. Adjacent enterprise sales backgrounds will be considered for the right profile.
* Deep, current network across KSA — HR and mobility leaders, RMCs, giga-project employers, and major multinationals operating in the Kingdom.
* Proven track record carrying and exceeding individual quota on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
* Strong commercial instincts: comfortable structuring multi-unit agreements, negotiating MSAs, and defending pricing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English; Arabic fluency is strongly preferred and a meaningful advantage for this role.
* Familiarity with the KSA regulatory and business environment, including Saudization, Iqama, and the dynamics of doing business with government-linked entities.
* A builder's mindset — comfortable operating without a fully built playbook in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Why Join Flow?**

  

Headquartered in the United States, Flow was established in 2021 with a $350 million investment from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), the largest individual investment in the venture capital firm's history.

Since entering the MENA region in 2024 via the acquisition of close to one thousand units in Saudi Arabia, the company has become one of the largest owners and operators of residential real estate in the Kingdom.

Joining the company now would mean stepping into a pivotal role at a transformational time. You’ll work alongside a high-caliber team to launch flagship communities, deliver iconic resident experiences, and redefine what it means to call the region home.

We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

The Sales Manager leads the sales community to success. Communicates direction to the team in line with the company’s vision and strategy. Inspires the team to meet and exceed goals. Manages the HPE sales motion towards growth and increased profitability. Creates a high performing team through recruiting, developing, and retaining talent. Coaches to assure best in class individual and team sales performance. Orchestrates major Enterprise-level customer engagements to deliver results and create the best customer experience in the industry. Manages escalations to solution, and solution to opportunity. Establishes sales methodology for end-to-end sales process management. Manages sales planning, and follows up to ensure consistent execution. Provides timely and accurate sales forecasts. Provides customer feedback and won/loss deal analysis into the broader HPE team.

***Responsibilities:***  
  
***Strategic Leadership:***

* Leads the sales community to success. Communicates effectively to set direction for the team in line with the company’s vision and strategy.
* Inspires the team to meet and exceed goals.
* Manages the HPE sales motion strategy and deployment towards growth and increased profitability.
* Creates and supports a high performing team through recruiting, developing, promoting, and retaining best in class talent.
* Organizes the team and adapts the resource mix to maximize the collective team’s and HPE’s achievement, market coverage and financial performance.
* Actively and regularly coaches to assure best in class individual and team sales performance.
* Displays uncompromised integrity. Propagates our culture and values and the importance of winning the right way.

***Customer Intimacy:***

* Orchestrates major Enterprise-level customer engagements for HPE to make sure we deliver results through the best customer experience in the industry.
* Acts as role model for the sales community by displaying will to win and action oriented leadership, and by holding customers in the center.
* Manages escalations to solution, and solution to opportunity. Drives a hunting mentality.
* Engages with key customer executives (CEO, CFO, COO) to understand the customers’ business context and build trust. Coaches and guides team members to develop and deliver HPE’s value proposition in line with the customer's business priorities.
* Creates early stage opportunities by managing top customers’ executive level relationships.
* Coaches and enables teams to craft the right technical, IT investment, pricing and sales strategies to win.
* Partners with stakeholders (channel, categories, HR, legal, other sales teams) across business units to maximize customer success and team efficiency across HPE.
* Helps teams to bust barriers and overcome obstacles.

***Managing the Business:***

* Establishes sales methodology for end-to-end sales process management, with clear roles and responsibilities in each stage of the sales process.
* Manages strategic and tactical sales planning at both segment and account levels, considering the intersection of technology, people and economics.
* Follows up to ensure consistent execution.
* Provides timely and accurate sales forecasts and outlooks for customer and market dynamics.
* Provides structured customer feedback, competitive assessments and won/lost deal analysis into category, R&D, strategy & planning and sales teams to promote learning.

***Education and Experience:***

* University or Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience
* Typically 10-12+ years’ experience in sales, including success in achieving progressively higher quota and other sales goals.
* 5+ years’ experience managing high performing sales teams preferred
* Demonstrated excellence in project management.
* French is a plus

***Knowledge and Skills:***

  

* Deploys Purpose and Vision: Understands HPE's vision and strategy. Aligns and translates them into the team’s vision, purpose, and clear goals.
* Strategic Thinking: Understands how to best deploy the business model, individual and team strengths to the most impactful opportunities or challenges. Understands various sales motions and their impact on P&L. Coaches and guides the direct and indirect team to consider each deal's impact to HPE's long term success. Leads the team to determine how HPE adds value to our customer and our customer's customers.
* Leads through Change: Anticipates and embraces business changes; directs and enables shifts within the team.
* Inspires the Team: Engages and energizes team members to achieve team goals and realize their individual potential.
* Builds Teams: Creates and supports a high performing team through attracting, hiring, developing, promoting, and retaining best in class talent. Plans resource allocation and aligns talent to opportunities, to maximize the effectiveness of the coverage model.
* Develops Talent: Coaches, mentors, and develops talent to maximize individual and team performance. Acts as an advisor helping teams navigate unusual deal situations while encouraging learning.
* Builds Long-Term Customer/Partner Relationships: Understands the customer's or partner's strategy and business needs and positions HPE as a partner invested in the customer's/channel partner's long term business outcomes, leveraging HPE’s portfolio.
* HPE Portfolio Knowledge: Builds and continually updates an understanding of the full portfolio of HPE products, solutions, and service offerings - their value propositions, competitive differentiators, and benefits to our customers. Guides the team to define a strategic solutions roadmap for the customer and articulate targeted solutions to add value to the client.
* IT Industry Acumen: Builds and maintains up-to-date knowledge of IT industry developments and technology trends with potential impacts to our customers.
* Vertical/Industry Knowledge preferred: Understands industry drivers, trends, best practices, and customer needs. Able to define how HPE adds value in a customer's business and in an industry. Able to articulate value propositions and messaging tailored to the customer's industry and practices.
* Business Analysis: Demonstrates mastery at understanding and analyzing customer, competitor, market, country-specific, and financial information. Leverages analytics, sound judgment, and an ability to "see beyond the data" to decide on winning tactics.
* Sales Methodology: Deploys sales methodology to maximize coverage and customer engagement.
* Drives Results: Drives results (pipeline, forecast, revenue, profit) in alignment with the company strategy. Drives sales execution. Maximizes outcome of resources.
* Business and Financial Acumen: Understands how different parts of a business interoperate to produce business outcomes, including financial outcomes. Understands how actions and decisions impact customer, partner, and HPE achievement and KPI's. Understands general business concepts and the economy. Able to interpret financial reports and make relevant conclusions for planning.
