Title: Complex Senior Sales Manager - Hilton Orlando Lake Buena Vista and Hilton Palace
Description:
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a **Complex Senior Sales Manager** , you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

  

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

* **Represent the hotel to prospective clients:** Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
* **Drive new business opportunities:** Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
* **Manage the full sales cycle:** Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
* **Develop strategic sales plans:** Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
* **Analyze sales performance:** Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
* **Support exceptional service delivery:** Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
* **Inspire and develop the team:** Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

  

**What It Takes to Make the Stay**

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

  

**How We'll Help You Thrive**

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:

* **Incredible travel perks** – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
* **Own a piece of Hilton** – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
* **Paid parental leave** – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
* **Personalized caregiving support** – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
* **Crisis concierge** – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
* **Mental health resources** – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* **Generous paid time off (PTO)** – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
* **Health & welfare benefits** – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
* **Financial security for your future** – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next

*\*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.*

  

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Title: Membership Sales Manager - Recreation
Description:
About Us

As the world's largest family of luxury hotels, we all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental® brand.

Shaped by decades of international know-how and local insights, our passion for luxury travel spans cultures and customs. Inspiring us to create warm and sophisticated experiences for those seeking a richer perspective on the world. Each of our hotels cultivates a distinctive style and ambience where we embrace every opportunity to give our guests a personal and enriching experience.

If you'd like to embrace a wider world of experiences and opportunities, we'd like to welcome you to the world's most international luxury hotel brand.

Located on Doha's longest private beach and nestled in landscaped gardens, the InterContinental Doha Beach & Spa features 12 restaurants, a range of recreational facilities, a free-form swimming pool, and the world-class Spa InterContinental.

Situated in an exclusive location, minutes from downtown Doha and major government and corporate offices and within minutes to the Doha Exhibition and Convention Centre, City Center Mall, and Doha Golf Club, our properties offer distinctive surroundings which will forever redefine luxury.

Your Day to Day

As the Membership Sales Manager, you will be responsible for leading and driving the membership sales strategy within the Recreation Department, focusing on maximizing membership revenue, expanding our membership base, and strengthening long-term relationships with existing members.

Working closely with the Recreation team and other hotel departments, you will identify new business opportunities, develop effective sales initiatives, and ensure that our membership offerings remain competitive and aligned with the hotel's luxury positioning.

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial acumen, strategic sales capabilities, relationship management skills, and a genuine passion for luxury hospitality to drive business growth while delivering exceptional member experiences.

Key Responsibilities Include:

* Develop and implement effective membership sales strategies to achieve revenue targets, increase membership acquisition, and maximize retention.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, networking, referrals, and corporate partnerships.
* Lead the membership sales process, from initial inquiries and facility tours to negotiations, conversions, and membership renewals.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective members, ensuring personalized service and long-term loyalty.
* Develop and execute targeted sales campaigns, promotional initiatives, and membership packages to attract new members and drive revenue growth.
* Identify opportunities to expand corporate memberships, group packages, and strategic partnerships within the local market.
* Monitor membership sales performance, conversion rates, renewals, and retention trends, implementing corrective actions where necessary.
* Conduct regular market research and competitor analysis to identify emerging trends, pricing opportunities, and areas for business development.
* Collaborate with the Recreation, Marketing, and other operational teams to develop promotional activities and enhance membership visibility.
* Oversee the membership renewal process, proactively engaging with members to maximize retention and identify upselling opportunities.
* Ensure all prospective members receive professional facility tours that effectively communicate the unique benefits and experiences offered by the hotel.
* Handle member feedback and concerns professionally, ensuring timely resolution and maintaining high levels of satisfaction.
* Prepare regular sales forecasts, performance reports, and membership growth analyses for management review.
* Establish and maintain an accurate database of prospective and existing members, ensuring effective follow-up and relationship management.
* Identify opportunities to enhance membership offerings, benefits, and experiences based on member feedback and market demand.
* Support the development of the annual membership sales budget and revenue objectives.
* Ensure all membership sales activities comply with hotel policies, brand standards, and established operational procedures.
* Lead, coach, and support the membership sales team, where applicable, to achieve individual and departmental objectives.
* Foster a proactive, results-driven sales culture while maintaining the highest standards of luxury service and professionalism.

What We Need From You

Ideally, you'll have some or all of the following competencies and experience we're looking for:

* Proven experience in a Membership Sales Manager, Sales Manager, or similar commercial role, preferably within hotel recreation, leisure facilities, fitness clubs, or luxury hospitality, with a strong understanding of recreation operations, membership management, and guest engagement.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute successful sales strategies, achieve revenue targets, and drive membership growth.
* Strong understanding of membership acquisition, retention, renewals, and relationship management.
* Established networking and business development capabilities, with the ability to identify and secure new corporate and individual membership opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong commercial awareness and the ability to analyze sales performance, market trends, and revenue opportunities.
* Proven ability to build and maintain long-term relationships with high-value clients and members.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* A proactive, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Experience developing sales promotions, membership packages, and strategic partnerships.
* Strong understanding of luxury service standards and a commitment to delivering exceptional member experiences.
* Knowledge of the local market and an established professional network in Qatar would be an advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant CRM or membership management systems.
* Degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality Management, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Flexibility to work varied hours, including evenings and weekends, as required by business needs.

What We Offer

We’ll reward all your hard work with competitive salary and benefits.

Join us and you’ll become part of the global IHG family – and like all families, all our individual team members share some winning characteristics. As a team, we work better together – we trust and support each other, we do the right thing and we welcome different perspectives. You need to show us you care: that you notice the little things that make a difference to guests as well as always looking for ways to improve - visit www.careers.ihg.com to find out more about us.

So go on - show us how your passion and personality are the perfect fit to deliver memorable experiences to our guests.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Title: General Manager – Sales & Operations (Signage & Outdoor Advertisement)

Title: Sales Manager, GCC & ME (Arabic Speaker)
Description:
Mandarin Oriental Jumeira, Dubai is looking for a Sales Manager – GCC & Middle East to join our Sales team.

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.

With a pristine oceanfront setting, Mandarin Oriental Jumeira, Dubai is a stylish urban resort overlooking the clear blue waters of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai’s glittering skyline, which is dominated by Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world. The hotel's beachfront location and open-air facilities are designed to bring a new level of relaxed luxury to the city.

**About the job**

The Sales Manager is responsible for the commercial performance and development of an assigned territory and portfolio of accounts. The role develops and implements territory and account plans, acquires new business, strengthens existing client relationships and delivers agreed revenue and production targets.

The Sales Manager takes ownership of the assigned portfolio, using market intelligence and account performance analysis to identify opportunities, establish priorities and recommend appropriate commercial actions. The role operates with a high degree of independence within the hotel's agreed commercial strategy and pricing guidelines, reporting directly to the Director of Sales.

**As Sales Manager, you will be responsible for the following duties:**

  

**Territory and Portfolio Ownership**

* Take ownership of the assigned territory and portfolio, ensuring effective coverage of relevant corporate, government, MICE, leisure and business travel agent accounts.

* Develop and maintain a territory business plan and account plans aligned with the hotel's commercial strategy and business mix objectives.

* Establish account priorities based on revenue potential, production, profitability and strategic importance.

* Acquire, develop and retain key accounts, identifying opportunities to increase market share and account contribution.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers and key stakeholders within assigned accounts.

* Ensure effective coverage of all relevant revenue opportunities within the portfolio.

  
  

**Business Development and Commercial Performance**

* Deliver agreed monthly, quarterly and annual portfolio targets.

* Proactively identify, qualify and convert new business opportunities within the assigned territory.

* Lead account negotiations and prepare commercial proposals within approved pricing and business parameters.

* Manage RFP participation and develop account strategies to maximise acceptance and conversion.

* Identify opportunities to increase revenue through account development, upselling, cross-selling and improved business mix.

* Monitor account production and pipeline performance, taking corrective action where required.

* Recommend tactics and strategies to improve revenue performance, address shortfalls and maximise business opportunities.

* Ensure that sales activities and account plans are translated into measurable commercial results.

  
  

**Market Intelligence and Strategic Planning**

* Analyse market conditions, competitor activity, economic trends, supply and demand, customer behaviour and emerging business opportunities.

* Identify changes in market dynamics that may affect the hotel's performance and recommend appropriate responses.

* Provide accurate and timely reporting on territory, segment and account production.

* Use market and account intelligence to inform territory plans, account priorities and sales activity.

* Represent the hotel at trade shows, sales missions, industry events and relevant client functions.

* Contribute informed recommendations to the Director of Sales on territory opportunities, business risks and commercial priorities.

  
  

**Client Relationship Management and Service Delivery**

* Develop a detailed understanding of clients’ business requirements, decision-making processes and service expectations.

* Ensure that client requests, proposals and business commitments are managed professionally and within agreed timeframes.

* Work closely with Reservations, Front Office, Conference & Events and other hotel departments to ensure effective delivery of account requirements.

* Resolve account-related issues and escalate matters requiring senior management involvement.

* Promote customer loyalty and uphold Mandarin Oriental brand standards through consistent service excellence.

* Maximise opportunities to cross-sell the Mandarin Oriental portfolio through the MObilise programme.

  
  

**Collaboration and Departmental Contribution**

* Share market knowledge, account intelligence and best practices with colleagues in the Sales department.

* Support and guide Sales Executives through the sharing of commercial knowledge and effective account management practices, as required.

* Collaborate with the wider Sales team to ensure consistent market coverage and avoid duplication of client activity.

* Attend departmental meetings and contribute meaningful account, market and performance updates.

* Maintain effective relationships with colleagues across the hotel.

* Understand and comply with hotel policies, procedures, MOHG standards and applicable legal requirements.

* Act as a hotel ambassador at all times.

* Carry out additional duties related to the role as requested by management.

  

**As Sales Manager, we expect from you:**

* Degree or Higher National Diploma in Hospitality, Hotel Management, Business Management or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in a five-star hotel Sales environment, with a proven record of achieving targets and closing business.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of accounts and developing new business in GCC & Middle East.
* Experience representing a hotel at trade shows, sales missions and industry events.
* Previous experience in the GCC is an advantage.
* Fluent in English and Arabic.
* Strong commercial awareness and understanding of hotel sales, account management and revenue generation.
* Excellent negotiation, presentation, communication and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to analyse account performance and market information and translate findings into commercial action.
* Ability to develop, implement, monitor and adjust business and account plans.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently.
* Effective time management and problem-solving skills.
* Commitment to delivering high standards of customer service.

  

**Our commitment to you**

* Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
* MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
* Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
* A competitive salary and benefits packages

Title: Senior Manager, MX B2B Sales Operations (Onsite - Plano, TX)
Description:
**Position Summary**

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship
  
  
Headquartered in Plano, TX, Samsung Electronics America (SEA) is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. Across each of these areas, our work drives innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity in the United States.
  
  
For nearly five decades, Samsung has been at the forefront of technological advancements, investing over $100 billion and creating more than 20,000 jobs nationwide. Our mission? To integrate cutting-edge products, services, and AI technology to deliver smarter, sustainable, and more connected experiences that empower people to live better.
  
  
As a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SEA offers opportunities to work alongside global visionary thinkers and innovators who are passionate about making a difference. Explore the exciting opportunities at Samsung Electronics America and discover how you can make an impact.
  
  
To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

**Role and Responsibilities**

**ABOUT MX (Mobile Experience) B2B**

Samsung's MX B2B division drives mobile sales to business customers across the full spectrum of go-to-market channels: Distribution Channel, Carrier, SMB, and eCommerce. Our product portfolio spans the full Samsung mobile ecosystem, with core lines including smartphones, tablets, smartwatches, and laptops. We partner with enterprise resellers, national carriers, and direct business customers to bring Samsung's device portfolio to organizations of all sizes. Our sales operations function keeps that engine running.

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Senior Manager, MX B2B Sales Operations to lead the management plan (MP) breakdown and management by objectives (MBO) processes for MX B2B, own CBS pipeline performance and governance, and lead the team that delivers sell-through, sell-out, and insights reporting. This role sets the operating cadence for weekly sales operations and is accountable for the quality and timeliness of the team's output. You will work closely with Sales leadership, Product GTM, Business Intelligence, Supply Chain, and Finance.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

  

**Management Plan (MP) Target breakdown to fit each sales organization**

* Own the end-to-end MP process, including annual and quarterly targets cascaded from top-line revenue to channel, product, and SKU levels.
* Prioritize and manage MP-related workloads and requests from leadership, Sales, and Finance, setting timelines and deliverables for the team.
* Monthly TP (target plan) and weekly DP (demand plan) link with each sales organization, and drive weekly forecast and target tracking calls by product category (HHP, Tab, PC).
Align the RR forecast with MP commitments, and flag gaps to leadership early with a recommended path to close them.  

  

**MBO**

* Design and run the MBO cascade for sales teams, linking objectives to measurable KPIs and integrating them with quarterly compensation planning.
* Build and maintain the KPI tracker and scorecard, and report progress in operational and executive reviews.
Manage MBO checkpoints (quarterly) with clean, auditable data, and resolve discrepancies before results are shared.  

  

**CBS Pipeline & Performance**

* Own CBS (Carrier Business) pipeline hygiene and drive pipeline focus across the team, including pipeline close-rate reporting and risk flags.
* Run the S/T and DT pipeline cadence, and connect Sales and sell-through teams on opportunities that lack a clear path to sale.
Lead SKU and product lifecycle analysis (PLC, EOL, Supply constraint) and assess its impact on targets, pipeline, and inventory.  

  

**Process Improvement**

* Identify and implement process and workflow improvements that increase the efficiency and reliability of the function.
Drive adoption of reporting tools and analytical infrastructure (e.g., Tableau, AI productivity tools), and serve as the escalation point for field-raised data and reporting issues.  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

**Required**

* 8+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, sales strategy, or analytics in a B2B environment
* 3+ years of experience leading or managing a team
* Proven experience owning management planning, target setting, or MBO processes, including cascading goals from top-line to individual level
* Working knowledge of supply chain management (SCM), including sell-in, sell-out, and sell-through metrics, and channel inventory management (WOS, PSI)
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, pivot tables, and large-scale data manipulation
* Experience building and maintaining dashboards using Tableau, Alteryx, Excel, or equivalent tools
* Strong command of sales revenue structure, including gross-to-net revenue, deductions, and P&L adjustments
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to present complex data to executive audiences
* Strong PowerPoint skills, with experience owning executive strategy decks and business reviews
Bachelor's degree in Business, SCM, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience  

  

**Preferred**

* Experience in IT Channel, telecom, or consumer technology sales environments
* Familiarity with route-to-market models across IT Channel, Digital, and Direct sales motions
* Knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and exposure to enterprise BI or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle)
* Experience with supply chain planning concepts (e.g., demand signals, safety stock, buffer planning)
Familiarity with AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate analysis and reporting workflows  

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

You are a builder, a leader, and a connector. You see how revenue moves through the business, and you know how to turn that complexity into clear processes, reliable data, and a team that delivers consistently. You are as comfortable coaching an analyst through a model as you are presenting to a leadership team. You don't just run the numbers. You own them, explain them, and use them to drive better decisions. You thrive in ambiguity, communicate proactively, and take pride in work that other people depend on.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE PART OF**

* A high-visibility Sales Operations function that directly shapes how MX B2B sets goals, plans targets, and measures performance
* Cross-functional partnerships across Sales, Product GTM, Business Intelligence, Supply Chain, and Finance
* A team culture that values ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement
Travel as required (~10%)  

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR 1**

  

**Own the MP and MBO Cycle**

Within the first six months, you are the recognized owner of the MP and MBO processes. You understand how targets are built, how they flow to the field, and how they connect to compensation. The next planning cycle runs through you.

  

**Be the Source of Truth for CBS and Revenue Performance**

Pipeline, forecast, and revenue reporting are consolidated, accurate, and delivered on time. Stakeholders come to you when they need to understand what is happening in the business.

  

**Build a Team That Delivers**

Your team has clear ownership of its cadences and deliverables, and its reporting is trusted by leadership. Team members are developing their skills and taking on more responsibility.

  

**Build Toward Scale**

By year end, you have identified gaps in the existing infrastructure and led improvements, whether that is a more reliable data pipeline, a cleaner forecasting model, or a more consistent planning cadence. The function is more capable than when you arrived.

  

*Work is generally performed in an office environment. This role operates under periodic time-sensitive conditions, including month-end, quarter-end, and planning-cycle deadlines, and may require hours beyond a standard schedule. The position carries significant responsibility and broad access to confidential revenue and business data.*

Title: Head of After Sales (3719285)
Description:
**Head of After Sales, North America**

**Location**
: Charlotte, NC preferred. Remote within the United States considered for the right profile.

**Travel**
: Regular travel across the United States; occasional international travel.

**Team**
: Approximately 9 people (first-level technical support and second-level field technicians, plus external service partners.

**Employment**
: Full-time, permanent.

**About the Client**

Our client is an international group and a leading manufacturer of professional coffee machines and automated food and beverage equipment for the out-of-home market, with a strong focus on super-automatic espresso technology.

Its North American business is experiencing double-digit growth and has established a new US subsidiary. The company is investing in its people, infrastructure and service capabilities, offering the opportunity to join a lean, entrepreneurial organization with close collaboration and direct exposure to its European headquarters.

**Position Overview**

The company is entering a new phase of development in North America and is looking for a
**Head of After Sales to lead, consolidate and further develop its entire aftermarket organization.**

Reporting to the North American leadership, this person will have end-to-end responsibility for the After Sales function, bringing together first-level technical support, second-level field service and the broader aftermarket business, including spare parts, accessories, telemetry and service solutions.

This is a genuine
**build-and-transform opportunity**
, rather than a role focused on maintaining an established structure. The successful candidate will be expected to bring leadership, structure and accountability to the organization, while remaining sufficiently hands-on to understand operational challenges, support the team and engage directly in critical customer situations.

The ultimate objective is to develop a high-performing service organization that delivers an outstanding customer experience while establishing After Sales as a stronger and increasingly profitable contributor to the North American business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Service Organization & Leadership**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of employees across first-level technical support (phone and email troubleshooting) and second-level field technicians/trainers throughout North America.
* Review, design, and lead the transformation of the service organization, establishing clear responsibilities, support levels, escalation paths, operating procedures and performance KPIs.
* Establish effective coordination between remote technical support and field service/training, ensuring that resources are deployed efficiently and customer issues are resolved promptly.
* Plan and coordinate field service/training activities, technician schedules and customer visits to ensure effective geographical coverage and optimal use of resources.
* Build, develop, and manage a network of third-party field service providers (external) across North America.
* Identify organizational and resource requirements to support business growth, including planned additional hires in North America.

**2. Technical Support, Training & Product Expertise**

* Develop and implement structured technical training programs to strengthen the technical capabilities and independence of the internal service team.
* Oversee technical training and certification programs for customers' technicians and external service partners.
* Ensure effective knowledge transfer and consistent technical standards across the North American service network.
* Act as the primary interface with European headquarters, coordinating with Technical Support, R&D and Production on complex technical cases, recurring product issues and product improvements.
* Drive a systematic approach to troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and the resolution of recurring technical issues.
* Ensure that technical knowledge and field feedback are effectively shared with headquarters and translated into improvements in products, processes and customer support.

**3. Aftermarket Business Development & Profitability**

* Develop the North American aftermarket business, including spare parts, accessories, telemetry, maintenance solutions and service offerings.
* Develop and execute a strategy to increase aftermarket revenue, improve profitability and strengthen customer retention.
* Manage and develop relationships with national spare-parts distributors, supporting commercial policies, discount structures, product bundles and promotional programs.
* Identify opportunities to expand the penetration of accessories, service solutions and value-added offerings across the installed machine base.
* Work closely with headquarters to define the product and accessory portfolio, ensuring alignment with North American customer needs and market opportunities.
* Establish appropriate performance metrics and reporting to monitor aftermarket sales, margins, service performance and business development opportunities.
* Work closely with Sales, Customer Service and Marketing to develop an integrated approach to customer satisfaction, retention and revenue growth.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5+ years of experience in After Sales, Technical Service or Field Service for capital equipment, of which at least 2 years leading technical teams (field and/or remote support).
* Proven track record of building, restructuring or significantly improving a service organization, including processes, team structures and escalation mechanisms.
* Solid technical understanding of electromechanical equipment that interacts with a product and requires precise calibration, installation, configuration, troubleshooting, calibration and ongoing maintenance (e.g. super-automatic espresso machines, traditional coffee machines, grinders, gelato machines, combi ovens).
* Demonstrated commercial acumen and experience developing aftermarket revenue streams, including spare parts, accessories, service agreements or maintenance programs.
* Experience managing distributors, channel partners and/or external service provider networks.
* Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to translate strategy into operational execution.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with full professional proficiency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across North America. Valid driver's license and passport required.

**Preferred**

* Background in professional coffee equipment, ideally super-automatic machines, or in comparable food service equipment (ovens, fryers, gelato and soft-serve equipment).
* Previous experience working for an equipment manufacturer, distributor or national service organization within the foodservice industry.
* Familiarity with telemetry, connected equipment, CRM platforms, field service management systems, and Salesforce.
* Experience working with international headquarters, ideally within a European multinational organization.
* Experience managing geographically dispersed teams across North America.

**What We Are Looking For**

Beyond technical expertise and management experience, we are looking for an individual who combines a builder's mentality, strong leadership and commercial orientation. The ideal candidate:

* **Is a builder, not simply a manager**
  : enjoys creating structures, developing people and implementing processes, while remaining directly involved in operational matters when needed.
* **Takes ownership, proactively propose solutions, and makes decisions**
  : is comfortable setting priorities, establishing boundaries and making difficult decisions, including managing customer expectations when necessary.
* **Leads with accountability**
  : sets clear expectations, follows through on commitments and creates a culture of responsibility and performance.
* **Stays effective under pressure**
  : understands the urgency of equipment downtime in commercial environments and can support a team dealing with demanding customers and time-sensitive situations.
* **Develops people**
  : provides direction, coaching and constructive feedback, building a stronger and more independent technical organization.
* **Combines technical and commercial thinking**
  : understands that excellent service is not only about resolving technical issues, but also about protecting customer relationships and developing business opportunities.
* **Works across cultures and functions**
  : builds effective relationships with North American colleagues, external partners and European headquarters.

**Why Join**

This is an opportunity to take on a high-impact leadership position within an international manufacturer at a pivotal stage of its North American expansion. You will have the opportunity to:

* Shape and develop the entire After Sales organization across North America.
* Build a stronger service infrastructure, including internal capabilities and an external partner network.
* Take ownership of the aftermarket business and directly influence its growth and profitability.
* Work closely with North American leadership and European headquarters, with significant visibility and influence across the organization.
* Make a tangible impact on the company's customer experience, operational performance and long-term growth.

**If you are an entrepreneurial After Sales leader who enjoys building teams, improving service organizations and turning technical excellence into business performance, this is an opportunity to make a real difference.**

Title: Senior Manager Supply Chain, MENA
Description:
**For A Better You**  
  
At iHerb, we believe that living a healthy and balanced life should be easy and accessible to everyone. As a team member, we’ll empower you to live this promise each day as you make a truly global impact in your career.  
  
We constantly strive for innovation, while transforming and improving the online shopping experience for our customers. We believe that individually we are incredible, but when we come together, our growth is infinite. In an industry that is constantly evolving, we are on a mission to make an impact on the global market, and the individual and collaborative efforts of our people are paramount to helping us succeed.  
  
Whether you work in one of our logistics centers, technology hubs, corporate offices or even from home, your role at iHerb will take you beyond what’s expected, turning challenge into change. If you're ready for it, we want you to join our team. Get started now.

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager, MENA Supply Chain is the single-threaded owner of end-to-end logistics performance and build-out across the Middle East and North Africa region, with initial focus on the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). This role designs, launches, and scales the regional logistics network, ensuring best-in-class cost, service, and delivery speed.

Operating as a core member of the regional leadership team, this role is the primary partner to the COO in-region. It translates global logistics strategy into scalable, high-performing operations and shapes key decisions based on regional realities, including cross-border customs flows, Arabic labeling, cash on delivery, and seasonal demand peaks such as Ramadan, Eid, and White Friday.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategy, execution, and team building during a critical scale-up phase.

**Job Expectations:**

### **Build and Own the MENA Supply Chain Setup**

  

* Lead the end-to-end setup of the MENA logistics network, including selection of the regional hub (for example a free zone warehouse in Dubai) and the set-up of an Arabic and bilingual labeling solution in the MENA warehouse.
* Define the flow model for the region: import and consolidation at the hub, in-country distribution, and cross-border linehaul to the other GCC markets and, over time, the wider MENA region.
* Ensure the initial setup is scalable, cost-efficient, and operationally robust.
* Ensure logistics is a proactive enabler of growth, not a constraint.

### **End-to-End Performance Ownership**

  

* Own regional logistics KPIs across (i) cost (transport, warehousing, handling, customs duties and fees), (ii) service levels (OTIF, delivery promise accuracy, first-attempt delivery, cash on delivery remittance accuracy), and (iii) speed (lead times, delivery SLAs by country and city tier).
* Drive trade-off decisions across transportation, warehousing, and inventory, including air versus sea inbound and hub versus in-country stock placement.
* Plan capacity and inventory for regional demand peaks (Ramadan, Eid, White Friday) and for summer heat constraints on temperature-sensitive products.
* Establish full visibility and control over performance drivers.

### **Strategic Partner to COO (Regional Translation and Feedback Loop)**

  

* Act as the go-to logistics counterpart to the COO in MENA.
* Translate global strategy into executable regional plans.
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on (i) market constraints, (ii) performance gaps, and (iii) optimization opportunities.
* Proactively challenge and refine global assumptions based on MENA realities, such as address quality, last-mile variability, and payment preferences.

### **Customs, Compliance and Regulatory Coordination**

  

* Drive cross-functional coordination to ensure MENA regulatory requirements are met across logistics operations, including product registration and import approvals with the relevant authorities in each market (for example SFDA in Saudi Arabia and the competent health and standards authorities in the UAE), GCC and country-level customs procedures, and halal and conformity requirements where applicable.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Marketing, customs brokers, and external partners on Arabic labeling, documentation (certificates of origin, attestations, import permits), and market-specific requirements.
* Translate compliance needs into operational execution across warehouses, 3PLs, customs brokers, and distribution flows, including free zone and mainland transfers and the GCC customs transit process.
* Identify risks and dependencies, such as shipment holds, registration delays, and duty classification disputes, and drive resolution across stakeholders.

### **Team Build and Leadership**

  

* Act as logistics representative within the regional leadership team.
* Lead a lean, high-performing regional logistics team, including a 3PL /Warehouse Manager, a Transportation and Customs Manager, and an Inventory Planner, with the ability to build a multi-cultural team across the region.
* Coach the team on carrier, 3PL, and customs broker strategy and execution, and collaborate with global to ensure global strategy and guardrails are followed.

### **Continuous Optimization and Scale**

  

* Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements early.
* Optimize network design (warehouse footprint, in-country versus hub stock, routing, inventory placement), including the timing of a second node, for example in Saudi Arabia, as volumes grow.
* Optimize last-mile and cash on delivery operations, including carrier mix, delivery success rates, and returns handling.
* Lead regional logistics projects (process improvements, system enhancements).

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

Required:

* Proven experience building or scaling logistics operations (warehouse, transport, and inventory) in the region.
* Strong hands-on experience with 3PLs, carrier networks, customs brokers, and multi-country GCC distribution, including cross-border trucking and free zone operations.
* Working knowledge of GCC customs procedures and import requirements for regulated consumer products (health, food, personal care).
* Experience with e-commerce last-mile, including cash on delivery and returns, is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and deeply operational levels.
* Strong stakeholder management across global and regional teams, and the cultural fluency to work with partners across different MENA markets.
* Data-driven, execution-focused, and comfortable making trade-offs.
* Fluent English is required. Arabic is a strong advantage.

**Equipment Knowledge:**

  

* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience with Google Business Suite (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms) preferred

**Experience Requirements:**

Generally requires a minimum 10 years in logistics / supply chain, with strong MENA or GCC exposure.

**Travel Requirements:**

The role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with frequent travel to the hub warehouse and port areas (for example Jebel Ali) and regular travel to other markets in the region, in particular Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam).

**Education Requirements:**

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related discipline or equivalent additional experience required

Title: Technical Architect – SAP S/4HANA, ABAP & BTP
Description:
### **Technical Problem Solver | Solution Navigator | Trusted Advisor**

**Location**: Remote

**Employment Type**: Full-Time

**Department**: Professional Services / Delivery

**Reports To**: Practice Director / VP Delivery

### **About the Role**

Bramasol is seeking an experienced SAP Technical Architect with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, ABAP, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) to help customers translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable, and sustainable SAP solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical knowledge with business understanding, curiosity, sound judgment, and strong consulting skills. This individual understands not only how SAP technologies work, but when and why to apply them to achieve the best business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, client-facing technical leadership role focused on bridging business and technology. The Technical Architect will evaluate requirements, explore alternative approaches, and recommend appropriate solutions leveraging standard SAP functionality, ABAP development, SAP BTP services, integrations, extensions, automation, and emerging technologies.

We are looking for a natural problem solver who asks thoughtful questions, challenges assumptions constructively, and approaches complex challenges with a “let’s figure out how” mindset, rather than simply explaining why something cannot be done.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Business Understanding & Technical Problem Solving**

* Engage with business stakeholders and functional teams to understand business objectives, challenges, and underlying requirements.
* Ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and explore alternative approaches to solving business problems.
* Translate business requirements into practical SAP technical solution options, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks, costs, and long-term implications.
* Evaluate when to leverage standard SAP functionality, ABAP, SAP BTP, integrations, extensions, automation, or other technologies.
* Recommend solutions that balance business value, technical feasibility, implementation effort, and long-term maintainability.

### **Technical Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design scalable, secure, and supportable technical solutions across SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Public Edition, and hybrid landscapes.
* Apply SAP Clean Core principles when evaluating standard capabilities, ABAP Cloud, in-app and side-by-side extensibility, APIs, and integration approaches.
* Provide architectural guidance across SAP BTP services, including Integration Suite, API Management, and relevant development and automation capabilities.
* Evaluate technical dependencies, data flows, integration patterns, security considerations, performance requirements, and operational supportability.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, solution design workshops, and architecture reviews.
* Establish and promote technical standards, reusable patterns, and development best practices.

### **Technical Leadership & Delivery Accountability**

* Provide technical leadership across SAP implementations, migrations, integrations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Take ownership of technical architecture decisions and remain engaged throughout development, testing, deployment, and stabilization to ensure successful outcomes.
* Guide and mentor ABAP developers, integration specialists, BTP consultants, and other technical team members.
* Review technical designs, challenge proposed approaches, and assist in resolving complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with project managers, functional leads, and other architects to identify risks, manage dependencies, and drive decisions to closure.
* Proactively communicate technical concerns, recommend solutions, and follow through on commitments.

### **Customer Consulting & Collaboration**

* Build trusted customer relationships through technical credibility, clear communication, responsiveness, and a commitment to customer success.
* Translate complex technical concepts into understandable business language to support informed decision-making.
* Work collaboratively across functional and technical disciplines to develop solutions that address customer needs.
* Demonstrate ownership, professional judgment, and accountability when navigating challenging customer situations.
* Maintain a solutions-oriented approach, exploring possibilities and practical alternatives when faced with technical or business constraints.

### **Innovation & Business Development**

* Stay current with SAP S/4HANA, BTP, ABAP Cloud, RAP, Fiori, Integration Suite, and emerging SAP technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and modern SAP capabilities to improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to Bramasol’s technical knowledge, reusable solutions, accelerators, and delivery practices.
* Support pre-sales activities, including technical discovery, architecture discussions, solution estimates, and proposal development.

### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Extensive experience in SAP technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong foundation in SAP ABAP development, including object-oriented ABAP, enhancements, interfaces, APIs, and modern development approaches.
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, extensibility, integration technologies, and technical design principles.
* Practical experience with SAP BTP and modern SAP integration approaches, particularly Integration Suite.
* Familiarity with SAP Clean Core principles, ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS, OData, and SAP Fiori development approaches.
* Demonstrated experience defining technical solutions and guiding development teams through implementation.
* Ability to evaluate competing technical approaches and recommend solutions based on business value, architectural suitability, and long-term supportability.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated accountability for technical decisions, delivery commitments, and successful customer outcomes.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Architecture experience across multiple full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or transformation initiatives.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and/or Public Edition.
* Working knowledge of SAP Finance (FI/CO), Sales and Distribution (SD), or other enterprise business processes.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, API Management, SAP BTP extension services, and automation.
* Experience supporting technical pre-sales, solution estimation, and customer advisory engagements.
* SAP certifications in relevant S/4HANA, ABAP, BTP, or Integration Suite technologies.

### **What We’re Looking For**

**Beyond technical expertise, we value consultants who demonstrate:**

* **Curiosity**: A genuine desire to understand business challenges, ask meaningful questions, and explore new possibilities.
* **Ownership and accountability**: A willingness to take responsibility, identify risks early, and follow through until issues are resolved.
* **Collaboration**: The ability to work effectively with customers, functional consultants, developers, and other stakeholders.
* **Practical problem-solving**: The judgment to recognize constraints while finding creative, achievable ways forward.
* **Customer focus**: A commitment to responsiveness, clear communication, professionalism, and earning customer trust.
* **Continuous learning**: An interest in emerging technologies, evolving SAP capabilities, and improving how solutions are delivered.

### **The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a business-oriented technical architect, natural problem solver, and trusted consultant who can move comfortably between business conversations, architectural decisions, and detailed technical discussions.

They understand the SAP technology ecosystem well enough to determine not simply how to build something, but whether it should be built, where it belongs, and which approach creates the greatest long-term value for the customer.

Most importantly, they combine technical expertise with curiosity, collaboration, sound judgment, and the accountability to see solutions through to successful delivery.

Title: Legal Counsel
Description:
Echelon contracts continuously: a portfolio of technology partners on structural, programme and referral agreements, MOUs and term sheets with defence and energy technology companies, customer Scopes of Work delivered by our forward deployed teams, and a share plan that reaches every employee.

We are looking for a qualified hands-on lawyer — admitted to practice, with the training that comes with it — who has drafted and negotiated the contracts behind technology and AI delivery services, understands how those businesses work, and has the head for it: one who would rather be the only counsel in the room than one of twenty. The legal function grows next year; you will have shaped how it works before it does.

**THE ROLE: WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
-------------------------------

You will run the day-to-day legal work of the group: drafting, negotiating and closing under the group’s standards, keeping the corporate house in order, and working with the General Counsel and external counsel on the matters that need them. The growing part of that work is services contracting: Echelon sells the expertise and time of its engineers, and the master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, staffing and subcontracting agreements under which they are deployed are heavily negotiated contracts the group signs. You will draft them, negotiate them and close them. Under the Delegation of Authority the CEO is the only signatory, so the quality of what reaches his desk is the whole of the job. Partnerships with technology companies require a different discipline: referral, revenue-share and reseller agreements, IP boundaries and exclusivity terms that must protect Echelon’s margin and position over the life of the relationship, not only the length of one engagement.

You will carry files from first draft to signature, hold Echelon’s positions on exclusivity, margin protection and first right of refusal for our forward deployed teams, and decide what needs the General Counsel and what does not. The method exists; you own the outcome inside it and decide the sequencing and the trade-offs, so that most files close on standard paper and the exceptions get the attention they deserve.

* **Services contracting:** Master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, and staffing and subcontracting agreements for our engineering services business — with customers, with the partners we deploy for and with the firms we deploy alongside. Large, recurring contracts, often negotiated on the other side’s paper: you draft, negotiate and close them.
* **Partner & commercial contracting:** NDAs, MOUs, term sheets, referral and revenue-share agreements, from first draft to signature through the DoA signature process.
* **Templates & playbooks:** The recurring instruments — partner referral agreement, Partner Revenue Share terms, Scope of Work, NDA, employment contract and amendment — so that most files close on standard paper.
* **Corporate housekeeping:** Board and shareholder resolutions, registers, the shareholders’ agreement and the share plan documentation for the holding company and the Saudi operating company, with the GNRC.
* **Employment & regulatory:** Contracts, performance-bonus amendments, policies and Saudi labour-law compliance with the People function; the regulatory perimeter around data, licensing and, with Echelon Defense Industries, clearance-bound activity.
* **Intellectual property:** Engineering IP held at group level, partner IP boundaries in every deployment, and the protection of Echelon-developed capability as it is productised.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - WHERE WE ALIGN**
-------------------------------------------

A hands-on lawyer who reads fast, drafts clean and marks uncertainty rather than inventing a position. You find contracts interesting because of what they make possible, not because of what they prevent.

* **Curiosity:** You want to understand the deal before you paper it: where the value sits, what the partner actually wants, what the technology does. You hold the position that protects it.
* **Speed of learning:** An unfamiliar instrument — a share plan, a referral agreement, a defence MOU — comes back from you as a workable draft, not as a list of questions.
* **Ownership & pace:** A file is yours from first draft to signature. You turn a term sheet in days and keep the corporate record current without being asked.
* **Judgement:** Pragmatic on commercial points, immovable on the ones that matter. You escalate the right things and explain why in three sentences.
* **Where you are:** A qualified lawyer — a law degree and admission to practice are required — based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE, with hands-on experience of delivery-services contracting — Scopes of Work, master services and subcontracting agreements — and a working understanding of the technology and AI sector; fluent legal drafting in English, with Arabic spoken and written. What you have closed counts for more than how many years you have been closing.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality :**You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* **Long-term builder:** You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.

**THE SEAT**
------------

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; open to candidates based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE  
**Languages:** English & Arabic fluent  
**Reporting:** Echelon CEO; dotted line to Echelon’s holding Legal Counsel department  
**Package:** A base salary with housing and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage.

**HOW WE WORK**
---------------

You start from the problem, not the precedent. You meet an unclear brief or an unfamiliar instrument with energy and a plan.

* **Curiosity:** You learn how the business and its technology really work, and keep learning as the deals and the law move.
* **Speed:** You move from brief to workable draft quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* **Rigour:** You check before you rely, read every clause you put forward for signature and can explain every position you take.
* **Confidence & humility:** You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* **Autonomy:** You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself.
* **Resourcefulness:** Missing documents, partial facts, an unfamiliar jurisdiction: you find a way with what is available.
* **Situational leadership:** You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* **A force multiplier:** Your templates, playbooks and clear guidance make every team you work with faster.
* **AI-native practice:** AI tools are part of how you research, draft and review, and you know where their output needs a lawyer’s check.

Title: Senior Cybersecurity Specialist - Saudi National
Description:
**Job Description**

The Cybersecurity Senior Specialist shall be responsible for the leadership, governance, assurance, and oversight of all cybersecurity activities. The role will ensure that cybersecurity requirements are defined, implemented, verified, and maintained throughout the project lifecycle, from design and procurement through testing, commissioning, handover and operations readiness.

The Cybersecurity Manager will provide strategic direction and management oversight across Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), railway control systems, communications systems, station systems and connected infrastructure to ensure cyber risks are identified, managed, and reduced to an acceptable level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Develop and implement the project cybersecurity management strategy and cybersecurity assurance framework.
* Establish cybersecurity governance arrangements across all project stakeholders.
* Lead cybersecurity working groups, technical reviews and management reporting activities.
* Act as the primary cybersecurity focal point for the project.

**Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Interface directly with RCRC regarding cybersecurity requirements, compliance activities and assurance reporting.
* Interface with the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) on matters relating to regulatory compliance and cybersecurity controls.
* Coordinate cybersecurity reviews with government agencies, Contractor, Metro Operators and other external stakeholders.
* Support cybersecurity audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.

**Project Delivery Assurance**

* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into project requirements, specifications, contracts and supplier deliverables.
* Verify cybersecurity requirements are appropriately addressed throughout system design, implementation, testing and commissioning.
* Review and approve cybersecurity documentation produced by contractors and suppliers.
* Monitor implementation of cybersecurity measures across all project packages and disciplines.

**Risk Management**

* Establish and maintain the project Cybersecurity Risk Register.
* Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities affecting project systems and assets.
* Ensure cybersecurity risks are addressed through appropriate mitigation measures and assurance evidence.
* Support risk acceptance and management decision-making processes.

**System and Operational Technology Security**

* Provide cybersecurity oversight of the Contractor for railway signalling, telecommunications, control systems, SCADA, networking infrastructure, station systems and operational technology environments.
* Ensure the Contractor provides appropriate segregation, protection and monitoring of critical operational networks.
* Review the Contractor’s cybersecurity architecture and defence-in-depth strategies and propose guidance.
* Support secure integration between operational and enterprise systems.

**Assurance and Compliance**

* Oversee and guide Contractor’s cybersecurity assurance management activities across the project lifecycle.
* Oversee cybersecurity testing, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and compliance verification activities with the Contractor.
* Ensure the Contractor develops quality cybersecurity case documentation and evidence required for project approvals.
* Support independent assessment and certification activities where required.

**Handover and Operational Readiness**

* Support the development of operational cybersecurity procedures and incident management arrangements.
* Ensure cybersecurity controls are fully implemented prior to system acceptance and handover.
* Coordinate cybersecurity readiness reviews for revenue service commencement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* Master's Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering Management or a related discipline is highly desirable.
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, IEC 62443 or equivalent are highly desirable.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 20 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, systems assurance, critical infrastructure, rail, transportation or major infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 10 years in a senior leadership or management role.
* Demonstrable experience delivering cybersecurity programmes on large-scale complex transportation, rail, metro, aviation, defence, utility or other critical infrastructure projects.
* Experience interfacing with government authorities, regulators, and owner organisations.
* Experience managing cybersecurity requirements through design, implementation, testing, and commissioning phases.
* Experience working within multi-contractor and international project environments.
* Previous Middle East or Saudi Arabia project experience is highly desirable.

**Knowledge Requirements**

* Saudi National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) frameworks, controls, and regulatory requirements.
* Cybersecurity risk management and assurance methodologies.
* Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity.
* Railway systems including signalling, communications, SCADA, AFC, PSDs and station systems.
* IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework and related standards.
* Cybersecurity governance, auditing and compliance management.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic leadership and stakeholder management.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Risk-based decision making.
* Regulatory engagement and compliance management.
* Technical understanding of critical infrastructure cybersecurity.
* Contract and supplier management.
* Report writing and executive-level communication.

**Security Clearance**

The successful candidate must be capable of obtaining and maintaining any project, client or governmental security clearances required for the execution of the role.

**Key Activities**

* Report on delivery status, risks and KPIs to the line manager.
* Escalate risks and issues that need a decision to senior management, with clear options and impact.
* Keep project details and documentation accurate and up to date.

* Validate the real urgency of each escalated request against business impact and evidence, and prioritise on facts rather than pressure.

* Keep working relationships constructive so that no dispute delays the company's delivery.
* Continuous improvement
* Identify recurring delays in the request flow and propose SR, form or process improvements.
* Run awareness sessions for product owners on how to request and prepare for hosting.

* Follow all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.

* Comply with all relevant information security practices and standards to ensure data integrity and confidentiality.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification is preferred.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification is preferred.

* 7+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure or Cloud environments, including 3+ years managing technical projects or service delivery.
* Working knowledge of data center and cloud hosting technologies, including virtualization using VMware, containers using OpenShift/Kubernetes, Red Hat Linux, networking, storage, and backup.
* Experience working with ITSM tools and processes, including Jira Service Management, SMAX, ServiceNow, or equivalent platforms.
* Practical understanding of ITIL Request, Change, and Incident Management concepts.
* Ability to review solution architecture diagrams and translate them into infrastructure requirements and bills of materials.
* Exposure to public cloud environments such as GCP, Microsoft Azure, or AWS is preferred, particularly within Saudi sovereign or regulated environments.
* Familiarity with NCA cybersecurity controls, including ECC and CCC, and Saudi data residency requirements is preferred.
* Experience with hosting cost estimation and capacity planning is preferred.
* Strong ownership, stakeholder management, structured communication, problem-solving, process improvement, conflict resolution, and customer management capabilities.

* Ability to maintain composure under pressure, manage exaggerated urgency objectively, and set realistic customer expectations without negatively impacting stakeholder relationships.
