Title: GRC Consultant
Description:
GRC Consultant – Governance, Risk and Compliance

**Company:** Fourth Command  
**Client:** Reputed Government Organization in Qatar  
**Job Location:** Qatar  
**Number of Vacancies:** 4  
**Experience Required:** 3–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, On-site  
**Employment Benefits:** Accommodation, Health Insurance and Employment Visa will be provided.

1. Job Overview

Fourth Command is seeking qualified and technically competent Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Consultants for a cybersecurity consulting engagement with a reputed government organization in Qatar.

The position requires strong technical and functional expertise in information security governance, cybersecurity risk management, regulatory compliance, security architecture, information security auditing, and cybersecurity training and awareness.

The selected candidates will be responsible for assessing the organization's cybersecurity posture, evaluating the effectiveness of security controls, identifying security and compliance deficiencies, developing governance frameworks, and recommending appropriate security improvements.

Candidates must possess a strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and cybersecurity technologies, with the ability to independently conduct assessments, manage stakeholder engagements, deliver cybersecurity training, and prepare professional consulting deliverables. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are mandatory.

2. Key Responsibilities2.1. Information Security Governance

* Develop, review, and maintain information security policies, procedures, standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks.
* Support the implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).
* Develop cybersecurity strategies, implementation roadmaps, governance processes, and security improvement plans.
* Establish information security roles, responsibilities, accountability mechanisms, and reporting processes.
* Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of information security policies and governance requirements.

2.2. Cybersecurity Risk Management

* Independently conduct enterprise-level, asset-level, application-level, process-level, and project-specific cybersecurity risk assessments.
* Identify cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, control deficiencies, and associated business and operational impacts.
* Develop and maintain risk assessment methodologies, cybersecurity risk registers, risk treatment plans, and risk acceptance documentation.
* Evaluate security control effectiveness and determine inherent and residual risk exposure.
* Recommend appropriate technical, administrative, and operational controls to mitigate identified risks.
* Monitor risk treatment activities, validate remediation effectiveness, and escalate critical or unresolved risks.

2.3. Regulatory Compliance and Security Audits

* Conduct compliance assessments, gap assessments, security maturity assessments, and internal information security audits against applicable national and international cybersecurity frameworks.
* Assess organizational compliance with ISO/IEC 27001, Qatar National Information Assurance (NIA), NIST CSF, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* Develop compliance matrices, control mappings, Statements of Applicability (SoA), audit reports, and corrective action plans.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, documentation reviews, technical walkthroughs, and evidence-based security control assessments.
* Support regulatory inspections, external audits, and cybersecurity certification initiatives.
* Monitor regulatory developments, track compliance deficiencies, and validate the implementation of corrective actions.

2.4. Security Architecture and Technical Security Assessments

* Review and assess enterprise security architecture, network architecture, infrastructure architecture, cloud architecture, and application security architecture.
* Interpret and evaluate network topology diagrams, solution architecture diagrams, data flows, system integrations, and security control placement.
* Identify architectural weaknesses, insecure configurations, inadequate security controls, and potential cybersecurity exposures.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for new technology implementations, infrastructure changes, applications, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Assess the implementation and effectiveness of technical security controls across the following domains:
* Network Security and Network Segmentation.
* Endpoint and Server Security.
* Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* Privileged Access Management (PAM).
* Cloud and Application Security.
* Data Security and Data Loss Prevention (DLP).
* Vulnerability and Patch Management.
* SIEM, SOAR, EDR and XDR.
* Security Monitoring and Incident Response.
* Encryption and Cryptographic Controls.
* System Hardening and Security Configuration.
* Backup and Disaster Recovery.
* Review vulnerability assessment reports, penetration testing reports, security configurations, and technical assessment findings to determine associated business risks.
* Evaluate cybersecurity technologies against organizational security requirements and recommend appropriate control enhancements.
* Apply Zero Trust, defense-in-depth, least privilege, and security-by-design principles during security architecture assessments.

2.5. Third-Party Risk Management and Data Privacy

* Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments of vendors, suppliers, service providers, and technology partners.
* Review third-party security practices, contractual cybersecurity requirements, and regulatory compliance obligations.
* Develop and maintain third-party risk registers, assessment reports, and remediation plans.
* Assess organizational data protection and privacy practices against applicable regulatory requirements.
* Develop and review data classification, information handling, data retention, and data protection requirements.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of data security controls and recommend appropriate corrective measures.

2.6. Business Continuity and Incident Management

* Review and assess Business Continuity Plans (BCP), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRP), and cybersecurity incident response plans.
* Support Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and evaluate Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Assess organizational preparedness for cybersecurity incidents and operational disruptions.
* Develop and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises, incident response simulations, and business continuity exercises.
* Review incident investigation findings, root cause analysis, and corrective action plans.

2.7. Cybersecurity Training and Awareness

* Develop, implement, and maintain organizational cybersecurity training and awareness programs.
* Independently prepare professional training materials, presentations, educational content, and cybersecurity awareness campaigns.
* Conduct cybersecurity training sessions for employees, management, technical personnel, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop role-based training programs aligned with organizational functions and associated cybersecurity risks.
* Conduct specialized workshops covering cybersecurity governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, data protection, and secure working practices.
* Support phishing simulation exercises and other cybersecurity awareness initiatives.
* Establish training schedules, performance indicators, and mechanisms to evaluate training effectiveness.

2.8. Security Performance Monitoring and Reporting

* Develop and maintain cybersecurity Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and security performance measurement frameworks.
* Prepare professional risk assessment reports, compliance reports, audit reports, and technical security assessment reports.
* Develop executive dashboards, management presentations, cybersecurity roadmaps, and periodic security performance reports.
* Monitor outstanding cybersecurity risks, compliance deficiencies, remediation activities, and security improvement initiatives.
* Present technical findings, business risks, and security recommendations to technical teams and senior management.

2.9. Stakeholder Management and Consulting

* Independently conduct client meetings, stakeholder interviews, technical discussions, and cybersecurity workshops.
* Coordinate with business functions, IT teams, cybersecurity teams, auditors, and senior management.
* Provide professional cybersecurity advisory services and technically feasible recommendations.
* Effectively communicate complex technical findings and cybersecurity risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage assigned consulting activities, project commitments, and deliverables in accordance with established timelines and quality standards.

3. Required Qualifications and Skills3.1. Education and Professional Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* A minimum of three years of directly relevant professional experience in GRC, information security consulting, cybersecurity risk management, or information security auditing.
* Demonstrable experience in independently conducting risk assessments, compliance assessments, information security audits, and technical security control reviews.
* Practical experience in developing security policies, procedures, risk registers, compliance matrices, and professional assessment reports.
* Experience in reviewing security architecture and evaluating technical cybersecurity controls.
* Experience in developing and delivering cybersecurity training, awareness sessions, and stakeholder workshops.
* Previous experience in client-facing consulting engagements, government organizations, or the GCC region will be an added advantage.

3.2. Knowledge of Standards and Regulatory Frameworks

Candidates must possess strong knowledge and practical understanding of relevant cybersecurity standards and regulatory frameworks, including:

* ISO/IEC 27001:2022 – Information Security Management Systems.
* ISO/IEC 27002 – Information Security Controls.
* ISO/IEC 27005 – Information Security Risk Management.
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0.
* Qatar National Information Assurance (NIA).
* Qatar National Information Security Compliance Framework (NISCF).
* Qatar Personal Data Privacy Protection Law.
* ISO 22301 – Business Continuity Management Systems.
* NIST SP 800-53 – Security and Privacy Controls.
* CIS Controls and CIS Benchmarks.
* COBIT – IT Governance and Management.

Practical knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001, cybersecurity risk management methodologies, and security control assessment practices is mandatory. Familiarity with Qatar-specific cybersecurity regulations is strongly preferred.

3.3. Technical Knowledge and Competencies

Candidates must demonstrate strong technical knowledge of enterprise IT infrastructure and cybersecurity technologies, including:

* Enterprise IT infrastructure, network architecture, security architecture, and system integrations.
* Networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, VLANs, VPNs, and network segmentation.
* Windows and Linux operating systems, Active Directory, authentication, authorization, and access management.
* Firewalls, WAF, IDS/IPS, Network Access Control (NAC), and secure remote access technologies.
* SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, and vulnerability management technologies.
* Cloud computing, virtualization, cloud security, and shared responsibility models.
* Application security, API security, and Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC).
* Data protection, encryption, system hardening, patch management, and secure configuration.
* Zero Trust, defense-in-depth, least privilege, and security-by-design principles.
* Cybersecurity threats, attack techniques, threat intelligence, and incident management.
* GRC platforms, security assessment tools, and reporting technologies.

Candidates must be capable of interpreting technical assessment findings, architecture diagrams, security configurations, and control implementation evidence.

**Candidates with experience limited to documentation or checklist-based compliance assessments, without adequate technical cybersecurity knowledge and practical assessment experience, will not be considered.**

3.4. Communication and Professional Skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are mandatory.
* Strong technical and business writing skills, with the ability to independently prepare professional, client-ready deliverables.
* Strong presentation and public speaking skills, with the ability to conduct training sessions and confidently engage with senior management and government stakeholders.
* Ability to effectively communicate and substantiate technical findings, cybersecurity risks, and security recommendations.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio or equivalent tools.
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to independently manage consulting responsibilities with minimal supervision.

4. Professional Certifications

Candidates possessing one or more of the following professional certifications will be given preference:

* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor.
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).
* Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC).
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
* ISO 22301 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer.
* CompTIA Security+.

Professional certifications must be supported by relevant practical experience and technical cybersecurity proficiency.

5. Working Model

This is a full-time, on-site cybersecurity consulting position supporting a reputed government organization in Qatar. The selected candidates will work from the designated client premises and coordinate directly with client stakeholders, technical teams, cybersecurity teams, and Fourth Command management.

Candidates must be willing to relocate to Qatar, independently manage assigned responsibilities, adhere to project delivery timelines, and maintain consistent quality across all deliverables.

Strict adherence to organizational policies, confidentiality obligations, government security protocols, and professional conduct requirements is expected throughout the engagement.

6. Employment Benefits

* Accommodation in Qatar.
* Health Insurance.
* Employment Visa.

7. Mindset and Commitment

Fourth Command is seeking disciplined, technically competent, and professionally mature cybersecurity consultants with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and commitment to delivering high-quality consulting services.

Candidates must demonstrate sound professional judgment, attention to detail, professional integrity, and the ability to independently address cybersecurity and regulatory challenges. A proactive approach to security improvement, stakeholder management, and continuous professional development is essential for success in this position.

Title: Physiotherapist
Description:
Physiotherapists treat patients with physical difficulties resulting from illness, injury, disability or ageing. They treat people of all ages including children, the elderly, stroke patients and people with sports injuries . They work with patients to identify and improve their movement and function. They help promote their patients' health and wellbeing and assist the rehabilitation process by developing and restoring body systems, in particular the neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, cardiovascular and respiratory systems. They devise and review treatment programs, comprising manual therapy, movement, therapeutically exercise and the application of technological equipment, e.g. IDD therapy. Physiotherapists also provide advice on how to prevent injury.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corresponding Key Activities performed by the role**

  

**Managerial**

* Maintaining sufficient inventory of material supplies and equipment for performance of duties

  + Reporting shortage of materials to supervisor at earliest convenience, maintaining records for ordering and replenishments

  

**Technical**

* Undertake duties in accordance with the philosophy, business practices and policies of NMCRH-DIP, and practicing within the standards and ethics of the Physiotherapy profession typical work activities include :

  + Working with patients to identify physical problems.

    - Developing and reviewing treatment programs.
    - Assisting patients with joint and spinal problems, especially following surgery.
    - Helping patients' rehabilitation following accidents, injury and stroke.
    - Writing patient case notes and reports.
    - Collecting patient statistics.
    - Educating and advising patients and their cares about how to prevent and/or improve conditions.
  + Working as a professional member of a multi-disciplinary rehabilitation team and actively participating in team meetings.

  + Effectively communicating with staff members, health professionals, clients and family with regards to provision of physiotherapy services.
  + Contributing to, and participating in, education programs for residents, relatives and staff.
  + Participating in continuing education and courses updating Physiotherapy techniques and information.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy equipment is adequately maintained and liaising with the head of department for the ordering of supplies and equipment.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy treatments are based on sound evidence of benefit.
  + Ensuring all adverse clinical events are recorded and reported.
  + Maintaining a safe work environment.
  + Assisting in the on-going maintenance of a safe work place through involvement in the implementation of safe systems of work.
  + Identifying and reporting hazards in the workplace.
  + Participating in Quality Management System and commitment to processes of continuous improvement activities, including auditing, surveys and needs analysis.
  + Other duties as directed by the Head of Department.

  

**Quality and Safety**

* Promoting and maintaining quality in all services and ensure continuous quality improvement measures are in place. Conduct method evaluation/ development as per standard policies and procedures

  + Complying with all safety and quality control programs and procedures as applicable
  + Complying with applicable precautions for environmental safety, infection control, using a series of interventions that minimize or prevent cross infections
  + Ensuring that safety procedures and quality assurance tests are maintained within all sections
  + Comply and support clinical audit processes within the service and report on these as agreed
  + Communicating in a professional and courteous manner with patients, family and other medical personnel as necessary to obtain information for laboratory records, explain procedures, clarify orders and communicate status.

  

**Continuous Education**

* Participating in education sessions for department staff, doctors and nurses on the safe and secure handling of equipment, i.e teaching, induction, peer review, case studies, and clinical presentations

  + Participating in department programs/ committees, various hospital committees, and staff meeting (when requested)
  + Participating in the orientation and training of new employees
  + Maintaining professional knowledge by attending lectures, seminars or on-line education sessions
  + Completing and maintaining all regulatory requirements including licensure and certification and other mandatory training within established time frames.
  + The ability to apply technical skills, together with a demonstrable knowledge of and interest in sciences, such as anatomy, physiology and physics;

  

**Occupational Safety and Health Management Systems**

* Comply with all OSH and infection control policies, standards and procedures and cooperate with hospital management to comply those requirements

  + Notifying OSH Hazards, incidents, Near misses and issues and assistance with the preparation of risk assessments, incident reports
  + Attend applicable OSH/Infection control training programs, mock drills and awareness programs
  + Comply with reasonable OSH instructions, policies and safe working procedures
  + Use of appropriate personal protective equipment and safety systems.
  + Be familiar with emergency and evacuation procedures
  + Not wilfully or recklessly endanger anyone’s health and safety
  + Comply with Waste management procedures and policies. Reduce, Reuse, Recycling of waste as much as possible
  + Attend all OSH Trainings, awareness programs and mock drills.
  + Participates in the OSHMS audits, inspections, ensuring standards are maintained

  

**Prevention and Control of Infection (PCI):**

* PCI is everyone’s responsibility. All staff are required to read and implement the NMC PCI Policy and Strategy in an effort to maintain the highest possible standards of cleanliness at all times, thus reducing the risk of infection in patients, staff and visitors.

  + The strictest hand hygiene, 5 moments of hand hygiene, bare below the elbows and environmental care, will be expected of all staff, including the post holder, at all times

  

**Qualification, Licensure, Experience and Special Skills:**

* Demonstrated commitment to quality outcomes and ability to consult with staff regarding continuous improvement.
* Sound computer skills including knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel.

  

**Experience required in addition to the Qualifications mentioned above**

**Required:**

Currently licensed in country of origin and with DHA license to practice in Dubai U.A.E.

  

**Specialist Certification**

**Required:** NA

**Desired:** NA

  

**Additional requirements**

Title: Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting
Description:
### **Welcome to PxGeo**

PxGeo is an international offshore geophysical services company providing seismic data acquisition and related services to the energy industry. The Group operates across multiple jurisdictions with a head office in Dubai and manages projects in a complex and highly regulated environment.

PxGeo’s operations involve an extensive international supply chain, including vessel chartering, specialist equipment and technology, offshore services, logistics, and a broad range of suppliers and contractors. The Legal function supports commercial arrangements across multiple countries and legal frameworks, with a significant proportion of the Group’s contracts governed by English law.

### **What's the role?**

Official job title is Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting and will be based in Dubai, UAE.

This position provides senior-level legal support to PxGeo’s commercial, operational and Supply Chain activities.

The role will take ownership of complex and strategically important commercial agreements, provide practical and commercially focused legal advice throughout the contracting lifecycle, and support the development of consistent contracting standards across the Group.

The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, Technical Solutions, Finance, Supply Chain, Sales and other business functions. The role requires the ability to lead contractual negotiations independently, identify and communicate material legal and commercial risks, and develop workable solutions that support PxGeo’s operational objectives while appropriately protecting the Group’s interests. Key responsibilities include:  
  
**Commercial Contracting**

* Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value and strategically significant commercial agreements.
* Provide legal support in connection with contracts relating to:
* + offshore and seismic services; vessel chartering and marine services;
  + specialist equipment and technology; equipment supply, rental, hire and leasing;
  + agency, logistics, freight and transportation; consultancy and contractor services;
  + software, technology and licensing; framework and master services agreements;
  + purchase orders and associated contractual documentation; and
  + other operational and project-related arrangements.
* Lead negotiations with customers, suppliers, contractors and other commercial counterparties.
* Review and negotiate amendments to PxGeo’s Terms & Conditions.
* Review and negotiate counterparties’ standard terms where PxGeo’s contractual documentation cannot be used.
* Advise on contractual structures and appropriate risk allocation, including:
* + liability and indemnities; consequential and indirect loss;
  + warranties and performance obligations; insurance requirements;
  + intellectual property and data rights; payment and security arrangements;
  + delivery, acceptance and delay; liquidated damages;
  + suspension and termination; force majeure;
  + regulatory compliance; governing law and dispute resolution.
* Provide practical advice on contractual interpretation, contract performance and operational issues arising during project delivery.
* Support the management and resolution of commercial claims and disputes before escalation to formal proceedings.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel where specialist or jurisdiction-specific advice is required.

**Business and Project Support**

* Act as a senior Legal point of contact for commercial and operational matters.
* Work closely with business teams to understand the technical, operational and commercial context of proposed arrangements.
* Participate in project, tender and negotiation meetings where legal input is required.
* Support the identification and management of contractual risks during the tendering, negotiation, mobilisation and performance stages.
* Advise management on material contractual exposures and available mitigation measures.
* Support the development of negotiation strategies for complex or sensitive matters.
* Promote early engagement with Legal so that material risks are identified before commercial positions are agreed.

**Contracting Standards and Legal Processes**

* Support the development, maintenance and implementation of PxGeo’s standard contracts, templates, contractual guidance and fallback positions.
* Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of commercial contracting processes.
* Support efficient workflows and escalation routes between Legal and other functions.
* Provide guidance and support to Legal Counsel/Paralegal and other members of the Legal team on commercial contracting matters.
* Deliver practical training to relevant business functions on contractual risk and contracting procedures.
* Support with other commercial, corporate or strategic matters as required.

### **Who are we looking for?**

* Qualified lawyer with substantial 9+ post-qualification experience, although the quality and relevance of experience will be more important than the precise number of years.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LLB) or Master’s Degree in Law (LLM). English law qualification is desirable but not essential, provided the candidate has strong practical experience with common law commercial contracts.
* Strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial agreements governed by English law or based on English common law principles.
* Demonstrated ability to lead contractual negotiations independently and engage effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external counterparties.
* Detailed understanding of commercial risk allocation.
* Ability to understand technical and operational requirements and translate them into workable contractual arrangements.
* Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material legal risks from matters that can be managed operationally.
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex and time-sensitive matters with limited supervision.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous:
* + energy or oil and gas; offshore services; seismic or geophysical services; marine or shipping; vessel chartering; procurement and Supply Chain contracting; or international project-based operations.
* Previous in-house experience within an international, operational or project-based organisation would be a strong advantage.

**The Position**

The Counsellor, Building Healthy Families, works primarily with the Peel Children’s Aid Society to offer African Canadian clients culturally-appropriate interventions and services designed to assist families through various domestic difficulties and stressors, which may have culminated in child protection issues. These issues range from parenting capacity problems, child physical and sexual abuse, adult conflict, parent/child conflict, anger management, addictions and mental health.

Title: ELV & Starlink Installation Technician
Description:
**About Starway Link**

Starway Link is a UAE telecom and infrastructure company headquartered in Deira, Dubai. We install Starlink satellite dish antennas for business customers as a Starlink installation subcontractor, and deliver ELV (Extra Low Voltage) systems for offices, retail outlets and commercial buildings. Starway Link is a SIRA-approved contractor for CCTV supply and installation.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on installation technician to carry out Starlink satellite installations and ELV works at customer sites. The technician will survey sites, install and terminate equipment, configure and test systems, hand over to the customer, and complete all job documentation (work order completion forms, photos and test records). The role needs someone who is safe working at height, neat with cabling, comfortable dealing with customers, and able to work independently on site.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Starlink Installation***

* Conduct site surveys using the Starlink app to check for a clear sky view, obstructions and the best mounting position.
* Install Starlink dishes on roofs, walls, poles and parapets using the correct mounts (pole, wall, pivot, non-penetrating ridgeline or ballast).
* Route, protect and seal outdoor cables; drill and seal wall penetrations properly to prevent water ingress.
* Install and configure the Starlink router, power supply and, where required, Ethernet adapters, mesh units or third-party routers and switches.
* Activate and test the service: signal, speed test, Wi-Fi coverage and connected devices. Explain basic use to the customer.
* Complete the work order completion form and before/after photos for each job and get the customer's sign-off.
* Attend service calls for relocation, obstruction issues, cable faults and equipment replacement.

***ELV Systems***

* **CCTV:** Install IP cameras, NVRs, PoE switches and monitors; configure recording, remote viewing (mobile app) and user accounts. Follow SIRA requirements for camera coverage, recording retention and documentation.
* **Structured cabling:** Pull, terminate and label Cat6/Cat6A cables; install patch panels, racks and cabinets; test and certify links.
* **Containment:** Planning for GI conduits, trunking, cable trays and back boxes as per site requirement.
* **Network & Wi-Fi:** Install and configure switches, routers and access points.
* **Audio / BGM / paging:** Install speakers, amplifiers and volume/zone controls; test and balance audio.
* **Access control & intercom:** Install readers, electric locks, exit buttons, controllers and video intercoms; enrol users and test.
* Read and work from layout drawings and BOQs; mark up as-built changes.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on existing ELV systems.

***Site Survey & Documentation***

* Survey sites before quotation: count existing equipment, check what can be reused, measure cable runs and note access issues.
* Share survey findings and material lists with the team for quotations.
* Keep records of serial numbers, MAC addresses, IP addresses and passwords of installed devices and update the company device register.
* Prepare test reports, handover documents and as-built notes.

***Safety & Site Conduct***

* Follow site HSE rules, building management rules and permit-to-work requirements (mall, tower and landlord permits).
* Use PPE and work-at-height equipment (harness, ladders, scaffold) correctly.
* Keep tools, materials and company vehicle (if assigned) in good condition; report stock used on each job.
* Leave every site clean and tidy after work.

***Customer Service***

* Behave professionally with customers, building security and facility managers.
* Explain the completed work and basic operation to the customer at handover.
* Report customer requests or upsell opportunities (internet, SIM, PBX, CCTV upgrades) to the sales team.

**Requirements**

***Qualifications & Experience***

* Diploma / ITI / technical certificate in Electronics, Electrical, Telecom or Networking.
* 2–4 years' experience in ELV installation (CCTV, structured cabling, networking); UAE / GCC experience preferred.
* Experience with outdoor installations is a strong advantage.
* Valid UAE driving licence preferred.

***Technical Skills***

* CCTV brands such as Dahua and Hikvision.
* Cat6 termination, punch-down, crimping, cable testing and labelling.
* Basic networking: IP addressing, DHCP, PoE, VLANs, Wi-Fi configuration.
* Use of hand and power tools: drills, hammer drill, crimpers, testers, ladders.
* Ability to read layout drawings and simple single-line diagrams.
* Basic computer and smartphone use for apps, reports and photos.

***Personal Skills***

* Safe and confident working at height and outdoors in UAE weather.
* Neat, organised workmanship.
* Good communication in English.
* Punctual, reliable and able to work independently or in a team.
* Flexible to work evenings, weekends or outside office hours when sites require it.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Jobs completed on time and right first time (no repeat visits).
* Complete job documentation submitted the same day (completion form, photos, test results).
* Zero safety incidents.
* Customer satisfaction and sign-off on handover.
* Accurate material usage and stock reporting.

**Salary**

* To be decided in interview

rt, multi-airport hub in Dubai and adapt to our customers ever-changing needs.

Ensure that all activities take place in an effective and efficient manner so as to ensure all **freighter and charter services** are adequately covered especially at times of schedule disruptions, schedule adjustments, additional operations and new route introductions.

  When special charter flights are operated, the job holder is required to travel to outstations, especially off-line stations and/or stations that do not have freighter expertise, to ensure all operational activity in relation to the charter is performed according to company standards and customer's satisfaction.

  **Support the operational planning and coordination of ad-hoc charter flights, ensuring all stakeholder requirements are met before, during and after operation.**
* DEVELOPMENT & ANALYSIS:

  Provide information on the profitability of all ad-hoc freighter operations, charter operations and diversions ensuring that information related to such operations are communicated to all relevant internal departments.

  **Prepare analysis and reporting on charter performance, operational efficiency and profitability to support management decision-making.**

  Independently handle special projects as directed by Manager Freighter Operations & Charters, Manager Freighter Analysis & Development or Cargo Scheduling & Planning Manager.

Should have completed approved Cargo Acceptance and Handling courses including Special Cargo Handling and Acceptance, Cargo Product Knowledge, Advanced Load Control and Freighter Load Control.

Excellent communication & IT skills.

Should have sound analytical skills.

**Job Purpose**
  
Lead development and optimization of public bus schedules, systems, and ensure reliability to deliver efficient, integrated, and customer-focused services across the network. **Roles and Responsibilities**
  
**Strategy**
  

* Develop bus schedules that reflect Public Transport Agency strategic objectives and enable seamless integration with metro and other transit modes in line with defined processes.
* Supervise required reserve ratios of buses and drivers using actual performance data and international best practices to maintain sufficient operational resilience and service continuity.
* Determine requirements for advanced scheduling systems, AI platforms, and related technical programs, leading proofs of concept and roadmaps that enhance network planning, OCC integration, and scheduling capabilities.
* Export error free scheduling system data to technical systems in other departments within the agreed timeline.

**Operations**
  

* Prepare and maintain detailed bus schedules in RTA systems that meet quality standards, stakeholder requirements, and agreed timelines across all public transport lines.
* Ensure concerned departments receive timely notifications of service changes so they can arrange required buses, drivers, maintenance activities, transportation systems updates, and customer service resources.
* Develop and export system technical requirements and operational data for the public transport network to RTA systems.
* Maintain comprehensive, up-to-date information on bus services, including routes, timetables, fares, conditions of carriage, destination boards, and passenger information displays.
* Ensure scheduling system availability, correct security-level user access, and resolution of GIRO scheduling system issues through coordination with IT teams, vendors, and technical committees.
* Coordinate with managers, staff, and representatives on scheduling information, system improvements, administrative tasks, and provide responses to Tarasul letters and CRMrelated matters as required.
* Manage events, manual and unplanned schedule changes by preparing implementation plans and prepare service changes notices.
* Ensure the system availability to the schedulers at the appropriate security level (system user access).
* Deploy scheduling staff and surveyors with bus drivers before and after network changes to inform passengers, brief depots, and gather feedback on diversions, roadworks, and operational issues.

**Product / Process Improvement**
  

* Support to evaluate service reliability by comparing planned and actual running times, conducting field surveys and route recces, and analysing OCC data to recommend improvements and OTP dashboards.
* Update and develop the scheduling system and associated technologies to include geographic maps and bus lines and to support new systems, TSD enhancements, electric buses, and the OCC roadmap.
* Create and maintain public bus network and operations databases in the scheduling system, and provide performance, OTP, and service change reports to PTA stakeholders.
* Coordinate with scheduling system vendor, in case of any difficulties in system performance on its various modules.
* Coordinate with managers, staff, and representatives regarding the provision of scheduling information and system improvements.

**Physical Working Conditions**
  

* Work mainly in an office environment using scheduling systems, with weekly site visits to routes, depots, OCC, and stations for surveys and stakeholder meetings.

* Core Engineering Principles
* Survey Design

Title: Electrical Superintendent F/H
Description:
Deep-Water Intake Group,  
a joint venture of multiple subsidiaries of the VINCI Group, construction worldwide leader, specialized in the design and construction of major civil engineering and building works in Canada is hiring an  
  
**Electrical Superintendent**  
  
**What is the project?**  
  
The Pickering Nuclear Generating Station refurbishment program involves designing and building a new deep-water intake in Lake Ontario to improve the plant's cooling system. This will involve:  
A 1.5 km-long tunnel, built by a pressurized TBM (10.5 m diameter slurry TBM);  
Two vertical shafts (onshore and offshore);  
An offshore modular intake structure, resting on the lake bed.  
  
The project is distinguished by its proximity to an active nuclear site, requiring rigorous standards of safety, planning and coordination.  
  
**What you will do:**  
  
The electrical superintendent is part of the plant department and reports to the deputy plant manager and plant manager. Joining the project at the early stage of the execution phase he or she will be responsible for planning, coordinating, supervising, and inspecting all electrical activities associated with the project including installation works, production support, maintenance, modifications and dismantling.  
  
**Concretely your tasks will be:**

* Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all electrical activities on the project.
* Responsible to setup, launch and develop electrical site installations for all sites
* Lead and supervise electrical foremen, electricians, technicians, and subcontractors engaged in the installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems
* Ensure all personnel working on electrical systems are adequately trained, qualified and authorized.
* Ensure compliance with project QHSE requirements, Canadian Standards in Ontario and client requirements.
* Review and approve Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS), and electrical risk assessments
* Conduct regular site inspections, audits of the electrical installations and works.
* Participate in incident investigations, root cause analyses, and implementation of corrective actions
* Coordinate electrical interfaces with tunnelling, shaft construction, ground treatment, soil processing, marine operations, and other project disciplines.
* Develop and monitor electrical work plans, schedules, resource requirements, and procurement activities.
* Ensure adequate temporary power distribution systems are installed, maintained, and adapted to evolving project needs.
* Act as the primary technical authority and point of contact for all project electrical matters.
* Ensure electrical installations comply with project specifications, applicable codes, standards, and engineering requirements.
* Verify completion of inspections, testing, commissioning, and acceptance procedures.
* Review and approve electrical shop drawings, technical submittals

**Your skills**

* Engineering Degree
* Solid knowledge of design and visualizations software such as AutoCAD or similar
* Strong knowledge of the Ontario Electrical Safety Code, Canadian
* Electrical Code, and applicable CSA standards
* Extensive experience supervising electrical construction and commissioning activities on industrial, infrastructure, mining, tunnelling, or heavy civil projects
* Experience with medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems, power distribution, grounding, protection, and control systems.
* Experience with transformers, switchgear, substations, generators, motor control centres (MCCs), instrumentation, and control systems.
* Familiarity with commissioning processes and electrical testing protocols.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and construction contracts.
* Understanding of construction sequencing, logistics constraints, and temporary works requirements

What do we have to provide:

* Gross annual salary between CAD$ 175K and 215 depending on experience and profile
* 4 vacation weeks & 3 emergency/sickness days paid;
* Annual bonuses;
* Group Health Insurance (premium participation including virtual health care system);
* RRSP Program
* Career development opportunities;
* A cosmopolite and inclusive work environment;
* Attractive and challenging project.

At Deep-Water Intake Group, we believe that diversity is a source of wealth and strength. We are committed to creating an inclusive working environment where every individual is valued and respected. We strongly encourage applications from members of Aboriginal communities and strive to ensure fair and respectful employment opportunities. We recognise the unique contributions of indigenous peoples and are committed to supporting their professional development. By joining our team, you will be part of a company that celebrates diversity and actively works to promote inclusion.

**Senior Associate - Product Solutions (Credit & Compliance)**

**Location:** Dubai

**About the Role**

We are looking for a strong Product Specialist to join our Product team at YubiMENA. The ideal candidate understands banking credit, risk, and compliance, and knows how products are designed around them. This person sits between clients, sales, and product engineering. They translate each bank's or lender's regulatory, credit, and risk requirements, along with its existing systems, into a configured solution that can be scoped, priced, and delivered.

They will be the main technical and regulatory voice for clients during pre-sales and implementation, and will turn complex requirements into solutions that product and delivery teams can build.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client discovery and requirements**

  

* Lead discovery workshops with credit, risk, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand regulatory obligations, risk appetite, and current controls.
* Map regulatory and compliance requirements to product capabilities, covering understanding the obligations, translating them into functional requirements, and tracing each one to the product feature that satisfies it.
* Identify gaps between client needs and the current product, and document them clearly for the product roadmap.

**Solution design**

  

* Design end-to-end solution architectures covering credit origination, underwriting and decisioning, risk monitoring, AML/CFT screening, KYC onboarding, and regulatory reporting, including integration with core banking, onboarding, and payments systems.
* Define configuration approaches for risk-based rules, scoring models, thresholds, and workflows, and explain the trade-offs between them.
* Produce solution documentation: design documents, data flow diagrams, integration specifications, and configuration guides.

**Pre-sales and proposals**

  

* Support sales with technical deep-dives, demos, and proof-of-concept scoping.
* Lead the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs, and security or regulatory questionnaires.
* Estimate implementation effort, timelines, and resource needs, and flag risks early.

**Implementation handover**

  

* Hand off solution designs to delivery and engineering with clear acceptance criteria.
* Support UAT planning and resolve design questions that come up during implementation.
* Contribute reusable patterns and accelerators back to the product team.

**Product input**

  

* Work with Product Management to prioritize features based on client demand, credit policy needs, and regulatory change.
* Track regulatory and credit policy updates and advise on their product impact, including new reporting templates, thresholds, and typology changes.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

  

* 6 to 10 years of experience in banking, with a focus on credit, risk or compliance, including at least 3 years in a solution, pre-sales, implementation, or product-facing role.
* Hands-on experience in credit and compliance processes (underwriting, credit assessment, credit risk, or credit monitoring) and/or financial crime compliance (AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC/CDD) within banks.
* Working knowledge of UAE and GCC regulatory frameworks, including CBUAE requirements.
* Experience designing, configuring, or implementing banking systems such as credit decisioning, risk scoring, transaction monitoring, screening, or case management platforms.
* Ability to write clear solution documents and explain technical concepts to both business stakeholders and engineers.
* Experience running workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders, including CCOs, CROs, and credit heads.
* Strong analytical skills, with comfort working with transaction or portfolio data and tuning metrics such as approval rates, default rates, and false positive rates.

**Preferred Background**

  

* 10 years of banking experience in Dubai or the UAE, in credit, risk or compliance roles.
* Experience in a product department at a bank, or in product design, product management, or solutioning.
* Current or recent experience at an AI-first, tech-forward fintech or financial institution in Dubai, with a prior background in traditional banking.

* Develops and maintains operationally robust schedules across the relevant planning windows, ensuring alignment with the approved Operating Plan and available aircraft, crew and maintenance resources.
* Oversees schedule changes within the tactical planning window and coordinates implementation with Network Control, Engineering Planning, Crew Planning, Airport Services, outstations and Commercial teams.
* Assesses planned aircraft rotations and recommends adjustments that improve aircraft and crew utilisation, operational resilience, connectivity, revenue opportunity and cost efficiency.
* Develops and implements schedule recovery and disruption-mitigation options in response to operational constraints, including aircraft availability, maintenance requirements, crew limitations, airport restrictions and Notice to Airmen (NOTAMs).

* Develops and maintains cargo schedules in Sabre AirVision, ensuring flight details, frequencies, timings, aircraft assignments and operating patterns are accurately created and controlled.

Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

External job description  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Do you want to manage supplier relationships in the invoice payment lifecycle? Do you consider yourself well-versed in the world of telecom billing reconciliation, Accounts Payable, program management and vendor relationships? If so, the AWS Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development (GCID) Business Operations team at Amazon is looking for an experienced professional to provide support of payment, operations and capacity by managing the invoice to payment lifecycle for our global backbone, interconnect and metro fiber circuits increasing our capability to optimize network cost efficiency around the world.  
  
As part of the Business Operations team, you’ll use the levers of process and technology to help our GCID team influence and hold supplier partners accountable.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Vendor Management – on-boarding new suppliers including sharing of GCID requirements via supplier welcome package and set-up guidance in our approvals and payable systems. Maintain relationships with vendors to ensure invoicing/payment procedures are clearly understood, documented and accurately managed.
* Drive On-Time Payments - Provide ongoing support ensuring timely vendor payments by reviewing & approving invoices, avoiding late fees, resolution of disputes, prompt acceptance of credits, expense monitoring and cross-functional process improvements
* Controllership of Networking Spend – Optimize cost efficiency of the business by reviewing and understanding service level agreements (SLA), keeping vendors aligned to contractual rates, raising and recovering SLA credit requests.
* Maintain Accountability – influence others and hold responsible individuals accountable for issues resolution. Know when to involve the appropriate business partners, when to escalate and who to engage for effective resolution.

  
A day in the life  
You will work closely with supplier partners, AP, Finance and Business Development to ensure AWS network costs are closely tracked, easily understood, and managed YoY.  

* You'll be empowered to think big, influence and exercise ownership over your solutions.
* You’ll interface with various levels within AWS as well as external vendors, to influence decisions and manage expectations
* You'll be a trusted resource for GCID and will be a key member of a team of innovative program managers to extend impact across the organization.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
* Experience leading process improvements
* Experience supporting accounting/finance customers to set and effectively manage expectations, project deliverables, and drive resolution when conflicts or issues arise
* Experience with telecom expense management (TEM), including invoice auditing, cost allocation, and spend optimization

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in program or project management
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in contract management
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

Title: SVP, IT Operations
Description:
**SUMMARY**

The Senior Vice President, IT Operations is accountable for the stability, performance, resilience, secure operation and continuous improvement of the technology environment that supports BGIS operations and the business-critical solutions we deliver to our clients. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this executive leads four operational domains: Application Support, Infrastructure (including Service Desk and End User Support), Financial Application Support, and the Legacy Software Development Platform (operational enhancements). The individual sets the operational strategy and service model for these domains, directs a team of directors, managers and technical professionals across onshore and offshore teams, and partners with business unit leaders, client-facing teams and vendors to ensure that services meet or exceed contractual SLAs and client expectations. The individual drives a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement, using automation, standardization, data-driven KPI management and modern IT service management practices to increase reliability, reduce cost, and improve the client and end-user experience. The role is a member of the IT leadership team and reports regularly to senior and executive management on operational performance, risk and investment priorities.

**KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

Leadership

Directs the IT Operations organization through a team of directors and managers, spanning onshore, offshore and third-party resources across all four domains.

Demonstrates strong, competent leadership for team members to guide them in reaching their full potential and meeting their objectives, which supports achievement of our corporate goals. Specifically, these responsibilities include but not limited to:

* Full involvement with recruiting talent.
* Provides mentoring, coaching and guidance to all team members.
* Objectively recommends compensation adjustments.
* Manages all aspects of performance.
* Builds leadership bench strength and succession plans across all four IT Operations domains.
* Develops the technical capabilities of the organization, including reskilling and upskilling staff for cloud, automation and AI-enabled operations.
* Defines the workforce and sourcing strategy, determining the right balance of in-house, offshore and managed service resources.
Fosters an environment of teamwork, accountability, innovation and client service to meet business objectives.  

IT Operations Strategy & Service Excellence

* Defines and executes the multi-year IT Operations strategy and roadmap, aligned with BGIS business objectives, client commitments and the broader IT strategy.
* Partners with the Chief Technology Officer and Architecture to shape the enterprise technology roadmap and standards, and leads the operational integration of acquired businesses and new technology platforms.
* Holds overall accountability for the availability, performance and resiliency of business-critical solutions that support our clients, ensuring contractual SLAs and KPIs are consistently met or exceeded.
* Establishes a unified operating model, service catalogue and support structure (L1-L3) across Application Support, Infrastructure, Financial Application Support and the Legacy Software Development Platform.
* Establishes demand intake, prioritization and resource capacity planning across all four domains, balancing day-to-day operations, operational projects, CISO-requested security work and client commitments, and ensures operational projects are delivered on time, on budget and with minimal service disruption.
* Establishes governance for ITSM processes, including incident, major incident, problem, change, release, configuration and request management, and ensures timely root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Ensures 24x7 operational coverage for business-critical services, including monitoring and event management, and on-call and after-hours support.
* Serves as the executive escalation point for critical client-impacting incidents; directs response, client communication and post-incident reviews.
* Builds relationships with senior business unit leaders and client-facing teams to understand business direction, anticipate operational needs and manage expectations.
* Provides service performance insights to account and client-facing teams to inform client governance discussions and shape the support model, and ensures IT services comply with client contractual, audit and data protection requirements.
* Establishes and enforces IT Operations policies, standards and procedures, and ensures adherence to enterprise IT standards (i.e. Security, IT Governance, Service Management, Architecture).
* Manages operational risks through mitigation strategies, and plans or implements contingencies where necessary.
Provides regular reporting to senior and executive management on SLA and KPI performance, operational risk, capacity and investment priorities.  

Application Support

* Directs the support, maintenance and operational health of the enterprise and client-facing application portfolio, including integrations, middleware and SaaS platforms.
* Ensures applications that support client service delivery are monitored, supported and maintained to meet defined service levels and business continuity requirements.
* Partners with Business Technology, product and development teams to ensure smooth transition of new solutions into production support, including defining operational acceptance criteria early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Sets the strategy for application lifecycle management, including patching, upgrades, license compliance, and the rationalization and decommissioning of redundant applications.
Oversees database administration and data operations, including performance, backup and restore, and data retention, in line with BGIS and client requirements.  

Infrastructure & End User Support

* Leads the strategy, engineering and operation of the infrastructure environment, including data centre and cloud platforms, servers, storage, networks and telephony.
* Directs the Service Desk and End User Support functions, including end-user computing, mobile devices, collaboration tools and field support, ensuring a consistent, high-quality experience for employees and client-facing staff.
* Ensures infrastructure capacity, performance and resiliency meet current and future business and client requirements.
* Owns IT disaster recovery and partners with the Business Continuity Planning (BCP) team to ensure IT systems meet BCP objectives; ensures DR plans are documented and tested regularly.
* Establishes IT asset and configuration management practices, including hardware and software asset lifecycle and an accurate configuration management database (CMDB).
Advances infrastructure modernization, including cloud adoption, observability, AIOps and infrastructure automation.  

Financial Application Support

* Directs the operation, support and operational enhancement of the financial application landscape (e.g. ERP, general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, billing, procurement and related integrations).
* Partners with Finance leadership to ensure financial systems reliably support month-end, quarter-end and year-end close, client billing and financial reporting cycles.
* Ensures appropriate IT general controls, segregation of duties and audit readiness in support of internal controls over financial reporting and internal and external audit requirements.
Establishes governance with Finance stakeholders for prioritizing financial system changes, enhancements and upgrades.  

Legacy Software Development Platform (Operational Enhancements)

* Leads the team responsible for sustaining and enhancing legacy and custom-developed software platforms that continue to support business-critical operations and client solutions.
* Establishes the intake and prioritization framework for operational enhancements, defect fixes and minor changes, balancing business value, risk and capacity.
* Ensures sound software change management practices, including source control, release and deployment management, testing, quality assurance and release sign-off.
Reduces technical debt and operational risk of legacy platforms, and partners with Architecture and Business Technology to define modernization, migration or retirement roadmaps.  

Security & Compliance Support

* Partners with the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), delivering the technology work required for security projects and programs as they are raised.
* Ensures operational security practices are consistently executed across IT Operations in accordance with CISO-defined policies, including access management, vulnerability and patch management, backup and secure configuration.
* Supports the CISO during security incidents by providing technical response, recovery and remediation resources.
Supports compliance, certification and client audit activities by providing operational evidence and remediating identified gaps.  

Continuous Improvement

* Champions a culture of continuous improvement, using operational data, trend analysis and client feedback to identify and remove recurring issues and inefficiencies.
* Drives automation, self-service, standardization and AI-enabled tooling to improve service quality, speed of resolution and cost-effectiveness.
* Ensures knowledge management, runbooks and documentation practices are maintained across all IT Operations domains to enable shift-left resolution, self-service and reduced reliance on key individuals.
* Establishes meaningful, business-focused KPIs and dashboards for each domain and uses them to set improvement targets and measure progress.
* Introduces and matures industry best practices (e.g. ITIL, Lean, SRE and DevOps principles) across IT Operations.
* Applies BGIS AI policies and establishes operating guidelines for the responsible use of AI and automation within IT Operations.
Evaluates emerging technologies and recommends investments that improve reliability, reduce risk and deliver value to our clients.  

Financial & Vendor Management

* Develops and manages the IT Operations operating and capital budgets; identifies opportunities for cost optimization while protecting service quality.
* Applies cloud financial management (FinOps) practices to monitor, allocate and optimize cloud consumption costs.
* Manages strategic vendor, managed service provider and outsourcing relationships, including contract negotiation, performance management and SLA governance.
* Ensures managed service providers, offshore and third-party resources meet BGIS and client security, privacy and contractual obligations, in partnership with the CISO and Procurement.
* Supports proposal and client transition teams by defining operational support models and service commitments, and ensures client data, access and integrations are transitioned or decommissioned in line with contractual obligations when client contracts end.
Other duties as assigned.  

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business or equivalent; Master's Degree or MBA is an asset.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive IT experience, including at least 8 years in senior leadership roles within IT Operations, infrastructure and application support.
* Proven experience leading large, multi-disciplinary teams through multiple layers of management, including onshore, offshore and third-party resources.
* Demonstrated track record of supporting business-critical, client-facing solutions in a service delivery or outsourced services environment with contractual SLAs.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure (cloud, data centre, network, end-user computing), service desk operations, application support, and IT service management (ITIL) practices.
* Experience supporting financial/ERP systems and IT general controls in an audited environment.
* Working knowledge of security and privacy frameworks and regulations (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, PIPEDA) as they apply to IT operations.
* Experience sustaining and modernizing legacy and custom-developed software platforms, including software change and release management.
* Proven ability to drive continuous improvement, automation and operational transformation with measurable results.
* Exceptionally skilled business and financial management ability, including management of operating and capital budgets.
* Exceptionally skilled at influencing, negotiating and building relationships with senior management and executives.
* Highly skilled at managing vendor performance and complex service contracts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas in easy to understand business terms.
* Calm, decisive leadership under pressure, with the ability to direct response to major incidents.
Experience in the Real Estate or Facilities Management domain is desirable.  

**Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation**

* ITIL certification is required (Expert or Managing Professional preferred).
PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or cloud platform certifications are an asset.

Title: Responsable, Analyste des opérations commerciales
Description:
**À propos du poste**

  

Beanfield recherche un responsable de l’analyse des opérations métier, doté d’un esprit pratique, pour diriger notre équipe en pleine expansion dédiée aux opérations métier tout en pilotant activement des initiatives techniques et opérationnelles à fort impact. Sous la responsabilité directe du directeur des opérations métier, vous jouerez un rôle central dans le développement de nos méthodes de travail.

  

Dans ce rôle de « joueur-entraîneur », vous partagerez votre temps entre l’accompagnement de vos subordonnés directs, la standardisation du fonctionnement de notre pratique d’analyse métier et la fonction d’analyste métier principal pour les initiatives d’entreprise majeures — notamment notre prochaine mise en œuvre de ServiceNow et le déploiement de systèmes à plus grande échelle. Vous assurerez la liaison entre les unités opérationnelles transversales et les équipes techniques afin de garantir que nos processus soient évolutifs, documentés et alignés sur la croissance de Beanfield.

  
  

**Responsabilités clés**

  

**Leadership et standardisation des pratiques**

  

  
* Gestion d’équipe : diriger, encadrer et développer une équipe d’analystes métier, en organisant régulièrement des entretiens individuels, en équilibrant la charge de travail et en réalisant des évaluations de performance.
  
* Alignement des processus et de la documentation : mettre en place, normaliser et faire respecter des méthodologies d’analyse métier, des modèles et des normes de documentation (cahiers des charges, flux de processus, récits d’utilisateurs) cohérents au sein de toute l’équipe.
  
* Collaboration avec le PMO : travailler en partenariat avec l’équipe de gestion de projet afin d’établir une gouvernance, des normes et des méthodologies de livraison communes à l’ensemble de l’organisation.
  

  

**Mise en œuvre de systèmes d’entreprise (ServiceNow et systèmes centraux)**

  

  
* Responsabilité de la mise en œuvre de bout en bout : Agir en tant qu’analyste métier principal, en charge de l’ensemble des tâches du cycle de vie de l’analyse métier pour la mise en œuvre de ServiceNow chez Beanfield et les déploiements ultérieurs des systèmes d’entreprise — y compris la collecte des besoins, la conception des processus, les spécifications fonctionnelles, les tests d’acceptation par les utilisateurs (UAT) et le support après le lancement.
  
* Exigences et conception : documenter et élaborer des flux de processus métier, des exigences fonctionnelles et des documents de conception de systèmes de haut niveau pour répondre aux nouveaux besoins de l’entreprise.
  
* Animation des parties prenantes : animer des séances de travail et des discussions exploratoires entre les dirigeants et les équipes transversales afin de cartographier les opérations internes et de définir des exigences claires.
  

  

**Amélioration continue et reporting**

  

  
* Optimisation opérationnelle : Identifier de manière proactive les domaines à améliorer ; planifier et mettre en œuvre des initiatives visant à améliorer la qualité, à accroître la productivité et à réduire les coûts opérationnels.
  
* Conseil en solutions : Collaborer avec les équipes internes pour évaluer les compromis et recommander des alternatives techniques ou de processus viables à la direction et aux parties prenantes.
  
* Visibilité et reporting : Surveiller en permanence les flux de travail opérationnels afin d’appliquer les modifications apportées au système, tout en fournissant des rapports d’état clairs et des tableaux de bord décisionnels au directeur des opérations commerciales et à la haute direction.
  

  

**Vos atouts**

  

  
* Expertise ServiceNow (obligatoire) : expérience pratique avérée en tant qu’analyste métier dans le cadre de déploiements ServiceNow, avec une compréhension approfondie des workflows et des fonctionnalités de la plateforme.
  
* Expérience : au moins 5 ans d’expérience en tant qu’analyste métier, dont au moins 1 à 2 ans à diriger, encadrer ou gérer d’autres analystes métier.
  
* Gestion du cycle de vie complet : Expérience avérée dans la prise en charge des livrables d’analyse métier tout au long du cycle de vie de la mise en œuvre du système, depuis l’analyse initiale et la collecte des besoins jusqu’à la conception des processus, la coordination des tests d’acceptation utilisateur (UAT) et la mise en production.
  
* Documentation et modélisation : Capacité avérée à traduire des workflows opérationnels complexes en schémas de processus clairs, en documents de spécifications et en user stories exploitables.
  
* Gouvernance des processus : Expérience avérée dans la création ou la standardisation, de A à Z, de cadres de travail, de modèles et de bonnes pratiques en matière d’analyse métier.
  
* Communication et animation : Solides compétences en animation, avec la capacité d’animer des ateliers, de concilier les priorités contradictoires des parties prenantes et de présenter des tableaux de bord et des mises à jour clairs à la direction.
  

  

**Atouts**

  

  
* Expérience dans le secteur : Une expérience préalable dans le secteur des télécommunications est fortement appréciée.
  
* Certifications telles que CBAP, PMI-PBA ou ITIL Foundation.
  
* Maîtrise des méthodologies Agile/Scrum ainsi que des cadres de gestion de projet traditionnels de type « Waterfall ».

Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking an experienced Group Client Delivery Partner (GCDP) to lead strategic SAP and Enterprise Application Managed Services engagements for key enterprise clients. This role is responsible for end-to-end delivery leadership, client relationship management, commercial performance, service transformation, and account growth across complex managed services and application support portfolios.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, and business executives while ensuring operational excellence, service quality, financial performance, and long-term client success.

------------------------------------

SDMs are fully responsible for providing deliverables or service to specification, within agreed cost and timescale, meeting the necessary quality standards and to customer satisfaction. SDM conduct client negotiations to agree terms for changes to the scope of the project or service, setting realistic expectations and ensuring commercial viability. SDMs manage project or service teams, plan activities and monitor progress. SDM ensure all project deliverables or services are provided using best practices and are of an appropriate quality. SDM provide factual analysis of the project or service portfolio and the teams performance and compliance to standard tools and processes.

Title: Network Engineer
Description:
We are seeking an experienced **Network Engineer** to manage, maintain, and operate the Ministry's network infrastructure across its headquarters and governorate branches.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking, Cisco infrastructure, routing and switching, wireless LAN configuration, firewall administration, network monitoring, and information security.

The successful candidate will ensure network availability, performance, security, and operational continuity while supporting infrastructure improvements and technical operations.

Key Responsibilities

**Network Infrastructure & Administration**

* Manage daily network operations and technical activities related to IT infrastructure.
* Install, configure, operate, and maintain network switches, Cisco Wireless Controllers, and Cisco Voice Gateways.
* Configure and manage VLANs and perform necessary switch modifications.
* Manage Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols, routing, and switching.
* Monitor network connectivity, internet links, leased lines, and overall network performance.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to resolve connectivity issues.

**Wireless Networking & Security**

* Configure and maintain enterprise wireless networks using Cisco, Ruckus, and HP/Aruba technologies.
* Prepare and analyze passive and active Wi-Fi heatmaps.
* Monitor firewall operations, perform necessary updates, and ensure security configurations are maintained.
* Implement information security policies, technical circulars, and network security requirements.
* Manage and monitor network security devices and associated infrastructure.

**Network Monitoring & Communication Systems**

* Monitor and maintain Cisco Call Manager, IP telephony, billing systems, and video communication infrastructure.
* Monitor network devices and connectivity using Cisco Prime Infrastructure 3.7 and PRTG Network Monitor.
* Monitor MPLS, leased lines, DSL connections, and other network links.
* Monitor UPS systems and backup batteries to prevent infrastructure interruptions.

**Backup, Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain secure backups of network devices and configurations before and after every major change.
* Prepare and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including device configurations, connectivity details, and network diagrams using Microsoft Visio.
* Maintain updated infrastructure plans, network drawings, and operational documentation.
* Prepare monthly and on-demand technical reports covering assigned activities, incidents, and resolutions.

**Infrastructure Management & Knowledge Transfer**

* Supervise network infrastructure and server room operations.
* Identify potential network failures and implement preventive measures to ensure service continuity.
* Analyze network equipment specifications and recommend infrastructure improvements.
* Develop operational plans and organize technical tasks to ensure business continuity.
* Provide knowledge transfer, technical guidance, and training to the Ministry's IT staff.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Networking, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum **5+ years of professional experience** in Network Engineering / Network Administration.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols.
* Practical experience with routing and switching technologies, particularly Cisco and HP/Aruba.
* Strong experience configuring and managing enterprise wireless networks using Cisco, Ruckus, and HP/Aruba.
* Ability to prepare and analyze active and passive Wi-Fi heatmaps.
* Knowledge of structured cabling systems, including passive network infrastructure.
* Experience with MPLS, leased lines, DSL connections, and ISP coordination.
* Knowledge of Cisco IP Phones, Cisco Call Manager, and voice communication systems.
* Familiarity with Cisco Prime Infrastructure 3.7 and PRTG Network Monitor.
* Experience with Cisco Firepower 5508 and Fortinet FortiGate firewalls (1000-D, 501E, and 60E).
* Strong troubleshooting, network security, and infrastructure management skills.
* Excellent documentation, reporting, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and under pressure.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, public holidays, and overtime when required.

**Mandatory Certifications**

Candidates must hold relevant networking and infrastructure certifications, including:

* MCSE – Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert.
* CCNA – Cisco Certified Network Associate.
* CCNP – Cisco Certified Network Professional.

**Additional Preferred Certifications**

* VCP-DCV – VMware Certified Professional, Data Center Virtualization.
* VCP-NV – VMware Certified Professional, Network Virtualization.
* MCITP – Microsoft Certified IT Professional.

Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) principles will be an added advantage.

**Nationality Preference**

* Omani Nationals – First Preference.
* Non-Omani Nationals – Second Preference.

Interested candidates are invited to apply with their updated CV, clearly highlighting their networking experience, Cisco and firewall expertise, and relevant certifications.
