Title: Project Engineer - Controls Systems
Description:
### **What You Will Do**

The Project Engineer - Controls will report directly to the Branch Manager and will be based in Qatar. As part of the Controls & Building Automation Systems (BAS) team, you will be responsible for the engineering, design review, project execution, testing, commissioning, and successful delivery of Building Management System (BMS) and Integrated Controls projects across multiple client sites.

You will work closely with customers, subcontractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with customer specifications and company standards. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop advanced technical, project management, and customer engagement skills within a dynamic environment.

### **How You Will Do It**

As a Project Engineer - Controls, you will leverage your technical expertise in BMS and Building Automation Systems to support all phases of project execution, from engineering and design review through commissioning and handover.

You will:

* Execute BMS, HVAC Controls, and Building Automation projects in accordance with project schedules, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Review project specifications, drawings, sequences of operation, and control schematics to ensure compliance with client and consultant requirements.
* Prepare engineering submittals, technical documentation, method statements, and project reports.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers to facilitate smooth project execution and timely issue resolution.
* Configure, program, and commission BMS controllers, supervisory systems, field devices, and network integrations.
* Perform functional testing, point-to-point verification, system integration, and site acceptance testing.
* Provide technical support during installation, startup, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, delays, and technical challenges, recommending corrective actions where necessary.
* Ensure compliance with project quality requirements, company procedures, and HSE standards throughout project execution.
* Manage subcontractors and site teams to ensure adherence to project schedules and delivery milestones.
* Assist in project planning, resource allocation, procurement coordination, and material management activities.
* Support project closeout activities, including preparation of as-built documentation, O&M manuals, training, and client handover.
* Prepare progress reports and maintain effective communication with all project stakeholders.

### **What We Look For**

**Required**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or Control Engineering.
* Minimum 5-6 years of experience in the design, engineering, execution, or commissioning of Building Management Systems (BMS), Building Automation Systems (BAS), or Controls projects.
* Proven experience in HVAC controls, chiller plant controls, energy management systems, and building automation applications.
* Strong understanding of control system architectures, field devices, communication protocols, and system integrations including BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, and TCP/IP networking.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, control schematics, sequence of operations, specifications, and technical submittals.
* Experience in system programming, controller configuration, graphics development, and commissioning activities.
* Knowledge of project execution methodologies, risk management, and quality control processes.
* Strong understanding of project documentation, contractual requirements, and client communications.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

* Valid Qatar driving license.
* Strong client-facing, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple stakeholders and project priorities.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on large-scale commercial, healthcare, data center, hospitality, or infrastructure projects within the GCC region.

Description:

It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.

About the Role:

When the unexpected happens, are you ready to make that critical call which keeps the network moving?

Central to this key role is your ability to execute day-of-operations network control for assigned flights, missions or regions within the published IOCC control  
window, under the operational control of the IOCC Shift Manager and day-to-day guidance of the Senior Operations Controller.

A core part of the role is monitoring the flying program, aircraft rotations, and operational systems to identify emerging risks early. Material issues must be escalated promptly so the right decisions can be made at pace.

Working closely with internal teams, stations, handling partners, and external agencies, the role coordinates approved actions from operational readiness to flight completion. This includes managing delays, cancellations, diversions, technical events, weather disruption, and airport or airspace constraints.

With responsibility for operational data integrity, this position ensures flight movements, aircraft assignments, delays, remarks, and event records are updated accurately in real time. The role also supports stakeholder notifications, handovers, operational reports, and aircraft allocation information in line with approved procedures.

You can expect to help coordinate slots, landing permissions, overflight permissions, and related approvals when operational changes require them. The position also supports special operations such as positioning flights, aircraft deliveries, inaugural services, charters, training activity, and functional check flights.

**EMS Education Manager**
=========================

**Posting Number:** #2186

**Position Title:** EMS Education Manager

**Closing Date:** Until Filled

**Location:** Remote, USA

  

The Public Health Institute (PHI) is an independent, nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting health, well-being, and quality of life for people throughout California, across the nation and around the world. As one of the largest and most comprehensive public health organizations in the nation, we are at the forefront of research and innovations to improve the efficacy of public health statewide, nationally, and internationally.

PHI was distinguished as one of the top 50 “Best Non-Profit Organizations to Work For” by the Non-Profit Times in a national search.

  

##### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Bridge Center (Bridge) at the Public Health Institute (PHI) works across the health care system to expand access to low-barrier addiction treatment and sexual and reproductive health care, and to advance health equity. Since 2019, CA Bridge has supported more than 290 hospitals to implement medications for addiction treatment (MAT) in the emergency department (ED) based on the CA Bridge model for 24/7 low-barrier access to evidence-based care. Since then, Bridge has trained teams in 22 states, 56 EDs, and 6 EMS agencies. Collectively, they reach 2,181 providers whose EDs see nearly 2.5 million patient visits a year.

EMS Bridge extends low-barrier MAT to paramedics, bringing EMS-initiated buprenorphine to communities across the country, including in California. The National Expansion Project builds capacity for emergency department-based MAT across the country; the ED Syphilis/HIV/HCV Screening Program supports emergency departments in implementing routine opt-out screening and linkage to care; and Access Bridge increases access to contraception and treatment for pregnancy emergencies from the ED.

##### **POSITION OVERVIEW**

Bridge is hiring an EMS Education Manager to work with our EMS Bridge team. EMS Bridge began in California, which remains home to our largest EMS program and much of our ongoing EMS research and implementation work, and now supports EMS agencies in other states. The EMS Education Manager will lead day-to-day planning, coordination, and delivery of EMS Bridge education, training, and technical assistance for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators, training officers, and agency leaders. Additionally, this role will lead the development and ongoing improvement of EMS Bridge curricula, run EMS Bridge learning collaboratives, and support grant reporting on training and technical assistance activities. Strong project management expertise will be necessary in these tasks. The successful candidate will bring direct experience as a paramedic or EMT and as an EMS educator and will work with a range of team members and external partners to support EMS agencies to offer buprenorphine and connection to ongoing care for people with opioid use disorder.

The full salary range for this position: $79,333 to $115,098 per year. The typical hiring range for this position is from $79,333 (minimum) to $97,216 (midpoint). The starting salary is determined based on the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and budget availability.

Employment Type: Full Time

##### **Important Information**

* This is a regular full-time 1.0 FTE position with a schedule of 40 hours per week.
* This is a fully remote position that requires travel approximately 30% of the work time, to EMS agency sites, trainings, conferences, and partner meetings as requested, including 2-4 All Staff meetings per year in the San Francisco Bay Area.
* The selected candidate will determine their work schedule in collaboration with their supervisor and is expected to be available during core business hours (9:00am – 2:00pm Pacific Time). Some trainings may be scheduled outside core hours, requiring flexible availability, to reach EMS crews on varied shift schedules.
* This position is open to applicants nationwide.
* **To apply, please submit a resume and cover letter detailing your interest in and qualifications for this position.**

##### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following:**

##### **EMS Training & Technical Assistance**

* Under the direction of the National & EMS Program Director, lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of trainings for paramedics and EMTs, in person and virtually, including initial buprenorphine trainings, refreshers, case reviews, and scenario-based sessions.
* Translate strategies and priorities established by senior leadership into actionable training and technical assistance plans, activities, resources, and deliverables.
* Design, coordinate, facilitate, and continuously improve EMS Bridge learning collaboratives and communities of practice for participating EMS agencies. This will include:
  + Developing agendas, learning objectives, session plans, facilitation approaches, and supporting materials for collaborative learning activities.
  + Identifying and coordinating Bridge staff, clinical consultants, field providers, and external presenters to contribute to learning collaborative sessions and other educational programming.
  + Incorporating equity and harm reduction content throughout collaborative programming.
  + Fostering opportunities for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators to learn from one another and build professional connections across agencies and regions.
* Partner with EMS educators, training officers, and agency leaders to build their capacity to teach EMS Bridge content within their own agencies.
* Provide individualized and group mentorship to field providers and EMS educators participating in Bridge programming, drawing on direct experience as a paramedic or EMT and as an EMS educator.
* Assess the training and technical assistance needs of field providers and participating agencies and identify appropriate strategies, resources, and subject matter experts to address those needs.
* Alongside other members of the EMS Bridge team, provide technical assistance related to implementing EMS-initiated buprenorphine, including protocol rollout, field workflows, documentation, patient engagement, crew buy-in and addressing stigma, and handoffs and linkage to care with emergency departments and community treatment programs.
* Identify common themes, challenges, and emerging needs surfaced through trainings, mentorship, and collaborative activities and communicate those findings to Bridge leadership to inform future programming and resource development.
* Identify and disseminate promising practices, tools, resources, and emerging evidence relevant to EMS-initiated buprenorphine and prehospital overdose response.
* Track participation and capture feedback and testimonials from trainings, site visits, and learning collaboratives.
* Represent the Bridge Center’s EMS training and technical assistance work at meetings, trainings, EMS conferences, and other events as requested.

##### **Curriculum & Educational Resource Development**

* Under the direction of the National & EMS Program Director, support development, adaptation, and ongoing improvement of EMS Bridge training curricula and educational resources for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators.
* Develop practical, accessible training materials and resources, including presentations, facilitator guides, case scenarios, skills and simulation activities, job aids, quick-reference tools, and other educational products.
* Collaborate with Bridge clinical experts and other subject matter experts to translate clinical guidance and evidence into practical educational materials for field providers.
* Coordinate subject matter expert review of curricula and resources to ensure materials are accurate, relevant, consistent with Bridge’s approach, and appropriate for EMS audiences.
* Support processes for offering continuing education credit for EMS Bridge trainings, where applicable.
* Incorporate participant feedback, implementation experience, emerging evidence, and changes in the EMS and substance use care landscape into ongoing curriculum and resource improvements.

##### **Project Management & Reporting**

* Manage the day-to-day implementation of assigned EMS training, technical assistance, learning collaborative, and curriculum-development activities from planning through completion.
* Maintain and support the development of project workplans, timelines, milestones, and deliverable trackers to ensure activities remain on schedule.
* Collect and synthesize training attendance, evaluation results, participant feedback, and lessons learned to inform continuous quality improvement.
* Support grant reporting by preparing training and technical assistance data, narratives, and site summaries in line with funder deliverables.
* Collaborate across Bridge teams and projects to identify opportunities to share resources, align programming, reduce duplication, and strengthen the consistency of Bridge training and technical assistance.

Perform other duties as assigned.

##### **QUALIFICATIONS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

##### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Five years’ work experience, including at least one year of experience as a paramedic or EMT, and experience teaching or training others in EMS and/or other clinical settings
* Bachelor’s degree; or high school diploma and an additional four years of relevant work experience, or associate’s degree and an additional two years of relevant work experience.

##### **Other Required Qualifications**

* Knowledge of EMS systems, operations, and culture, and of overdose response and substance use treatment.
* Strong training and presentation skills, and ability to facilitate and engage small and large groups of field providers in dialogue and learning.
* Experience developing training curricula and materials for EMS providers.
* Experience facilitating meetings, learning collaboratives, or communities of practice.
* Understanding of adult learning principles, including scenario-based and simulation learning, and how to embed them in training programs.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Adaptable, flexible, and receptive to feedback.
* Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills.
* Proficiency in Google Suite, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Lived experience with substance use, or with the communities most affected by substance use and overdose, is valued and strengthens this work.

##### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strongly preferred: EMS instructor credential (e.g., state EMS instructor certification or NAEMSE Instructor).
* Preferred: Experience with buprenorphine or other medications for opioid use disorder in EMS or other clinical settings.

  + Ensure legislative compliance related to payroll taxes, remittances, pension administration, and record retention requirements.
  + Monitor legislative changes and assess operational or system impacts to payroll processes and configurations.
  + Partner with Finance and Accounting teams to ensure payroll-related journal entries, accruals, and reconciliations are accurate and completed within required timelines.
  + Oversee payroll GL interface validation, account balancing, reallocations, and suspense resolution activities.
  + Develop controls and processes to ensure readiness for internal and external payroll audits, partnering with Finance, Internal Audit, HR, Legal, and external advisors so that payroll practices are defensible, documented, and audit ready.

  + Create and lead execution of the payroll and time tracking transformation roadmap, ensuring payroll capabilities evolve to meet business, compliance, technology, and workforce needs.
  + Identify, prioritize, and execute continuous improvement opportunities across payroll operations, systems, reporting, controls, and employee experience in collaboration with HR, Accounting, FP&A, Operations, and Digital.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Payroll, HR, Finance and other business areas.

**Job Description**
**About Moove**
Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best-in-class technologies to power mobility platforms. Our flagship Drive-to-Own (DTO) product democratises access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue-based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.
  
  
Our global growth has been fuelled by our partnership with Uber and backed by leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, and many others. Today, Moove operates the worlds largest manned & autonomous ride-hail fleet, with 38k+ vehicles across 29 cities, 13 countries and 6 continents enabled by 2.1k+ employees – Moove continues to expand through strategic partnerships with industry leaders like Uber. We’re transforming mobility to be safer, more efficient, and accessible to all, while creating economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Customer Support Lead, you own passenger support for Moove AV in the UAE. You will build and lead the Customer Support team, set the response standard and handle escalated passenger issues. You will also design, run and improve the support processes, systems and SOPs that connect passenger interactions with live, 24/7 autonomous operations.
  
  
This role reports to the Remote Operations and Customer Support Manager. You will work closely with Remote Operations on passenger communication during live rides, and with the Safety Manager on every passenger safety report.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Team Leadership**

* Lead, schedule and coach the Customer Support Executives across shifts, and plan shift cover around Ops Control Centre hours
* Hire, onboard and develop the Customer Support Executives, and manage their performance
* Make sure every Customer Support Executive is trained and signed off on safety escalation and passenger-incident procedures before handling live passengers
* Set and monitor service standards for response and resolution
* Run quality checks on interactions and give feedback; calibrate quality scores monthly with your manager
* Run shift handovers so open cases, callbacks, refunds and lost items carry over between shifts

**Escalation Management**

* Handle escalated passenger cases, and make sure every safety report reaches the Safety Manager immediately
* Own each passenger case handed over by Remote Operations through to closure
* Decide refunds, goodwill and fees within the service recovery policy, and escalate anything above it
* Lead the response for stranded passengers: first contact within the agreed target and onward transport arranged
* Handle the passenger side of lost property
* Run the support team’s response during service disruptions
* Route personal data and privacy requests to Legal in line with the UAE PDPL

**Customer Support Process Design and Systems**

* Take over and run the customer support foundations built for launch: support tooling (ticketing, in-app chat and phone), case categories, the knowledge base and support SOPs
* Work with Tech & Product, Remote Operations, Fleet Operations, Safety and Ops Excellence to design, test and refine how passenger interactions connect to live operations, including handoffs, escalation routes, response times and who acts on each case type
* Confirm the operational information Customer Support needs in real time (trip, vehicle and incident status) and agree how it reaches the support team
* Test support workflows with Operations before each new launch phase goes live and keep them aligned with operational and safety procedures as the service scales
* Plan and deliver the support processes each launch phase needs: phone support, partner-platform passengers, rider conduct and suspension, and accessibility
* Map the passenger journey end to end and close gaps between support, Remote Operations and the app
* Write and maintain support SOPs, scripts and the knowledge base, and agree service recovery limits with Finance
* Plan support capacity: headcount, shift patterns and channel mix against forecast demand

**Insight and Improvement**

* Define the support metrics and targets (CSAT, response and resolution times, first-contact resolution, and time to contact passengers handed over by Remote Operations) with your manager, baseline them, report against them weekly, and provide support data for programme and product objectives
* Report passenger feedback and recurring issues to your manager, and run the weekly review that sends complaint trends to Remote Operations and agrees changes to case categories and reply templates
* Turn case data into process changes: root causes, repeat contacts and refund cost

**What You Will Need For This Position**
Requirements to Apply
  
  

* At least 5 years of experience in customer service, including at least 2 years leading a support team across shifts
* Experience in mobility, travel or technology support is an advantage
* Calm, empathetic and decisive under pressure
* Comfortable with support systems and service metrics, and able to build reports in spreadsheets or a BI tool
* Experience designing support processes end to end: mapping passenger journeys, writing SOPs, setting SLAs and measuring results
* Experience taking support tools, workflows and SOPs from launch into daily operation, ideally in a new market or start-up setting
* Fluent in English; Arabic is a strong advantage. You will be responsible for Arabic cover on every shift
* Working knowledge of UAE consumer protection and personal data protection (PDPL) rules
* Able to work flexible hours in a 24/7 operation, including evenings, weekends and being on call for escalations

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality, Operations, Transport and Logistics or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Key Metrics**
What Does Success Look Like
  
  

* Service standards met across all shifts, with Arabic cover on every shift
* Support metrics defined and baselined within the first 90 days, and targets met from then on
* Every safety report reaches the Safety Manager immediately, and every passenger handed over by Remote Operations is contacted within target
* Every Customer Support Executive signed off on safety escalation procedures before handling live passengers
* Support tools, escalation flows and SOPs reviewed and tested with Operations within the first 90 days
* Refunds and goodwill kept within policy limits
* Support processes for each launch phase designed, documented and live on schedule
* Repeat contacts and refund cost falling quarter on quarter

**Job Description**

  

Reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer of TD Waterhouse Canada Inc. (CCO), who also serves as Associate Vice President, Compliance, the Head of Wealth Compliance Strategy, Emerging Risks & Transformation leads priority initiatives within the CCO’s mandate. The role translates emerging risks and regulatory developments into decision-ready advice and leads cross-functional change to strengthen the Compliance program.

The role operates within the CCO’s mandate for TD Waterhouse Canada Inc., engaging across businesses, legal entities, and enterprise functions on assigned matters. Its priorities include strategy and emerging risk, transformation and remediation, and improvements to Compliance governance, processes, controls, reporting, data, technology, and operating practices.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy within delegated authority, the Head advises the CCO and other senior leaders, provides objective analysis and effective challenge, and builds alignment across organizational boundaries. The role leads assigned initiatives from assessment through implementation and transition to ongoing operating ownership, with a focus on proportionate, risk-based outcomes.

  

**Key Accountabilities**

  

*Strategy, Emerging Risk, and Regulatory Insight*

* Monitor regulatory, industry, business, technology, data, cyber, and operational developments; assess their regulatory compliance and conduct implications for the CCO’s portfolio; and identify matters requiring action or escalation.

* Develop evidence-based recommendations setting out the issue, options, trade-offs, and proposed course of action for the CCO and other senior leaders.
* Support Compliance strategy, annual planning, and management objectives by developing analysis and recommendations and leading assigned priorities.
Lead assigned regulatory impact assessments and implementation planning, or provide advice and coordination where other teams retain ownership.  

  

*Transformation and Priority Initiative Delivery*

* Lead assigned Compliance transformation, modernization, remediation, and strategic initiatives from initial assessment through implementation.
* Establish objectives, governance, roles, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and measures of success; monitor progress and escalate material risks, delivery concerns, and unresolved matters.
* Assess the impact of business and enterprise change on Compliance accountabilities, capacity, controls, infrastructure, and operating models.
* Identify process and operating-model improvements and opportunities to use data, technology, analytics, automation, or artificial intelligence where they strengthen oversight, decision-making, or operational effectiveness.
* Challenge proposals that may create regulatory risk, control weaknesses, unclear accountabilities, unnecessary complexity, or unsustainable Compliance obligations.
* Coordinate resolution of cross-functional dependencies and clarify proposed ownership and outcomes with the relevant stakeholders.
Establish implementation readiness, stakeholder adoption, documented operating ownership, and appropriate post-implementation monitoring for transition to business-as-usual operations.  

  

*Compliance Program Effectiveness and Governance*

* Support assessments of Compliance program effectiveness, maturity, and alignment with regulatory expectations and enterprise requirements.
* Assess governance, processes, controls, procedures, reporting, and infrastructure to identify gaps and recommend proportionate improvements.
* Lead assigned regulatory, audit, issue-management, control-enhancement, and program-improvement initiatives, or provide advice and coordination where another team retains delivery ownership.
* Support practical and defensible responses to regulatory examinations, inquiries, findings, and other regulatory matters.
* Support the development of risk indicators, management information, trend analysis, and forward-looking reporting that inform oversight and decisions.
Recommend consistent, risk-based Compliance practices, clear ownership, and appropriate documentation, avoiding duplication across assigned initiatives.

* Advise the CCO and other senior leaders on complex, sensitive, or evolving matters, providing independent Compliance guidance and constructive challenge.
* Prepare decision-ready briefings, presentations, governance reports, and other materials that explain the issue, implications, options, and recommended action for the intended audience.
* Build relationships across Wealth, Compliance, Legal, Risk, Governance and Control, Technology, Operations, and other corporate functions, aligning stakeholders with different mandates and priorities.
* Explain regulatory, risk, technology, and transformation matters to senior, technical, and non-technical audiences, supporting timely decisions and transparent escalation.
Represent the CCO or Wealth Compliance at designated committees, regulatory and industry forums, working groups, and stakeholder discussions, as assigned.  

  

*Leadership and Capability Development*

* Lead cross-functional teams, working groups, project resources, consultants, or direct reports, as applicable, with clear expectations for assigned outcomes and delivery.
* Coach colleagues and share knowledge to build capabilities across Wealth Compliance.
* Foster collaboration, inclusion, innovation, constructive challenge, continuous improvement, and prudent risk management.
Support workforce planning, role clarity, operating-model development, organizational change, and broader Compliance priorities, as assigned.

Assignments within the CCO’s mandate may include strategy and annual planning; emerging regulatory compliance and conduct risks; regulatory change, examinations, inquiries, engagement, and remediation; Internal Audit, Compliance Testing, issue management, and control-framework enhancement; Compliance modernization, policy and procedure improvement, and operating-model, business, or enterprise change; governance and executive reporting; and data, analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, or technology enablement. Essential Qualifications and Capabilities
